Regulatory interviews established that a product containing no viable GMOs faces a considerably simpler approval path, which they explored alongside deliberate release and which shaped biosafety from an early stage. They also document conflicting stakeholder views and explain why some were not implemented.

**publicEngagement.** Triton has no separate education or outreach page; its public-facing work is the wiki itself, built as a scroll-driven public explainer that teaches why TFA matters before it mentions synthetic biology - the ECHA reproductive-toxicity classification, the 110-of-110 blood study, the >98% PFAS share, the 34-of-36 tap water result - with named stakeholder quotes and faces carrying the argument, a front-page feedback widget that opens the visitor's own mail client, and a step-by-step experimental video for the fluoride assay published for other labs to follow. Their documented engagement effort went into the professional and policy community rather than schools: over 30 stakeholders through interviews, company visits and events, with every stakeholder given an explanation of why the team reached out, what was learned and what was or was not incorporated, plus a published analysis of future regulatory and industrial developments offered as a starting point for anyone working on TFA contamination.

**realWorld.** Implementation is specified as a real retrofit rather than a concept: Triton sits downstream of existing split-stream reverse osmosis at a drinking water plant, with the capture module as a granular filter of bacterial cellulose beads carrying TFA-binding proteins attached through a cellulose-binding domain, eluted with a wash buffer so beads are reused, feeding a three-day bioreactor where evolved dehalogenase turns TFA into oxalate and fluoride while the riboswitch biosensor monitors continuously. Biosafety is specified per module: the beads contain no living cells and need no extra measures, the biosensor's small water stream is collected and autoclaved, and the bioreactor effluent gets UV sterilisation before discharge. Timeline is roughly 10 years to drinking-water implementation, with permitting, certification and grid congestion named as the bottlenecks rather than construction, and the biosensor identified as the faster path. The market analysis is sharply scoped - not water treatment, not PFAS at large, but the destruction of PFAS that filtration cannot retain, noting destruction was 24.9% of the PFAS treatment market in 2025 and is the fastest-growing segment at a projected 10.1% CAGR against 7.1% overall. The business plan runs a six-phase TRL 3 to 9 roadmap with a gate per phase, a cost analysis across physical and human capital, 2.6M euro to raise and break-even in 2033, six commercial and adoption risks each with a mitigation, five technical failure modes each with a fallback, an operational plan with a Dreyfus-model skill gap analysis resolved build/borrow/outsource, and a SWOT identifying a co-development partner as the predominant stakeholder. IP is worked out concretely: the software is not patentable because its source is deposited on the iGEM GitLab (but is copyright-protected), while BLASTp against the patented protein database returned only 43.30% maximum identity for DAR3835 and H1_ML against claims requiring 95%, so the evolved enzymes remain patentable.

**給 GEMS：** Build the measurement first and publish it as a product, not a result: their fluoride assay won Best Measurement because the protocol, the LOD/LOQ derivation, the acceptance thresholds, the comparison across five media and the documented failure modes (phosphate interference, saturation above 40 uM) all let another lab decide in advance whether it fits - and it needs only a 96-well plate reader and two cheap reagents, which is squarely within a high-school research centre's reach. The companion habit worth copying is PIGEON's reward design: charging a loss in the primary objective tenfold against the secondary one stops a model from quietly trading away the thing you actually care about.

### Stanford University — KelePatch
Undergrad · USA · https://2026.igem.wiki/stanford-university/
KelePatch builds an ADAR-based RADAR RNA sensor that only switches on inside keloid myofibroblasts, so a therapeutic payload is produced in diseased cells and not in healthy skin. The team designed a 26-part modular sensor collection across five fibrosis transcripts (ADAM12, POSTN, ASPN, COL11A1, SPP1), validated them in HEK293 cells, combined the two best into a dual-input AND gate for extra selectivity, and tested in healthy dermal fibroblasts and keloid-derived fibroblasts; they also paired a sensor with Cas12a2 to show the output is not limited to fluorescent reporters. Alongside the wet lab they built RADAR-Scout, a published web platform that takes a cell type and a gene and returns a ranked, structure-aware list of RADAR sensor candidates plus a mechanistic simulation of how it will behave. It won the Grand Prize because every layer connects: 960,518 single cells of transcriptomics pick the trigger, ViennaRNA folding energy ranks the sensor, ODE models explain the delay they saw at the bench, and a U-Net++ computer vision pipeline turns a photo of a scar into a 3D-printable patch.

**frameworks.** Four stacked layers. (1) Single-cell transcriptomics at scale: a processing pipeline integrating 26 scRNA-seq cohorts across cardiac, cutaneous, renal, hepatic and pulmonary fibrosis - 960,518 cells and 1,728 donor-population observations from CELLxGENE, CELLxGENE Census and GEO - with donor-level statistics averaged at equal donor weight so large-cell-count donors do not dominate. Rather than ordinary differential expression, they score each candidate across three populations (Pathological, Healthy, Bystander) to ask whether a transcript is abundant in the target cell and absent from neighbours, which is what an intracellular sensor actually requires. (2) RNA structure prediction: 19 predictors computed with ViennaRNA 2.7.2 (RNAfold for MFE and ensembles, RNApfold for per-nucleotide unpaired probability, RNAcofold for the sensor-trigger duplex) spanning sequence composition, secondary structure, accessibility and hybridization. (3) Mechanistic kinetics: five interconnected deterministic mass-action ODE models with a stochastic counterpart, covering plasmid nuclear entry, single-trigger plasmid, single-trigger RNA, AND-gate plasmid and AND-gate RNA delivery, built on Ligon et al.'s lipoplex delivery cascade with occupancy resolved into nine pit states and ten endosome states; 82 parameters are tabulated with provenance, and four are fitted by simulated annealing in Python against Cohen et al.'s qPCR nuclear copy-number data (p_entry = 0.107, K_sat = 232, k_TX = 0.273). A nine-state hybridization/editing scheme tracks the joint status of both AND-gate sites. (4) Device physics: finite element analysis using Fick's law, the Stokes-Einstein relation and Darcy's law for LNP diffusion through keloid extracellular matrix, plus a nociceptor-count model for pain.

**datascience.** The core result is a replacement for a field convention. The informal RADAR design guideline was to pick the candidate with the lowest GC content. Stanford built a 5x5 experimental library of 25 sensors, measured them by flow cytometry in HEK293 across two replicates (r = 0.94), gated the top 5% mCherry-positive cells and took geometric-mean GFP / geometric-mean mCherry as the output metric, then correlated 19 computational predictors against it. Sensor partition-function folding free energy reached Spearman rho = 0.62-0.63, against -0.29 for GC content and -0.31 for longest homopolymer - so folding energy, not composition, became the ranking filter inside RADAR-Scout. They were honest about what failed: linear, Ridge and Elastic Net regression on the same features reached only Q2 = 0.20, which is explicitly what pushed them from statistical fitting to mechanistic ODEs. Cross-organ analysis of the top 300 genes per organ found 857 of 1,136 distinct genes appeared in only one organ and pairwise Jaccard similarity of 0.050-0.145, so they rejected the idea of a universal fibrosis biomarker set. Isoform filtering uses GTEx Oxford Nanopore long-read data (~150,000 transcripts, 92 samples, 15 tissues) to check the trigger sequence is actually present in the isoforms that cell type expresses.

**dataviz.** RADAR-Scout is the visualization: a deployed web app (https://radar-scout.vercel.app/, with a companion dashboard at https://radar-scout-dashboard.vercel.app/) where the keloid view ranks 600 filtered genes across five cohorts on the left and plots every candidate sensor for the selected gene on the right, so a target and a sensor are chosen in the same screen, with filters for region type, codon variant, duplex length and isoform, and shortlist/CSV export. Changing the selected tissue reruns the isoform analysis live. The wiki itself is a hand-built site with per-page accent colours and mascot illustrations, and the modelling page is written so a reader can follow each decision: predictor correlations are shown three ways (full Spearman matrix at n = 24, per-replicate rho, then all predictors ranked) and the team states plainly that non-significant predictors are 'unresolved at n = 24 rather than confirmed null'. Parameter tables flag which values are fitted, which are placeholders, and which disagreements remain unresolved.

**software.** RADAR-Scout, live at https://radar-scout.vercel.app/ with a dashboard at https://radar-scout-dashboard.vercel.app/. It solves a real engineering problem: the Gao lab's published RADAR candidate table has roughly 7 million rows and could not be held in memory, so build_database.py ingests human_RADAR_sensor_candidates.csv.gz into a SQLite database in 100,000-row chunks with an index on the gene column, and the app queries it read-only with 50 candidates per API page. The computer vision pipeline for personalized microneedle patches uses a U-Net++ with a ResNet34 encoder (from segmentation_models.pytorch) to segment keloid wound photographs, then drives the Autodesk Fusion 360 API to emit a CAD/STL file for 3D printing. Separately, SynBase (https://synbase.web.app/home.html) is a released, free, account-based online learning platform. Parts: 26 modular RADAR parts including 15 functional sensors across five transcripts, novel composite synthetic triggers that each test an entire sensor panel for one gene, a dual-input AND gate, and T7 in vitro transcribed capped polyadenylated mRNA versions.

**ihp.** The team was trained in Stanford's Biodesign process by Dr Ross Venook, who told them that biodesign means shadowing clinicians rather than searching online, and they built the whole project around that. Ideation ran as a weekly discipline: every member interviewed one person a week - over twenty conversations with professors, researchers and people in their lives - and a team member's experience with ReSurge, an NGO training reconstructive surgeons abroad, surfaced the statistic that 30% of global disease burden is surgical and reframed abnormal scarring as an access problem. Professor Fan Yang told them burns and keloids are separate research areas and doing both would muddle the work, so they picked one. At the Stanford BIOME Shark Tank they pitched to eight judges (faculty, investors, biotech entrepreneurs) who returned written scorecards; the published response table shows each criticism and what they did, including a judge's suggestion to build an AI-CAD platform for microneedles, which became the U-Net++ segmentation-to-Fusion-360 pipeline. When they looked for keloid patient advocacy groups there were almost none, and the one foundation that replied told them to talk to clinicians instead - the team says plainly that physicians cannot stand in for patients' lived experience and documents this as a second-best route. They then contacted 28 Stanford dermatologists and plastic surgeons and interviewed seven, with a standard instrument of Likert-scale ranking statements plus specialty-specific open questions. Three concerns recurred - recurrence within two years, pain and inconvenience of repeated injections, and difficulty getting drug into dense scar tissue - and each changed the design: Dr Teng's point that late-stage keloids are far harder to treat moved the target from prevention to established keloids; Dr Li's recommendation of collagen-scaffold fibroblast and hydrogel mechanotransduction assays changed the validation plan; physicians' complaint about repeated injections, plus Dr Li's endorsement of a patch, drove the wound-shaped microneedle array, held at 900 um because needles over 1000 um are documented to cause bleeding and pain. Dr Miranda consulted her own network on whether viral-derived parts are inflammatory, and the team decided against combining saRADAR with RNA export machinery as a result. With no animal model for keloids (they occur only in humans), they met Genoskin about their ex vivo human skin models and identified that as the next safety step.

**publicEngagement.** Two deliberately linked programmes. SiBRP (Stanford iGEM Bioengineering Research Program) is a free, fully online three-week bioengineering bootcamp for high school students and incoming freshmen, with nine synchronous two-hour sessions plus three supplemental ones, progressing from molecular biology fundamentals through biodesign, genetic circuit design, plasmid design and experimental workflow to entrepreneurship and ethics. Students work in small groups to produce a full research proposal with literature review and experimental design, submitted as a draft, returned with TA feedback, then revised against a published rubric. It drew nearly 5,000 applications from all 50 US states and over 100 countries (up from 321 in its first year), with two-thirds of applicants female and over 60% from low-income and first-generation backgrounds; 230 participated. Nine guest speakers included iGEM co-founder Drew Endy. Because mentored capacity could not meet demand, the team converted the whole curriculum into SynBase (https://synbase.web.app/home.html) - 'Khan Academy, but for synthetic biology' - nine self-paced modules with accounts that save progress, knowledge checks, interactive activities and discussion boards, no application and no deadline, free worldwide. As of 17 October 2026 it had 750+ registered learners and 650+ free-response discussion contributions, with dry lab modules in development, and the team explicitly invites other iGEM teams to use or adapt it for onboarding their own members.

**realWorld.** The team was explicit at the Shark Tank that a target product profile was secondary to characterising a modular sensor platform other teams and scientists can reuse, and the contribution page is written as a handoff: swap the sensor region for a new transcript, add a second input as an AND gate, deliver as DNA or RNA, attach your own payload. The clinical path is staged and named - validate the Gao lab sensors and their own in HEK293, validate the AND gate, move to keloid and normal human fibroblast lines, add payload, then terminal assay in Genoskin's ex vivo human skin model for immunotoxicity, phenotypic and transcriptomic readouts - and Genoskin representatives engaged and advised on how to run it. The Cas12a2 payload work and the in vitro transcribed mRNA format are both framed as moving toward the form a real therapy would take rather than a reporter demo. SynBase is maintained beyond the competition as a continuing programme rather than a competition artefact.

**給 GEMS：** Stanford's SiBRP-to-SynBase pivot is the directly copyable move: they ran a small mentored cohort, discovered demand they could not staff (5,000 applications for 230 places), and then converted the exact same curriculum into a free self-paced online course with progress tracking and discussion boards - so the teaching asset outlives the cohort. A high-school-plus centre in Taiwan can do the same with its own course material, and should also adopt their dry-lab habit of testing the field's received wisdom (lowest GC content) against its own measured data and replacing it with a better predictor.

### HongKong-JSS — MerMAID - MerR-based Mercury Assay for In-field Detection
High School · Hong Kong · https://2026.igem.wiki/hongkong-jss/
HongKong-JSS is a four-school joint team (Y.W.C.A. Hioe Tjo Yoeng College, Po Leung Kuk Celine Ho Yam Tong College, Pentecostal School, Yan Oi Tong Tin Ka Ping Secondary School) that built a complete mercury-screening system for agricultural water and soil: a MerR-regulated E. coli biosensor expressing mRFP1e, a portable modular fluorescence reader, and a motorised sample-extraction platform that turns soil and water into a standard assay input. They designed, built and tested 13 biosensor prototypes - 2 aptamer-based and 11 protein-based - of which two protein designs responded to Hg2+, with the best showing low background, a response down to about 1 ppb (0.005 uM, roughly sixfold below the WHO drinking-water guideline of 6 ug/L), no cross-response to Cd2+, Pb2+ or Zn2+ at the concentrations tested, and retained function after alginate encapsulation. It took 1st Runner-up Grand Prize in the High School section and won Best Village Project, and the reason is visible on every page: the wiki's standing rule is that every number carries its conditions and a source, and the team separates demonstrated results from deployment claims more rigorously than most university teams.

**frameworks.** The headline model is a calibration-and-inverse-prediction framework rather than a mechanistic simulation, and it is unusually well executed. Image signals were defined explicitly before any fitting: colour response C = 1 - (G_pellet / G_white) from green-channel intensity measured in ImageJ on pellets photographed against a white tile, and fluorescence response F = R_pellet / R_background from red-channel intensity inside a light box, with the matched untreated control from the same run and timepoint subtracted (delta-C, delta-F) and no OD normalisation. They then fitted a log-linear model delta-S = A + b log10(c / 0.005 uM) with 0.005 uM chosen as the reference so A is directly interpretable, giving delta-C = 0.04363 + 0.07591 log10(c/0.005) and delta-F = 0.42290 + 1.08721 log10(c/0.005). Crucially, calibration and validation data were separated up front - 20 calibration measurements from four runs (2, 6, 8 and 13 October) and 10 held-out validation measurements from two further runs (14 and 15 October) for each readout, all at the four-hour timepoint across 0.005, 0.01, 0.03, 0.05 and 0.1 uM. The model was inverted to estimate unknown concentration, c-hat = 0.005 uM x 10^((delta-S - A)/b), and scored by RMSE on the held-out runs: approximately 0.0483 uM for colour and 0.0319 uM for fluorescence, with all numerical predictions included so that failures were not hidden (a 0.1 uM sample on 15 October was estimated at 0.246 uM by colour). On the hardware side they ran CAD-based dry-lab studies for a UV advanced-oxidation-process reactor, modelling fluid flow dynamics, UV photo-oxidation kinetics and lamp exposure times for both a batch quartz-tube reactor and a thin-layer millifluidic cassette, computing a residence time of 192.6 s and a modelled minimum-to-maximum light ratio of 92.2% across the 1 mm layer; the filter assembly was developed parametrically in OpenSCAD. Promoter selection also used in silico promoter-strength analysis, which predicted J23106 to be comparable to P429 and so added it as a comparison design.

**datascience.** The analysis is notable for publishing its own limitations as a work plan. They state that the pooled model does not separately estimate run-to-run variation, that the reported concentrations are point estimates with no uncertainty intervals, that no detection or quantification limit has been established, and that rounded signal values were used as fitting inputs. They then specify the fixes concretely: a random-intercept mixed model delta-S_ri = A + b log10(c_ri/0.005) + u_r + e_ri with run-specific slopes only if the data support them and with convergence and singularity checks; inverse-calibration intervals that distinguish prediction for a new run from prediction for a run containing a measured reference standard; a per-run intercept correction A_r = delta-S_standard,r - b log10(c_standard/0.005) estimated from a known standard run alongside every experiment; leave-one-run-out cross-validation over six folds with the warning that selecting and evaluating on the same cross-validation results produces optimistic estimates; and comparison of the local log-linear fit against a four-parameter logistic model if data across 0.001-5 uM becomes available. They also ran and reported an exploratory sensitivity check swapping calibration runs, and honestly noted that because the validation runs were examined during that comparison they no longer constitute a completely untouched final assessment. Results-page statistics use two-sided paired t-tests across five independent paired runs with explicit notice that p-values are unadjusted for the three readouts. Hardware performance was quantified the same way: automated water delivery gave a coefficient of variation of 1.95% against 7.41% across 10 manual syringe runs, drainage retained volumes of 0.28, 0.31 and 0.30 mL (mean ~0.30 mL, about 95% liquid recovery), and reducing tubing bore from 7 mm to 1 mm over a 10 cm segment was computed to cut geometric dead volume accordingly.

**dataviz.** Presentation is built around separating what was measured from what is assumed. Charts show individual run points alongside coloured means and error bars rather than only pooled summaries, the model page plots known versus estimated concentration against a dashed perfect-prediction line with out-of-calibration-range estimates marked separately, and tables consistently split 'experimental finding' from 'design goal' and 'prototype performance' from 'deployment claim'. Every figure caption states its conditions. The hardware readout itself is a data-visualisation artefact: Detection Unit V3.0 pairs a Hamamatsu C12880 miniature spectrometer (288-pixel detector, 340-850 nm, 12 nm typical FWHM) with two ESP32-S3-N16R8 microcontrollers driving a local TFT display and a Wi-Fi-connected web interface that shows the recorded spectrum and the raw signal at a user-selected target wavelength, with online data logging, registered devices, selected-wavelength trends and recorded runs reviewable on a phone or computer. A red/amber/green status display was added later, and the team deliberately separated device status, fluorescence reading, concentration estimate and safety judgement on screen so that a green operational light cannot be misread as 'this sample is safe'.

**software.** Open hardware and firmware rather than a bioinformatics tool. The Detection Unit CAD is published in Onshape (https://cad.onshape.com/documents/2228cb45d05bdbc67479791d) and the firmware and software at https://github.com/hkjssplkchc2026/mercurysense, containing ESP32 firmware, the C12880 spectrometer driver, acquisition instructions and Python/web monitoring software, with a live monitoring web app for reviewing spectra and runs. The Extraction Unit code is at https://github.com/davidlueng986-alt/MerMAID-Extraction-Unit. An itemised bill of materials is published with a ~USD 357 core-component subtotal (LED 2x 560 nm at USD 2.60, etc.), and the team states plainly that this overshot the USD 40 affordability target stakeholders had asked for. The detection unit went through four versions (AS7343 14-channel spectral sensor in a laser-cut acrylic box, to an opaque 3D-printed enclosure with recessed lid and adjustable optical mounts, to the C12880 spectrometer with interchangeable filters, fluid handling and web interface) and the extraction platform through three, with state-machine control sequences published for the water, soil and UV-AOP modules together with error-handling tests covering pump timeouts, watchdog recovery, soil-mass checks, stirring feedback, reagent availability and weighing faults. An educational browser game, 'Small Signal: a MerMAID field school', is published as a 3-5 minute pixel-art laboratory game in which players build a biological signal path, compare an unknown sample with its controls, and decide what the evidence supports - and is labelled a beta prototype whose educational effectiveness has not yet been evaluated. Repository: https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/hongkong-jss.

**ihp.** Human Practices ran on a stated operating principle - respond promptly to stakeholder feedback, and let it drive the next hardware revision - structured across four stages and a five-question cycle (Inspiration, Intercommunication, Investigation, Implementation, Impact) with the rule that each engagement must end in either a documented change or a documented reason for no change. There is also a five-tier Target User Prioritisation Pyramid which they explicitly label a working framework rather than a validated exposure ranking, and which puts underserved communities near suspected contamination sources such as informal e-waste processing sites above farmers, researchers, regulators and the general public. The traceable changes: the Drainage Services Department's guidance moved them off the chromoproteins used in earlier projects onto mRFP1e as a dual readout - visible colour for non-specialists plus a more sensitive fluorescence channel for quantification - and DSD, the Water Supplies Department and university researchers together pushed them to test lower concentrations, benchmark against international reference values, and assess cross-response to interfering heavy metals (hence the Cd2+/Pb2+/Zn2+ selectivity panel). Koo's Farm and local wet market vendors demanded numerical readings instead of qualitative colour indicators, which is the direct reason the AS7343 14-channel sensor was replaced by the wavelength-resolved Hamamatsu C12880 and why a numerical display and web readout exist. University professors said soil particulates must be removed before optical measurement and recommended a modular design, which produced the separate water, soil and planned organic-mercury extraction modules. Users reported excessive syringe force on the V1 filter stack (2 um pre-filter plus 0.45 um membrane), so manual syringe delivery was replaced by pump-driven dosing - measured as an improvement from 7.41% to 1.95% coefficient of variation. On-site trials at Blue Girl Organic Farm and Yeung Marine Products Limited with agricultural soil extracts, irrigation water and fish pond water (run without GM bacteria, since they could not legally be taken out of the lab) produced requests for clearer indicators and better protection against water and mud, answered with a red/amber/green status display, a reinforced housing, and maintenance access and modularity designed into the proposed V4.0. A second public survey combining street interviews with hands-on demonstrations for 195 people found 87.7% more confident that ordinary people could participate in checking soil and water safety and 84.1% finding the digital readout easy to understand - and the team immediately noted that perceived confidence and readability do not establish analytical accuracy, and separated device status from safety judgement in the interface as a direct result. More Happy Farm said plainly that not every farmer wants to own a device, which pushed them towards a service model. Throughout, they keep stating what their evidence does not cover: a response in a controlled biological assay does not establish accurate measurement in soil extracts, reliable operation of the complete device, or suitability for regulatory decisions.

**publicEngagement.** Nine targeted outreach events reaching over 2,400 participants, organised as an explicit four-tier framework. Tier 1 (primary students and parents, over 1,600 people) ran interactive Open Day and Information Day booths at Y.W.C.A. Hioe Tjo Yoeng College and Po Leung Kuk Celine Ho Yam Tong College with strawberry DNA extraction and live gel electrophoresis demonstrations. Tier 2 (over 730 secondary peers) covered Microbiology 101 for Grade 10 students on microbe handling, laboratory safety, cleanliness and contamination prevention, and a morning assembly for 700 Grade 7-12 students that framed synthetic biology through agricultural mercury contamination and explained how cellular components can be repurposed as logic gates and biosensors. Tier 3 is the most durable: a two-day Teacher Biotech Training Workshop for 30 local school teachers covering PCR and agarose gel electrophoresis, combined with a standing loan programme letting those teachers borrow DNA samples and laboratory equipment from the team - a deliberate attempt to leave teaching capacity behind after the competition ends. Tier 4 took the work into public and civic space: an exhibitor stand at InnoEX 2026, the international innovation and technology exhibition in Hong Kong, and a presentation alongside the Drainage Services Department at its Annual Media Briefing, which put the project on an official government webpage and into local news. They also ran a street interview with 30 members of the public specifically about a 'mercury-free' produce certification label, finding unanimous support for the idea, 14 people rating it very important for public health, 12 supporting it even at higher vegetable prices, 22 willing to buy certified produce at normal prices and 4 willing to pay extra - while also recording that 19 respondents remained somewhat or very worried about engineered bacteria leaking from the sealed device against only 8 who were not, a finding they published rather than buried. The browser game 'Small Signal' extends this by teaching the reasoning - compare the unknown against its controls, then decide what the evidence can support.

**realWorld.** The commercial concept is Certification-as-a-Service rather than instrument sales: farmers pay an annual subscription, the team visits to test soil on site with MerMAID, passing farms receive a 'Heavy Metal-Free' certificate and logo for supermarket packaging that lets them command a premium, and random surprise re-tests throughout the year (affordable precisely because the test is cheap and fast) guard the certificate's integrity. The plan is backed by a SWOT matrix, a competitor comparison against off-site laboratory testing (HKD 500+ per test, weeks of turnaround) and quick chemical test strips, and a five-step business plan naming AFCD, the Hong Kong Organic Resource Centre and premium supermarkets as the partners whose endorsement would make the certificate a standard. What lifts it above a typical student business plan is the case-study section: they analyse three real commercial analogues - Hygiena's reader-plus-consumables-plus-records model, SGS's accredited food-safety testing service, and Hong Kong's AFCD/VMO Accredited Farm Scheme - and draw out the uncomfortable implications, including that MerR-responsive bioavailable Hg(II) and a reference method's total-mercury result may be different measurands that cannot be assumed to agree just because both are labelled mercury, that a logo on packaging cannot replace a sample-to-report record tied to farm, location, date, sample ID and method scope, and that the full cost per valid result must include consumables, controls, staff time, storage, failed runs and waste handling. They state outright that the USD 350 build cost missed the USD 40 target, that the certification journey is a proposed direction, that the current prototype does not establish that any farm or product is heavy-metal-free, and that they claim no certification authority. Real-world constraints are acknowledged rather than wished away: engineered microbes cannot legally be placed in bins or taken into the field in Hong Kong, the on-site demonstrations therefore ran without GM bacteria, and the sub-five-minute loading and readout sequence is distinguished from the five hours of reporter expression the actual assay needs.

**給 GEMS：** Adopt their calibration discipline wholesale: split runs into calibration and validation before fitting anything, subtract a control from the same run and timepoint, invert the fit to predict unknowns, report RMSE on the held-out runs with the failures left in, flag out-of-range estimates, and then publish the statistical work you have not done yet (run-aware mixed model, inverse-calibration uncertainty intervals, leave-one-run-out cross-validation, a per-run reference standard) as a named plan. The second lesson is their teacher-capacity play - training 30 local teachers in PCR and gel electrophoresis and lending them the reagents and kit - which multiplies a school team's reach far more cheaply than any one-off workshop.

### UCAS-China — PARCEL
Undergrad · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/ucas-china/
PARCEL 是一個吸入式 mRNA 遞送平台，以類彈性蛋白多肽（ELP）而非脂質奈米顆粒構成。融合蛋白 ELP-Pum2-EEP13 以 Pum2 抓取 3' UTR 帶有 PRS 標籤的 mRNA，利用 ELP 的相分離把它包裹並保護起來，再以內體逃脫肽離開內體，並以 Sortase A 接合的抗 UPK1B scFv 鎖定呼吸道棒狀細胞（club cell）；所攜帶的貨物是 SLPI 的 mRNA（抑制嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶及其引發的黏液過度分泌），加上較低劑量的 IFN-lambda-1（抗病毒防禦與 Th2 抑制）。本專案獲得亞軍與 Best Integrated Human Practices，因為利害關係人工作真的導引了科學：臨床醫師把專案從急救治療轉向長期控制治療，而一位氣喘機制研究者則直接否決了兩個原始貨物之一。乾實驗室的完整度相當罕見，從 E. coli 生產、經霧化器氣霧沉積，一路模擬到以 FEV1 與 FeNO 表示的 PK-PD 讀值，每一個模組都餵給下一個。

**frameworks.** 六個相互連接的模組，共用參數並明確宣告輸入輸出關係。(1) 生產：以 SimBiology 建立一個群體感應自殺開關的 ODE 模型（LuxI/LuxRm A1 變異體，由 pLuxRm 驅動裂解），結合生長造成的稀釋與 AHL 動力學，掃過各個 Anderson 啟動子，找出恰好在 ELP 相變之前讓培養液裂解的那一個——這決定了濕實驗室使用的啟動子。(2) 組裝：以 AlphaFold 3 預測三個融合蛋白單體（1052-1322 個殘基），粗粒化為 Martini 3 並在 GROMACS 中以 298 K、1 bar、150 mM NaCl、50 mg/mL 蛋白濃度執行 2-3 微秒，並以 pLDDT 作為「穩定 Pum2 摺疊、同時保留 ELP 柔性」的依據；同時他們建立了 CAPE（Coverage and Assembly Prediction for Protein Ensembles），一個以濕實驗室資料校準的簡化自由能模型，並以 CAPE 為目標函數做貝氏最佳化，重新分配 Pum2 周圍的 ELP 重複單元，而不是暴力枚舉所有組合。(3) 肺部遞送：以 MPPD v3.04 在成人 Yeh-Schum 五肺葉幾何上，針對各肺葉最後三個傳導分支世代的沉積量，篩選對數常態的氣霧粒徑分布、流速與吸入體積；再以 ANSYS Fluent CFD 模擬三維呼吸道傳輸，接著餵入末端呼吸道與呼吸道表面液層的傳輸模型，以及一個參考細胞組成對映，把沉積量換算為每個棒狀細胞的表面接觸數。(4) 細胞內釋放：一個每個內體一顆粒的 ODE-隨機混合模型（中位粒徑 560 nm，每顆約 2,400 條融合蛋白鏈、因此有 2,400 份 EEP），追蹤酸化、ELP 解組裝、EEP 媒介的膜開孔與 RNA 降解，輸出隨時間變化的完整細胞質 RNA 量，並把完整 RNA 與螢光標記分開追蹤。(5) PK-PD：一個四區室模型（骨髓、血液、呼吸道壁、上皮襯液），含 25 個物種、53 條指派規則與 51 個反應，改編自 Gadkar 等人的重度氣喘免疫網路，產出四項臨床讀值——FeNO、FEV1、相對杯狀細胞數與 15 分鐘黏液素釋放量——用於比較 SLPI:IFN-lambda-1 的載量比與給藥頻率。(6) 反應預測：一個仿射對映的基線，加上以公開細胞激素擾動 scRNA-seq 訓練的殘差式 CellFlow（flow matching）。

**datascience.** 兩項具體工作。標靶篩選：他們以 Human Lung Cell Atlas 比較健康成人棒狀細胞與其他肺上皮細胞的倍數變化、校正後 p 值與偵測比例，從 68 個通過門檻的基因中選出 UPK1B——富集 2.28 倍、校正後 p = 0.00559，RNA 在 45.92% 的棒狀細胞中被偵測到，其他上皮細胞僅 3.43%。接著他們檢查抗體可及性（Human Surfaceome；UniProt O75841，260 個胺基酸，四個跨膜區，細胞外區段在 37-60 與 108-229）與跨組織選擇性（存檔的 GTEx：肺 0.11 TPM 對膀胱 21.90 TPM；Human Protein Atlas 顯示尿路上皮有膜上表現），並直言 UPK1B 並非棒狀細胞專屬，因此這份分析是在排序一個可供實驗的候選，而非證明選擇性標靶。反應預測的基準測試同樣誠實：仿射對映相較於「預測沒有變化」把平均表現量誤差降低 7.1%，也優於平均反應基線；而非線性的殘差 CellFlow 模型雖改善了部分平均表現量預測，卻使分布一致性與所選的 RNA panel 變差——因此他們保留仿射模型作為參考模型，並把跨捐贈者驗證與 RNA 重建列為未解問題。任務設定為在 GSE249307 與 GSE246368 上以捐贈者留出輪替，來源細胞與目標細胞未配對。

**dataviz.** 模型首頁一開始就是一段腳本化動畫，依序走過整個機制——E. coli 外殼充滿蛋白、裂解、蛋白鏈組裝成 PARCEL、顆粒進入支氣管、結合棒狀細胞受體、被內吞、解組裝、釋出 mRNA，而黏液每一輪下降一階——並附重播與跳過控制，在 JavaScript 關閉時還有純文字替代版本。AlphaFold 單體結構以互動檢視器嵌入，可依 pLDDT 與蛋白區域著色、並切換 cartoon/C-alpha 呈現，讓讀者直接看出為何 Pum2 被視為剛性、ELP 被視為柔性。wiki 另附字級控制（A-/預設/A+）以提升無障礙性。軟體方面，AeroEase Android 應用程式把裝置的原始時間戳轉成可展開卡片的總覽，含七日活動圖表與可依日期篩選的歷史紀錄；FeroEase 應用程式則即時繪出溫度、pH 與 OD600，並以下降趨勢偵測器標出收取時機。

**software.** 四項軟體產出。AeroEase 是霧化器的 Android 伴隨應用程式，透過 BLE 同步 ESP32-C3 按鈕的時間戳，採用帶檢查碼、session 與重複檢查的驗證握手、以手機校正時鐘，並且只有在資料持久儲存後才回覆確認；接著把這些資料呈現為本機儲存的用藥日誌，含每日與七日次數、依日期篩選的歷史、CSV 匯出，以及一個規則式的離線助理，不需任何雲端呼叫即可回答問題；團隊反覆強調這些紀錄記載的是裝置動作，而非實際遞送劑量或已確認的吸入。FeroEase 以 Flutter 撰寫，透過 Wi-Fi 監測兩階段發酵，提供溫度、pH、攪拌控制，以及一個 OD600 下降趨勢偵測器，用來判定一般實驗室發酵槽不會回報的裂解收取窗口。第三項是用於棒狀細胞標靶選擇的生物資訊管線。另有一個瀏覽器版益智遊戲支援教育活動。硬體方面：AeroEase 是建立在 ESP32-C3 上的可攜式振動篩網霧化器，具可充電電源、session 記錄、BLE、重力供液儲槽，以及在模組化 3D 列印外殼中實體隔開的液體與電子艙；FeroEase 則是一套 ESP32-S3 兩階段培養平台，具 pH 與溫度感測、受控加熱、馬達攪拌與穿透光 OD600 追蹤。製作資源與含原始碼取得方式的使用手冊都公開在 wiki 上。

**ihp.** 團隊把自己的循環形式化為 RCSF（Reflect-Connect-Share-Feedback），刻意與工程的 DBTL 循環平行，並讓專案走過九次有記錄的迭代，涉及六個明確界定社群（學界、醫療專業人員、產業、指導教師、病患與家屬、公眾）中的 20 位個人、團隊與機構，以及 44 位氣喘病患代表和 419 位從未滿 10 歲到 60 歲以上的公眾代表。每個社群在介紹時都說明他們是誰、知道什麼，以及為何他們的立場重要。改變具體且可追溯。王飛醫師的意見把專案從速效治療轉向氣喘長期控制治療，整個目標族群因此重設。研究呼吸道疾病機制的陳懷勇教授說明，在氣喘中許多棒狀細胞會分化為產生黏液的杯狀細胞——支持了從免疫細胞轉向呼吸道上皮的方向——並告訴他們兩個原始貨物之一的 NKX2-1 在發育期重要、但在成年期影響甚微，因此該基因被捨棄，由 SLPI 取代。劉平生教授對微脂體、LNP 與高分子載體限制的梳理，直接進入 ELP 載體的立論與蛋白序列設計。夏宇飛教授指出實驗設計中細微的缺陷，並帶他們走過標準的體內／體外驗證流程。前 iGEMer 曹耀中與他們就標靶專一性爭論過，而這正位於 UPK1B 抗體篩選的上游。研究科技倫理的黃小茹教授審閱了生物安全與生物倫理的規範。他們也就當地花粉與柳絮管理聯繫懷柔區園林綠化局，把專案扣回北京自身的法規（《森林法》實施辦法，2026 年 1 月 1 日生效）與觀察到的雷雨氣喘案例。涉及病患的工作都有明確的知情同意與隱私聲明，問卷也報告自身的人口組成（21 位已康復、21 位正在用藥、419 位未受影響）。團隊把自己的指導原則寫為「在地的人解決在地的問題」，而 HP 組的常態任務就是追蹤各子組的瓶頸，並把外部意見回灌到每一組。

**publicEngagement.** 教育是從團隊自己的臨床訪談與 461 人問卷中的兩項發現設計出來的：病患一覺得好轉就停藥，而家長因為害怕副作用而拒絕讓孩子開始用藥——因此目標變成服藥遵從性，而不只是知識認知。活動依受眾分層。對兒童：在懷柔區全國科普月市集（2026 年 9 月）設攤，辦生物主題遊戲，同時兼作問卷蒐集點；另提出一份「生命科學課堂」方案，針對懷柔區小學五、六年級學生，透過插畫與互動示範教授呼吸道結構，並以可下載 PDF 發布，讓其他隊伍也能照著做。對大學生：辦 iGEM 冬令營培訓新成員，實體課程教濕實驗（質體萃取、PCR、同源重組、蛋白質純化），線上則有乾實驗與建模組；還有一年一度、不限系所的「微生物繪畫」競賽作為招募漏斗——這項活動並未長出預期的菌落圖樣，團隊公開了三個原因（靜置懸浮液造成細胞沉降、塗盤密度不足、IPTG 誘導 EGFP 抑制生長），並藉此教參與者：負面結果是正常的，排除問題才是真功夫。對一般大眾：公眾科學日攤位，以及一個關於合成生物學與 iGEM 的瀏覽器益智遊戲。

**realWorld.** 創業部分是一份自我批判的商業評估，而不是推銷說詞。團隊直接寫明，PARCEL 的立論必須建立在明確未被滿足的需求之上，而不是技術新穎性，並在把 PARCEL 定位為非荷爾蒙、較低給藥頻率、模組化的長期控制選項之前，先列表比較吸入型皮質類固醇、支氣管擴張劑與生物製劑各自的優點與限制。SWOT 直指真正的弱點：遞送效率與表現持續時間只在 HEK293T 的體外系統中展示過，因此黏液、黏液纖毛清除、局部酵素與免疫吞噬都還沒處理；蛋白加 mRNA 的複合產品會讓 CMC 負擔倍增，橫跨 ELP 分子量、純度、雜質輪廓與相變行為，以及 mRNA 序列完整性與穩定性，再加上載量比、凝聚體特性、批次一致性與保存；團隊也列出自己不具備的專業（毒理、法規事務、臨床開發、智慧財產、市場准入）。機會同樣具體——模組化的 Pum2/PRS 標籤設計意味著換新貨物不需要新載體；中科院各所能提供他們缺少的分析能力；中國的醫保按療效付費試點，為能展示療效的療法提供了給付途徑。他們承諾在每個開發里程碑重新檢視這份 SWOT。

**給 GEMS：** 把 RCSF 循環學走：UCAS-China 讓人類實踐擁有和工程的 DBTL 一樣有名字、可重複的四步迴圈（Reflect、Connect、Share、Feedback），把每位利害關係人歸入六個社群之一並說明納入理由，然後展示了九次確實閉合的迭代——包括因為一位研究者說某基因在成年期沒有作用，就直接拿掉一個貨物基因。學校的研究單位在任何專案上都能跑這個迴圈；第二個教訓同樣便宜好學：公開失敗的部分，就像他們公開那場始終沒長起來的微生物繪畫活動，以及失敗的原因。

### Princeton — SymPleco: Making Precision Sequestration Sym-ple
Undergrad · United States · https://2026.igem.wiki/princeton/
SymPleco attacks a trade-off that runs through all remediation chemistry: activated carbon captures a lot but cannot tell similar molecules apart, while monoclonal antibodies bind precisely but need harsh pH or chaotropic salts to release and cannot be recovered or scaled. Princeton's answer is a filamentous M13 bacteriophage used as a programmable adsorbent: sortase A-mediated ligation staples engineered fusion proteins onto the N-terminus of every pVIII copy (making 'furry' phage that bypass classical display size limits), with pIII carrying a Cg-Defensin anchor for PLA filter attachment, a VHH7 nanobody for macrophage clearance, and an AsLOV2 optomonobody that holds cargo in the dark and lets go under 450 nm light. Because swapping the target means swapping only the displayed binder, the team paired it with SymPlify, a de novo binder design pipeline, so a new target does not wait on a new antibody. It won on foundational-advance logic: a genuinely modular chassis demonstrated across three deliberately unrelated applications (melanoma exosome sequestration, Parkinson's alpha-synuclein interception, microcystin/BPA water remediation), backed by an unusually self-critical ODE model and an IRB-approved patient engagement programme.

**frameworks.** Two distinct computational efforts. SymPlify is a de novo protein binder design pipeline that routes a target by type: a protein chain goes to BindCraft (AlphaFold2-multimer hallucination with gradient descent on logits through softmax, SolubleMPNN sequence design, AF2-monomer re-prediction as a deliberately harsh filter, then PyRosetta physical metrics for binding energy and surface hydrophobicity), while a small-molecule or macrocycle chain goes to RFdiffusion3 all-atom diffusion plus LigandMPNN (eight sequences per backbone) and an independent complex-prediction model. PeSTo supplies hotspot residue scoring, RDKit renders structures and finds pharmacophores, and freesasa computes hydrophobic patch fraction. Separately, the measurement work is backed by a mechanistic ODE model of the recursive Phage Jumpstart Assay (jumpstart.py, jumpstart_mechanistic.py, passage.py, phase2.py, recursion.py) tracking naive, infected and free-particle pools with superinfection exclusion (sigma = 0.05), saturating infection, carrying capacity, and a hybrid-coat infectivity a_h derived from real pIII gene dosage (a_h ~0.729 at m13ko7_copies=20); the 1:11 passage step samples each particle pool by Poisson rather than plain division so a lineage can genuinely go extinct.

**datascience.** The Jumpstart assay turned a single colony-ratio readout into a trajectory: because each recursion is both a manipulation and a measurement, repeated rounds on a population being driven toward one genotype reveal behaviour a single ratio cannot. Statistics are handled carefully — intervals bootstrap over wells, leave-one-well-out checks are reported, panels yielding 0-2 Amp colonies out of 165-272 are reported as upper bounds rather than measurements, and a chi-square test (197 on 5 df) establishes that the six Run B constructs are not interchangeable while the team explicitly declines to lean on the ordering because the bottom four are indistinguishable from zero. They also report that three magnitude-based titer estimators disagreed by up to 20,000-fold on the same panel, which is why they built a ratio readout instead. Most notably the model documents its own error history: an initial m13ko7_copies=200 was simply the wrong figure (wild-type M13 rolling-circle copy number rather than M13KO7's actual p15A-driven one), corrected to 10 and then 20 as evidence improved, with the admission that the corrected model is more parameter-sensitive, not less.

**dataviz.** SymPlify's web interface is the visualisation centrepiece: an RDKit 3D viewer colours the target by PeSTo binding probability, lists top hotspot residues with confidence scores, lets the user delete low-scoring ones with an x to tighten the patch, and recomputes the difficulty breakdown (spread, hydrophobic surface fraction, globularity) live as the selection changes — plus a warning when residues sit more than 30 A apart, because one binder cannot reach them all. A run-status page shows pipeline stage, target type, elapsed time, auto-resubmits, design count and job ID, and a final ranking screen lets the user click through designs and download .pdb files with or without GS linkers. The model page is unusually transparent as data presentation: it prints the full command reference, labels every parameter as measured, derived or assumed, and ranks assumptions by their sensitivity on the round-2 plate ratio.

**software.** SymPlify, an integrated de novo binder design pipeline with a web interface, hotspot prediction, cluster job submission with auto-resubmission, and post-design filtering and ranking; released for the wider synthetic biology community and wet-lab tested on the team's own targets. Team repository: https://github.com/dianalluu/puigem2026, with an AlphaFold deployment for the Princeton Della cluster at https://github.com/09aaronl/alphafold_princeton-della. The ODE model ships as a Python package with 52 automated checks in test_model.py (~80 s full run, ~8 s in fast mode) covering mass-balance and neutrality invariants, the hybrid-coat gene-dosage derivation, the Poisson passage statistics and pinned regression values. Hardware: a 3D-printed PLA gyroid biofilter cartridge whose two winning PITCCH designs are published as downloadable source STEP assemblies.

**ihp.** This is the strongest documented chain of design changes of any team here, and several of them cut capability rather than adding it. Dr Bowen Jing's technical advice seeded SymPlify and his steric clash filter was adopted, but the team then cut AlphaFold3 from the pipeline entirely because Dr Martin Pacesa argued it often mispredicts binding sites; Pacesa also supplied PeSTo as the hotspot engine and, after the team ran competing designs to compare, AF2 monomer was implemented on his side of the argument. Dr Reynold Panettieri talked them out of sequestering IL-6 — their original software benchmark target — by pointing out IL-6's dual-sided effects on blood cell production and T-cell regulation, redirecting them toward a niche where cheaper-than-mAb production is the real advantage and toward naming one indication and working from there, which is exactly how the final applications are framed. Dr Douglas Galasko's distinction between biomarkers and toxins moved them off amyloid-beta for Alzheimer's and into the Parkinson's and rabies work. Two multiple myeloma patients, interviewed under Princeton IRB Protocol #20003, independently said the word 'virus' for a bacteriophage was a problem — one noting roughly 80% of myeloma patients are treated in community settings and take their doctor's word — which changed how the team describes the project in all outreach. A former FDA biologics deputy director, Dr Celia Witten, pointed them to CBER's phage therapy work; EPA Office of Pesticide Programs and OPPT staff sent them to the statutes; and marine microbiologist Dr Stephen Giovannoni plus phage ecologist Prof Forest Rohwer turned the Cg-Defensin antimicrobial worry into a specific planned avidity-comparison assay. Dr John Wnek, who conserves Diamondback terrapins, chose their environmental targets: microcystins and BPA, because nearby New Jersey plants discharge effluent half a mile offshore with no process for xenobiotics.

**publicEngagement.** PITCCH, the Princeton iGEM Team CAD Competition for Hardware, is the standout: entrants were given a real open engineering problem from the project — design a 3D-printable gyroid biofilter, 20 mm diameter by 25 mm height, maximising contact surface area — along with the team's actual print parameters. It ran free, fully asynchronous and online in a junior division (grades 5-12) and an open division (18+), explicitly permitted responsible AI use, and drew 42 registered submissions from the United States, United Kingdom and Mexico, of which 26 passed dimensional and printability screening before being sliced and computationally ranked by total surface area. Announcement emails went to thousands more via high school superintendents, undergraduate engineering directors and makerspaces, each carrying a project description and iGEM links. The team frames it as citizen science and backed that framing with credit: two winning designs appear on the wiki with the designers named on the attribution form, and the registration terms stated plainly that the team reserves the right to draw inspiration from submissions with attribution. They also postered at symposiums and presented at bioethics exchanges, and at the US-China iGEM Human Practices Summit showed their halted immunology work as a case study in how to pivot.

**realWorld.** The regulatory path is mapped rather than asserted: phage therapy under FDA CBER for the clinical arms, and statute-level grounding for the environmental arm after meetings with EPA Office of Pesticide Programs and Office of Pollution Prevention and Toxics, with the team careful to state that nothing should be read as EPA guidance. Containment is designed for deployment — the phage stays inside a closed water treatment facility bound to a biodegradable PLA filter so it is retrievable and localised, with macrophage clearance via VHH7 as the biosafety route for therapeutic use. The commercial argument is reconfiguration cost: because capture specificity lives in one genetic part on pVIII, changing target means changing that part and not the media, housing, attachment chemistry or capital cycle, which is the case made against granular activated carbon for PFAS where GAC retains poorly over realistic service lifetimes. Work is mapped to SDG 3.4, 6.3 and 9. Continuation is concrete: further IRB submissions to interview melanoma patients and Parkinson's patients and caregivers, the Rohwer avidity assay, qPCR of M13KO7 copy number to settle the model's most sensitive parameter, and phage hydrogels as an alternative anchor that would remove the Cg-Defensin concern altogether.

**給 GEMS：** Copy PITCCH: hand the public a genuine, unsolved sub-problem from your own project with real constraints and real print parameters, judge entries computationally on a single objective metric, then credit the winners by name and actually build their design in. It converts outreach into contributed engineering at almost no cost, and it works for high-school students because spatial creativity, not synthetic biology training, is what the task rewards. Pair it with Princeton's habit of writing down which model parameters are measured, derived or merely assumed — and publishing the history of their own corrected mistakes — which is the cheapest credibility a student dry lab can buy.

### GEMS-Taiwan — ReLEAF
High School · Taiwan · https://2026.igem.wiki/gems-taiwan/
ReLEAF 把整件事做成一個閉環：田間感測器與氣象預報餵給逆境指數模型，模型決定綠光劑量，綠光驅動 Bacillus subtilis WB800 中來自藍綠菌的 CcaSR 雙組分系統，菌體再把 ACC deaminase 分泌到中空纖維灌流式生物反應器裡——蛋白質可以出去，菌留在裡面。整台機器約 40 x 24 x 62 cm，設計上就是要擺在台灣小農的稻田旁；台灣農業經營者平均年齡 63.8 歲，精準農業對他們本來遙不可及。這個專案幾乎囊括高中組的技術類獎項（Measurement、Hardware、Integrated Human Practices），主要靠的是來源標註的紀律：四台自製裝置都附有釋出版組裝手冊；數位孿生在光度計徹底失效前 26.7 小時就抓到它正在壞；一份預先登錄的生長預測被後來的實驗實際評分；還有一份輸入明細帳，把每個數字標明是自己量的、引用的，還是模型算的。它最特別的品質是誠實——wiki 一再撤回自己先前的主張，而這也正是乾實驗弱點看得見的地方。

**frameworks.** 共四條線。(1) 擬合出來的作物逆境指數：他們沒有憑專家判斷去給溫度、水分與光照配權重，而是拿台灣自己的收穫紀錄來擬合——農糧署 25 年的各縣市稻作產量，對上 ERA5 逐日再分析氣象資料（2001-2025），把低於縣市趨勢的期作視為逆境期作，並在保留年份上窮舉評分十五個候選逆境項的全部 2^15 - 1 = 32,767 種組合。一期與二期稻作分別擬合；二期要付的代價是風、光與時機不對的水分，而這三項進去之後，熱逆境再加也沒有貢獻——wiki 自己指出，這一點削弱了濕實驗的熱逆境主軸。2016-2025 年的縣市誤差為 365 kg/ha，單純趨勢線則是 419（二期稻作誤差降低 32%）。真正前瞻性的檢驗在 2026 年 9 月 26 日、任何縣市公布數據之前就封存；十六個縣市中有四個已回報，誤差 7.9%，趨勢線為 8.8%，團隊也正確地說這太少，還不足以確立效能。(2) 蛋白質設計（GRAFT 方法論：Generate、Restraints、Assembly、Flex、Triage）在任何選殖之前就先選定並調整了三種保護蛋白——BoPEP4（23 個胺基酸的 Brassica oleracea 植物誘導胜肽，與 PEPR1 受體進行分子對接，並跑了九條全原子分子動力學軌跡）、LEA14（151 個胺基酸的晚期胚胎發育豐富蛋白，五種 N 端 His 構築體，其中一個借用了 K-segment 膜結合模體，以 GGGGS 連接子接上）與 ACC deaminase。最突出的發現都是負面的，而且及時被攔下來：一個先前每道檢查都放行的 C 端 6xHis 純化標籤，在模擬中被證明會蓋住形成該胜肽最強受體接觸的化學基團，於是標籤改到 N 端；Asn23 的夾持被發現是五個接觸，而不是一個鹽橋；截短系列指出 9-23 是生產用長度（質量少 33%），其中 7-23 的夾持在 98.5% 的幀中維持，再短一階則只有 77.1%；而一道在結果出來之前就設好的 AlphaFold 信心門檻，LEA14 與其夥伴蛋白並未通過，於是依先前的約定，沒有任何結構被往下傳。至於 ACC deaminase，一個突變體都沒有訂，因為模型顯示這個酵素實際遇到的受質遠少於它處理得來的量，而可取得的最大增益是改變環境介質（質外體 pH 5.5，此時 Glu12-His227 接觸在 99.9% 的幀中維持）。(3) 反應器數位孿生：用一次 434 小時實驗中健康的前 120 小時訓練自編碼器，並把感測軸（參考光束，從不穿過培養液）與製程軸（比生長速率）分開評分，因此能區分是培養事件還是儀器故障；另有 Kalman 濾波器批次預測器，以及由光照板擬合出的 logistic 成長先驗。(4) 劑量與機隊模型：一條從培養皿上的毫升數一路算到每公頃美元的算術帳，以及一條畫滿整個效力軸的回收期曲線。

**datascience.** 有三項做法讓這份乾實驗明顯高於一般高中水準。第一是預先登錄：10 月 1 日、在任何 WB800 生物反應器實驗之前，他們就登錄了比生長速率 0.2986 h^-1、90% 區間 0.2705-0.3300、logistic 曲線形狀與 15% 的 NRMSE 通過門檻，以及依接種量而定的到 OD 0.5 時間，並寫明通過標準。第 6 次實驗得到 0.286 +/- 0.010 h^-1（R2 0.978），落在區間內；曲線形狀這個端點被記為未評分，因為先驗在前七小時低估了 30%，而實驗在第 7 小時之前就超過先驗的上限。第 7 次實驗被明確排除在評分之外，因為它三小時的遲滯期在登錄的 logistic 模型裡沒有對應項，而擬合速率會隨視窗選擇在 0.16-0.46 h^-1 之間擺動。第二是帶診斷切分的異常偵測：自編碼器在 216.3 小時就標記光度計異常，比 OD 通道在 243.0 小時失效早了 26.7 小時，而視窗表顯示漂移期間感測軸是 100% 警報、製程軸是 0%——這個模型指出的是哪個子系統壞了，而不只是「有東西不對」。第三是預測要和持續性基線比，而不是不比：Kalman 濾波器在 9 月那次實驗的 2 小時預測比不變基線好 41%，在第 7 次實驗的 8 與 12 小時預測好 24%，全域線性、指數與局部線性等替代方案都被列為落敗者，並誠實加註：實驗大部分時間都在光度計的線性範圍之上，所以模型預測的是讀值，不是生物量。其他量測工作：線上光度計與桌上型 BioDrop 在 OD 1.2 以內的對應斜率為 1.018（R2 0.995），依據 45 組配對 TiO2 點與一份以 2.5 mg 為階的 iGEM 二氧化矽協議，稀釋後再回復的測試誤差落在 0.2% 之內；由壓力感測器與流量計分別算出的管壁剪應力一致到 2.8%，兩個感測器互為查核；葉面感測器的實驗桌特性化在 540 組配對讀值中發現，相對於空氣參考值有 +0.47 到 +1.71 degC、隨位置而異的偏移，並明白寫出結論：1.2-1.9 degC 的偏差足以隱藏或憑空製造出數位孿生要據以行動的那個水分逆境訊號。團隊自己列出的乾實驗弱點：分泌活性 7.25 mU/mL 只有 n = 1，而且低於定量極限；兩次誘導實驗對活性在數小時內變化的正負號彼此矛盾；已發表的 CcaSR Hill 曲線（Castillo-Hair 等人，2019）被假設在 20 L 規模仍成立，但每次誘導都只跑單一光強度，所以根本沒有東西在檢驗它；稻作冠層校正係數 x2.44 是模型算的、不是量的，範圍落在 1.68-3.52；最低有效劑量未知，因為噴施實驗變動了鹽度與時機，卻從未變動施用量；一個已撤回的效力係數 0.58；以及 25 個模擬期作中只有 17 個曾越過啟動門檻，所以十台機組的機隊一年只運作 4.3% 的日子。

**dataviz.** 這個 wiki 的標誌性手法是用顏色標示資料來源。M4 劑量帳被畫成一條自上而下的單一鏈條，從 10 cm 培養皿上的 1.67 mL 一路到每公頃 US$3800 的資本支出，左側有一條軌道：只要每一列仍站在量測之上就是綠色，到了稻作冠層校正那一列轉為琥珀色，讀者因此能清楚看見量測在哪裡結束、模型從哪裡開始；下方各列繼承這個模型，其中兩列還各自加上自己的假設。每一項模型輸入都列表標註來源欄（七項出自自己的實驗桌、四項公開紀錄、兩項已發表常數、一項來自 Geospatial Analysis、一項既沒量也沒引用），五條假設則各有一張「什麼建立在它之上」與「什麼會推翻它」的表。一張時序圖把中央氣象署三天的預報時程、植物組跑的三條到達時間臂，以及 5.4 天的反應器前置時間疊在同一條「距逆境天數」軸上，用看的就知道它們對不起來。三次互相矛盾的時序實驗並排呈現，第三格把第二格自己的管子改以總葉綠素而非每克葉綠素重新解讀，排序因此明顯翻轉——這張圖是在反駁團隊自己先前的主張。衰減圖把兩種可能的解讀都畫過同一個 28 小時讀值，並標出 22 倍的分歧（「單一端點說不出的事」）。回收期圖把自己算出的「效力為 1 時 68 年」那一點，和 Geospatial Analysis 的 4.9 年估計放在同一條軸上，並直接點名這個分歧，而不是藏起來。數位孿生介面本身把光密度、pH、四路壓力曲線以及泵與閥的控制放在同一個畫面；專案描述頁一開頭就是一張七區塊的互動系統圖，以及一張以縣市夜間溫度著色、圓圈大小依稻作產量趨勢縮放的 GIS 分級著色圖。

**software.** 數位孿生以 MIT 授權釋出於 https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/gems-taiwan/digital-twin。它讀取反應器迴路的即時 OD600、pH、四路壓力通道與渦輪流量，驅動一個夾管閥與四個 Luer 閥，執行自編碼器感測警報與 Kalman 批次預測，透過水力模型計算管腔壓降、跨膜壓與積垢比，並套用 BLASTAM 稻熱病感染規則（葉面在平均 22-25 degC 下保持潤濕至少 10 小時才算一個濕潤期，低於 15 degC 或高於 25 degC 不發生感染，過去的時數取自感測器，未來的時數則在相對濕度 90% 時估為潤濕），以提醒農民在五到十天後去找病斑。團隊很清楚講出哪些還沒接起來：綠光誘導測過但尚未整合、溶氧校正撐不住、保護蛋白的量無法線上讀取而要靠人工取樣的 ELISA 與 DNPH、而且到目前為止每個模型都是在實驗結束後跑錄下來的資料、每個決策都由人做——所以老實說它是一個正朝數位孿生前進的「數位影子」。四台開源硬體裝置都附組裝手冊與列印檔：中空纖維灌流式生物反應器（10 頁組裝指南、17 頁產品說明、16 頁使用手冊）、Pro 與 Slim 兩款線上光度計（12 頁與 13 頁指南），以及 24 管雙波長光照板裝置（10 頁指南），另有一塊 13 個種子位的浮動水耕板、一份涵蓋 2026 年 3 月 23 日至 10 月 17 日的 6.5 MB 硬體筆記本，以及一套以 LLM 輔助、涵蓋 346 個農業鄉鎮的 QGIS 地理空間工作流程，連資料整備用的提示詞都公開。其他貢獻還包括：五個 SubtiToolKit Golden Gate 模組共 35 個 Registry 元件、一份 15 頁的植物實驗協議、把 ACC deaminase 的 DNPH 活性分析縮小二十倍搬到 96 孔盤，以及廢棄培養基協議（乾草、豆渣與甘蔗萃取液，以 LB 為對照基準）。

**ihp.** 七個月內 31 位利害關係人，整理成一張分四階段、標明日期的專案演進圖，另有四條主題式專家管道（佈署、保護蛋白設計、植物與逆境生物學、生物反應器與硬體），並與五位核心專家持續往來。決定性的轉變發生在最開頭：最初的設計是把工程改造的 Bacillus subtilis 釋放到土壤裡，用 DesK-DesR 系統直接感測溫度。Chen Wen-Liang 教授（4 月 10 日）與生物製程專家指出兩件事錯了——細菌無法被圍堵，而生物式感測既不夠精準也不夠可控——於是感測從細胞內搬到體外的電子感測器與 AIoT 模型，並做出中空纖維灌流式生物反應器，把細菌留住、讓保護蛋白出去。那一場對話就決定了整個架構。其他有清楚前後對照的改變：Dr. Paul Verslues（中央研究院，4 月 3 日）指出直接供給純脯胺酸效率不佳，還可能抑制植物自身的 P5CS1 生合成與脯胺酸氧化還原平衡，於是他們放棄遞送脯胺酸，改採以細菌訊號與前驅物調節植物的架構，從逆境復原轉向早期偵測，並把成果指標改以根部生長與生物量重新評分。Dr. Elizabeth Sattely（Stanford，6 月 27 日）告訴他們概念驗證鋪得太廣，應該把一種逆境做得很好，而不是多種都做得很淺，並建議去看胜肽——這就是 BoPEP4 進入候選名單、植物測試收斂到熱逆境與鹽害的原因。CH Biotech（7 月 9 日）推動他們用計算篩選來最佳化保護蛋白、比較根部灌注、葉面噴施與無人機噴灑、計算每單位面積的生產成本，並在行動前先做台灣的法規研究。Huang Chieh-Chen 教授（中興大學，7 月 28 日與 8 月 6 日）把反應器從連續操作改為週期操作、提出在苗期施用、警告保護蛋白濃度過高會傷害植物因此門檻必須驗證，並提供了這個專案現在使用的 B. subtilis WB800 菌株。Cheng Mei-Chun 教授（8 月 28 日）發現植株年齡與處理條件不一致，意味著早期結果反映的可能是非預期的逆境而不是處理效果，團隊因此標準化了實驗協議。Yes Health iFarm（8 月 11 日）促使他們重新考慮把 8/16 光週期改為 12/12、把溶氧與 OD 納入參數規劃、從純氧改為溫和通氣，並盡量減少移植，因為移植本身就是一種逆境。最有意思的是自然農法這條線：9 月 5 日與 Green Media 共同主辦的公開論壇上，Dr. Li Hsu-Ying 與陳女士主張，一株被保護到完全沒有逆境的植物永遠建立不起耐受性——「養作物就像養小孩」。團隊沒有打發掉這個意見，而是把它變成 M1 的規格：反應器只有在一個真正反映作物狀態的門檻被跨越時才該啟動，這也正是那 32% 誤差降低之所以重要的原因——它是釋放規則的證據，而不只是一個數字。同一場論壇上有位農民問這套系統會不會破壞有機認證；團隊去查了法規，結論是它不能用在有機農場，接著訪談蘭陽溪友善耕作生產合作社的 Chen Ke-Wei 先生，釐清這在商業上意味著什麼。這個專案最初的問題，來自迦納農民，經由 Ubuntu Social Enterprise Ghana 的 Gilbert Nkpeniyeng 轉達（2 月 1 日）。

**publicEngagement.** 5 所學校、140 位學生，課程按國小、國中與高中分層設計，每個群組都做課前與課後 Kahoot 問卷，結果以逐題正確率圖表公開——包括失敗的部分，例如 DNA 鹼基配對只有 30% 的學生答對。所有材料都放在專門的教育網站上免費下載：三份教案、三份簡報、兩款卡牌遊戲、兩款線上遊戲與一個植物逆境模擬器（CropShield），目標明確寫著要讓這些課程在團隊不在現場時也能運作。實作活動包括植物逆境實驗、做盆器、ATCG 卡牌遊戲與單字練習。團隊也為了誠實而修掉自己的說法——wiki 上留有一則可見的註記，記錄刪去「進步 49 分」的主張與和「標準教學法」的比較，並把學生人數從 144 更正為 140。另外還有一條台灣特有的互動管道：一個名為「農友助手」的 LINE 官方帳號，共六項功能——最新消息、產品介紹、作物逆境警示、以鹽害、熱逆境與蟲害等關鍵詞觸發的作物小幫手 AI 聊天機器人、使用者可張貼天氣、作物照片、土壤含水量與蟲害狀況並賺取可兌換 LINE 貼圖的點數的「農友日誌」，以及一條 Google 表單回饋迴路——會做這個，是因為在農業博覽會以及與陳慧文女士的訪談中發現，小農根本接觸不到網路上早就存在的資訊。2026 年 9 月 5 日在台北水花園有機農夫市集辦的公開活動（台灣咖啡 x 可可冰淇淋節）吸引超過 400 位到訪者、超過 200 位報名參與者，內容有一場論壇、含資料實體化裝置與套圈圈的攤位活動，以及一場植物逆境活動。

**realWorld.** 定位是社會企業，願景為「讓每一位農民都是生物製造者」，透過農民團體與試點合作社佈署，而非直接銷售，因為機隊分析顯示單一農場自己擁有一台反應器，大半個產季都在閒置。MVP 逐項估價：現行生物反應器 US$2280、葉面濕度感測器 US$125、一個 US$90 的密封式菌體卡匣（放到位後自動開啟，所以沒有人需要接觸開放的培養液），以及一個 Field Console 手機應用程式；資本支出約為每公頃 US$3800，不含補充、維修與人力。法規目標是在 2027 年 10 月前取得台灣封閉系統使用的答案；團隊和 Wu Tzu-Hsien 主任（10 月 12 日）一起走這條路徑，對方指出他們的成本模型漏掉廠房、人力、菌體培養與廢棄物管理成本，另與 Chang Hung-Hao 教授（8 月 31 日）討論，對方要他們把初期應用收斂到特定逆境與特定作物。在 BIO Asia-Taiwan 與 Bioeconomy Corporation 的一次對話，把擴張研究的方向轉往東南亞——那裡農業部門規模大，GMO 規範也比美國或歐盟寬鬆。Smart Agriweek Taiwan 指出青農才是現實中的早期採用者，並提醒年長農民需要另一套說服路徑。SWOT 與 PESTLE 分析把真正的威脅講得很白：無細胞農業生物製劑的法規定位不明，可能卡在生物農藥與合成生物學衍生化合物之間；保護蛋白會被沖走；生物積垢會降低產出；以及到 2024 年台灣只有 3.47% 的農地屬有機或友善耕作——這既限制也形塑了市場。回收期分析是整個 wiki 上商業上最誠實的一塊：以他們自己每公頃每期作 US$138 的損失數字來算，效力軸上沒有任何一點能在有用的時間尺度內回收資本——即使效力完美也要 68 年——而 Geospatial Analysis 以每期作 US$1931 的淨效益算出 4.9 年，團隊明白寫出這兩者定價的並不是同一公頃土地，而不是悄悄採用那個好看的數字。交付成果包括一份 85 頁的營運計畫書、一份對農民友善的使用手冊，以及三份生物反應器文件。

**給 GEMS：** 可以帶走的資產是來源標註的紀律，而它比看起來便宜得多：把模型裡每個數字標成「我們量的」、「引用的」或「模型算的」；公開一份假設清單，逐條寫出什麼情況會推翻這一步；當自己的兩次實驗互相矛盾時，兩筆都放出來並指出矛盾，而不是挑那個好看的。再搭配一項預先登錄、有日期戳記的預測，並由後續實驗實際評分——GEMS-Taiwan 登錄的生長速率是整個 wiki 上可信度最高的一項，而它的成本只是在資料出現之前先把話寫下來。

### Cornell — Klothos
Undergrad · United States · https://2026.igem.wiki/cornell/
今天市面上每一種疤痕療法都是在疤痕形成之後才開始——矽膠片、病灶內類固醇注射、雷射與植皮，全都是被動或反應式的，沒有一種在癒合的關鍵時間窗內處理纖維化的生物學。Klothos 改在癒合過程中介入：工程改造的細菌分泌 810A，一段 12 個胺基酸的胜肽，會結合 CTGF（CCN2）暴露出來的 C 端結構域，阻斷纖維母細胞轉為肌纖維母細胞的活化；而其表現被關在一個以 Pseudomonas syringae 的 hrpR/hrpS/hrpL 系統建成的雙輸入 AND 邏輯閘之後，因此只有在活性氧（經 TrxC）與缺氧（經 Pfnr）同時存在時才會製造胜肽——那正是重塑失控的特徵。細菌被包覆在海藻酸鈉/PEO 奈米纖維基質中，而這層基質是用團隊自行設計並製作的同軸靜電紡絲機紡出來的，因為市售機器的價格遠超大學部團隊能負擔的範圍。他們憑著這台開源、可拆平收納、設有安全互鎖的靜電紡絲機，加上一個模組化的 3D 列印同軸噴絲頭轉接件，拿下 Best Hardware 與 Best Presentation；又以一個從頭到尾罕見完整的專案拿下 Best Fashion & Cosmetics：20 多項標定風險等級的商業化分析、一條六階段的 FDA 路徑，以及一套真正圍繞著帶著疤痕生活的人所建立的人類實踐計畫。

**frameworks.** Cornell 的建模清楚分成濕實驗與產品開發兩塊。生物學這側：一條描述 SUMO-His-810A 相對於生物量累積的生產—降解 ODE（dF/dt = alpha*X - delta_F*F）；一條描述 Tet 與未來誘導型啟動子活性的 Hill 函數；SUMO 蛋白酶切割以回收活性胜肽的 Michaelis-Menten 動力學；一條以 ELISA 為基礎、描述 810A 對 CTGF/C 結合的 Hill-Langmuir 結合等溫線，因為只有單一結合位而把 n 固定為 1，並明確註記若擬合出的 n 遠離 1，代表的是誤差而不是協同性；以及一個二次式的配體耗竭模型，用於可接觸的 CTGF 與胜肽濃度相當、普通 Langmuir 假設失效的情形。在結合之後的下游，他們建了一個纖維母細胞狀態轉換的降階動態系統模型，參數取自在 STRING v12.5 組成的蛋白質交互作用網路——以 Scarring 的 Human Phenotype Ontology 詞條 HP:0100699 過濾，取得 48 條加權邊，再與 CCN2 最近的 20 個一階鄰點與 10 個二階鄰點合併，浮現出 SMAD3、FN1 與 TGFB2 等主要節點。這些節點與權重接著在 Netflux 中以基於邏輯的 ODE 網路執行（帶時間常數的正規化節點活性、修改過的 Hill 活化與抑制函數），以 COL1A1 的累積作為細胞外基質硬化的替代指標，模擬並追蹤 Xiao 等人 2020 年報告的下游 TGF-beta 抑制。傷口環境也有明確建模：ROS 以一個暫態峰值函數描述，並以 Carney 等人 2019 年在肥厚性疤痕中對 SOD1、MGST1 與 PRDX6 的時間序列 qRT-PCR 校準；氧氣則用指數回復函數，兩者各自餵進一個 Hill 函數型啟動子。AlphaFold 則用來呈現 810A 以及 CTGF/C-810A-6xHis 複合體。硬體這側：一個半經驗預測器，用來推估殼層溶液的黏度（以 Mark-Houwink 處理高分子重疊與糾纏統計）、導電度（可動離子貢獻）與表面張力（界面活性劑吸附，帶 CMC/CAC 平台），加上由流率、射流電流與表面張力推出終端射流半徑的 Fridrikh 標度律，以及基於連續方程的流率與步進馬達推桿速度模型。

**datascience.** 那個分類器是把資料變成預測工具最清楚的例子：Cornell 不是買了溶液再去量，而是從配方輸入（海藻酸鈉濃度、PEO 濃度與分子量、界面活性劑種類與濃度、鹽或緩衝液含量、溫度）預測黏度、導電度與表面張力，再用預測結果避開不可能成功的紡絲實驗。他們指名候選做法——邏輯斯迴歸、隨機森林或高斯過程分類——並在小資料集上偏好高斯過程，因為它會回報不確定性；也定義了兩層驗證計畫：性質層（黏度看平均絕對誤差、導電度看百分比誤差、表面張力看 mN/m 的絕對誤差，對照保留的實測配方）與結果層（被預測為綠色的配方是否真的紡出穩定的純殼層纖維，依 Taylor 錐形成、電流穩定性、珠狀缺陷、乾燥沉積與纖維直徑分佈判定）。他們直說分類結果比精確數值準確度更重要，也直說文獻上的 Mark-Houwink、CMC 與吸附常數只是起始估計值，要用團隊自己的量測重新校準。纖維形態以影像分析量化：彎曲度定義為纖維輪廓長度與端到端距離之比，以 >1.10 為「捲曲」門檻，結果是 8% 捲曲、92% 平直。失敗診斷同樣由模型驅動——液滴破碎被追溯到 100 kDa 下 PEO 鏈糾纏不足，因此他們把 PEO 從 1.5% 提高到 2%，並減少 PS80 界面活性劑。

**dataviz.** 最突出的是 Unified Readiness Classifier：它把三項各自獨立的性質預測收斂成一個綠/黃/紅的判斷，決定某個配方到底該不該送上靜電紡絲機——綠色代表可進入電壓窗測試，黃色允許一次短時間試紡或小幅調整配方，紅色代表先重新配方再說。它畫成一張以蒙地卡羅取樣對照文獻結果、橫跨海藻酸鈉與 PEO 重量百分比的可紡性等高線圖，讀者因此是看到可紡區域，而不是去讀一張數字表。海藻酸鈉分子量的分析框架也同樣好：同一張圖把跨越四個數量級以上的黏度放在左軸，而導電度與表面張力放在右軸且維持平坦，整個論點一眼就看得出來——導電度決定海藻酸鈉最多能溶多少、分子量決定那個上限是否達得到，而最佳點落在中間而非單調方向上。STRING 網路以力導向佈局呈現，Netflux 的執行結果則把 CTGF、TGFB1、FN1、COL1A1、SMAD2 與 SMAD3 的正規化活性曲線畫在一起。wiki 本身是一段由捲動驅動的 3D 島嶼旅程（「捲動前進，點島探索」），帶有一個互動式 AND 閘元件讓讀者自行開關兩路輸入訊號，以及一個靜電紡絲機的 WebGL 模型。

**software.** 沒有獨立的軟體釋出；真正釋出的成果是硬體。靜電紡絲機以材料清單、CAD 檔、電路圖、組裝文件、操作手冊與一本專門的安全手冊公開，並刻意設計成可拆解、可平板化收納，方便在共用或臨時工作空間裡的團隊搬運。控制端是 ESP32 DevKitC 微控制器，驅動一個 AHV24V30KVR5MAW 高壓模組（輸入 24 V，輸出可達 30 kV），以數位控制取代可變電阻；另有門蓋安全互鎖與緊急停止，會切斷電源並把高壓電路接地。另一項貢獻是模組化的 3D 列印同軸針頭轉接件：結構用 3D 列印，但保留金屬針尖以維持導電性，可適配不同針號與各種核—殼流配置。他們也公開一份針對雙硫鍵最佳化的 SHuffle 表現協議（6xHis-SUMO 融合，SUMO 同時作為分子伴護蛋白與乾淨的切割把手），並明白寫成可供其他難表現蛋白重複利用，例如類胰島素生長因子、抗體片段與毒液胜肽；此外還有海藻酸鈉製備、交聯後存活率測試、逃逸測試、光學顯微鏡 ImageJ 分析與以分光法測菌體沉降的各項協議。

**ihp.** 有幾場訪談是真的改了專案，而不是拿來裝飾。最清楚的是硬體：有人建議他們不要自製高壓電源（尤其不要用微波爐零件），因為電氣風險很嚴重，團隊因此完全放棄自製電源，去諮詢 Cornell 的 Afridi Lab，改買市售的穩壓機組，其他零件則透過 Digi-Key 與 Mouser 採購以壓低成本——那條建議是：把電壓升上去很容易，難的是穩定的穩壓直流輸出。Dr Insoo Hyun 重新定義了「安全」本身：他引入的是把風險與效益放在既有替代療法之上來權衡，而不是假設絕對安全；他也警告，某種微生物在食品中用得熟悉，並不表示它在開放傷口中是安全的，並要求他們選擇近似真實傷口條件的實驗模型，而不是最方便的那些。Dr Joseph Fins 針對臨床前證據施壓，並問：不帶活菌、直接遞送胜肽會不會更安全也更簡單——團隊現在明確把這條列為有紀錄的降風險架構，並把取捨（預先載藥的基質只能給固定劑量，會失去 AND 閘控制的釋放）寫出來而不是藏起來。Dr Andrew Leask 關於 CCN2/CTGF 訊息傳遞的意見形塑了標的的立論依據；而審查者要求確認在他們瞄準的傷口階段 H2O2 是否仍可偵測，則促使他們去處理感測靈敏度，並加上缺氧這一路 AND 閘以取得專一性。燒傷倖存者暨前燒傷護理師 Amy Acton 與 Phoenix Society for Burn Survivors 的 Andrea 改變了團隊說話的方式：倖存者在傷口癒合後很久仍需要支持——壓力衣與各項療程的經濟協助、情緒支持、與他人的連結——療法昂貴、不舒服而且效果不一，所以不要承諾一項療法能把疤痕減少多少。公開活動上約 20 位年長者與參訪者則教會他們：疤痕的大小或外觀無法預測它對個人的衝擊，而開放式對話浮現出的顧慮，是他們結構化問卷題目漏掉的；他們的結論是現有量表描述的是疤痕，而不是當事人想改善的東西。NYU 的 Alison Bateman-House 指出組成與製造方法是他們最強的專利請求項，並帶他們走過美國一年寬限期與 PCT 的經濟考量，這些直接進了商業化計畫。一場關於海帶養殖的對話，把永續性的論點從可生物降解轉向了原料來源，指出北美海帶養殖者真正的瓶頸是找到買家、而不是把海帶種出來，因為野採海藻便宜得多——這一點讓他們自己的敘事變得更複雜，而不是更好聽。

**publicEngagement.** Cornell 的教育計畫不只範圍罕見地廣，而且真的有迭代。他們自製的教育遊戲 Plasmid Pals 先找 Big Brothers Big Sisters 的參與者試玩，對方接著建議怎麼讓它更互動。質體手鍊搭配一塊開放式想法板（問參訪者會怎麼用合成生物學改變世界），後來演化出適配不同年齡的版本，用在托育機構、Sciencenter 與州博覽會——而當他們發現閱讀與拼字對約 20 位學前兒童是障礙時，便改用烹飪類比（DNA 是食譜書、RNA 是抄下來的食譜、蛋白質是做好的菜），並把「活動必須配合發展能力」這一課寫下來。一場夏令營課程讓約 80 位學生用即時投票辯論哪些科學問題值得被資助；一堂 30 分鐘的課後，又延伸出 20-25 分鐘由學生主導的提問，問的是研究職涯，以及沒有實驗室可用時要怎麼做出貢獻。STEM Her Way 是四場系列活動，高中女生在其中學合成生物學並發表自己的研究提案，15 位回覆者（來自七個國家）給出 4.7/5 的評分，且每位都願意推薦。隨行見習計畫為六個高中名額吸引到來自美國與 17 個國家的 260 多份申請，後來又擴大到五位國際學生，團隊協助評估他們自己的專案提案可行性——一位來自烏茲別克的參與者把土壤鹽化當作社區問題帶進來，學生們便圍繞它發展出 Salt Guardians。他們還辦了一場全球性的合成生物學治理競賽（法規路徑、生物安全與圍堵、取得與公平性，另加一個開放治理挑戰），製作了一檔敘事型合成生物學 podcast，透過分享自己的人類實踐簡報與腦力激盪指南，教 Lambert iGEM 如何準備利害關係人問題，並與 NUGEM 交換童書——NUGEM 把 Cornell 的譯成哈薩克語與俄語，Cornell 則把 NUGEM 的譯成中文、西班牙語與法語。

**realWorld.** 這是五個案例中商業化套件做得最完整的一份。目標市場有量化：美國東北部的燒傷中心與教學醫院，共 2,255 家醫療機構——26 家經認證的燒傷中心、604 家醫院（其中 31 家設有 ACGME 皮膚科住院醫師訓練）與 1,625 家醫美中心——服務估計每年 180 萬名可觸及病人，換算為每家機構每天 2.2 位病人，並優先瞄準最可能試用新技術的教學醫院與認證燒傷中心。法規分析點出真正的風險：Klothos 是組合式產品（海藻酸鈉奈米纖維裝置加上工程改造的活菌），因此 FDA 會指定一個主要作用模式，決定是由 CBER 走 IND/BLA 還是 CDRH 走 510(k)/PMA；分類錯誤可能迫使整個流程重來，估計代價是 18-24 個月與 50 萬美元以上——所以他們在投入開發資源之前，先向 Office of Combination Products 提出正式的 Pre-RFD 諮詢。他們引用 Azitra 已有 IND 並取得 FDA Fast Track 的工程改造 S. epidermidis 作為前例，證明 CBER 會接受外用工程細菌的 IND。六階段計畫從原型與纖維母細胞試驗開始，經過一套支持 IND/IDE 的資料包（皮膚安全性、免疫原性、生體分佈與微生物圍堵），到第一期臨床（因為是活體生物治療產品，需監測活菌），再到在手術、燒傷、肥厚性疤痕高風險與疤痕修整等情境下、以 POSAS、VSS 與 SCAR-Q 評分的第二期隨機對照試驗。自由實施分析涵蓋四個技術領域共十件專利，並標出具體警訊（University of Manitoba 的變色抗菌奈米纖維 US20220047523A1 與 NYCU 審查中的 pH 敏感靜電紡絲敷料，在加入 pH 指示劑之前都需要先行審視），另列出 PCT 成本：維持 150 個簽約國約 17K 美元，之後每個國家約 20K 美元。他們把法規策略攤在七個地區上，包括 MHRA 關於現代化 GTMP 定義的諮詢（2026 年 6 月 22 日結束）與韓國 MFDS 把目標審查時程從約 420 天縮短到 295 天的改革。超過 20 項風險分成技術、市場、財務與法規四類，依嚴重度、發生可能性與可偵測性評分，附上緩解措施並畫成熱圖；一張技能缺口雷達圖則指名這個 45 人以上的團隊目前做不到的事（定價、醫師採用、上市策略、臨床試驗設計）以及他們打算怎麼補。給付問題處理得很誠實：新穎的組合式產品往往沒有既成的給付代碼，因此他們把單位經濟同時放在自費與有給付兩種情境下計算。團隊拿到一筆 ANSA 補助，並把 Cornell 技術移轉辦公室的授權條件標為任何衍生公司在第一年的關卡因素。

**給 GEMS：** 把儀器的便宜版本做出來，然後好好公開它。Cornell 的關鍵一手，是判斷靜電紡絲機——通常得向廠商專購——可以用現成零件加 3D 列印做出來，接著把材料清單（BOM）、CAD、電路圖、組裝指南、操作手冊，以及一本獨立的高壓安全手冊（連同設計進去的安全互鎖與緊急停止）全部釋出。對校園型的中心來說，配套的一課是那個就緒分類器：從配方預測溶液的黏度、導電度與表面張力，標成綠/黃/紅，只把稀少的實驗時間花在綠色的配方上——一個能省下昂貴實驗的簡單模型，價值高於一個做得精緻卻不改變你下一步的模型。

### GU Frankfurt — HIDE
Overgrad · Germany · https://2026.igem.wiki/gu-frankfurt/
每年約有 183,000 例移植手術，術後隨之而來的是終身免疫抑制——為了保住移植物，卻削弱了整個病人。HIDE 改從病因下手：一個帶有以電腦設計的結合子（binder）的 synNotch 受體辨識捐贈器官上不相配的 HLA class I 等位基因，觸發 shRNA 的生產並以胞外囊泡輸出，再透過 RNA 干擾只沉默那些「非自體」的 HLA，其餘免疫系統維持完整。此專題一次串起三個研究領域（synNotch、RNAi、exosome 遞送），結合子與 shRNA 都由乾實驗以電腦設計，並以 FACS、qPCR、西方墨點法與奈米顆粒追蹤分析驗證。它拿下最佳元件集合與最佳教育獎，因為其副產物和療法本身一樣好用：HUSH，一套針對多型性基因家族的開源 RNAi 設計框架；以及 TRUST，一套談論死亡與哀傷的溝通框架，這是 iGEM 此前所沒有的。

**frameworks.** 兩條流程，處理一個沒有現成方法的等位基因辨別問題。在結合子方面，團隊刻意挑了較難的標的：選 HLA-A*01（等位基因頻率約 15%）而非更常見的 HLA-A*02，因為 A*01 相對於其他常見等位基因的多型性較少，要設計出具專一性的結合子因此更難；他們以 IPD-IMGT 把 HLA-A*01:01:01:01 與 A*02:01:01:01、A*03:01:01:01 做多序列比對，找出可用的不相配位點，這些位點集中在多型性的 alpha1 與 alpha2 區域的胜肽結合溝及其周邊。接著以 BindCraft 與 RFdiffusion3 產生約 2,000 個從頭設計的結合子，用 Boltz-2 與 AlphaFold 對標的與非標的 HLA 評估親和力與專一性，再把最有潛力的 8 個設計帶入分子動力學模擬檢驗穩定性，前後共六批設計並彙整模擬結果。在 shRNA 方面，序列比對找出核苷酸層級的辨別位點，候選序列以 siDirect 設計與評估，每個候選都再對人類基因組篩查在其他人類 mRNA 上的脫靶可能。HUSH 之後又追加了 150 條具序列比對意識的標靶 shRNA。

**datascience.** HUSH 之所以存在，是因為團隊盤點了工具生態後發現它停滯不前：商用 RNAi 設計工具是專有的黑盒子，演算法與選項設定都沒有文件，就連非商業的 siDirect 也既非開源、也無法整進流程，而近年已發表的、用於辨別高度相似序列的進展則完全沒有任何實作。因此 HUSH 把多序列比對折進設計步驟本身：輸入一條標的序列，再加上一組可選的相關序列（也就是要保留的等位基因），就會啟動具等位基因意識的標靶設定與一個比對階段；工具會在一開始就檢視輸入（分子類型、長度、GC 含量、序列組大小）並提出警示，例如 GC 含量高的標的可能導致種子區過濾器把所有候選都剔除，接著在條件設定步驟提供放寬該過濾器的選項。蛋白質輸入會被標記，因為必須先解析為對應的轉錄本。安全性是一個評分階段、不是免責聲明：候選序列以 Bowtie 對 NCBI human RefSeq 比對，團隊並提議把標準脫靶檢查擴及已知的單核苷酸多型性，因為這些位點可能造成不想要的脫靶。設計好的 siRNA 會在髮夾環的設計指引與結構完整性的熱力學評估下轉換為 shRNA。

**dataviz.** 這個 wiki 做成一套可探索的系統、而不是一份文件。乾實驗總覽是一張可滑過與點擊的熱區圖，每個組件（Binder、shRNA、HUSH）都會展開其設計理由，並連到各自的結果頁。HLA class I 的結構以可拖曳的 3D 模型呈現、依區域上色（alpha1、alpha2、alpha3、beta2m），讀者自己就看得出變異位在結合溝上。多序列比對以傳統的破折號記法對照 A*01 參考序列呈現，使每個不相配位點都數得出來。分子動力學的結果以每個結合子、每個等位基因為單位的動畫發表（例如把結合子 FR57 對 HLA-A*01、A*02 與 A*03 並排呈現），讓專一性看得見、而非只列成表。HUSH 頁面內嵌一個可運作的五階段精靈模擬界面，附上範例資料供讀者逐步操作，並由吉祥物 Heidi 逐步解說。人類實踐做成一張可依所屬單位、也可依構築的哪個部分篩選的互動利害關係人地圖，讀者可以直接問「是誰影響了結合子的設計？」並得到答案。教育成效以前後對照的成對數據呈現，而不是總量。

**software.** HUSH（Human genome-Universal Silencing Hairpin designer）在 GitLab 上開源，圍繞同一個核心的 HushSession 物件提供四種介面：一個有引導的五步網頁精靈，外加一個精簡的專家模式可直接調整熱力學常數與篩選規則；一個供一次性整進流程使用的 CLI；一個可保存輸入與序列組、常駐於終端機的互動介面；以及一個 MCP 伺服器，讓 AI 代理人能驅動它。另有 REST API 供外部流程相容接取。他們明示的三項設計原則是研究優先（每個選項都附上背後研究的文件）、易用性（上傳序列就會被引導，並依序列推導出建議的最佳選項）與安全性。團隊另外釋出了 START（SynBio Travellers，一款教育用瀏覽器遊戲）與 TRUST（敏感議題框架），wiki 的程式庫在 gitlab.igem.org/2026/gu-frankfurt。

**ihp.** 六個國家、44 場訪談、50 位利害關係人，依五項功能分類（界定需求、設計療法、通往臨床的路徑、捐贈議題的公共辯論、敏感溝通與教育），並對應到各自影響了構築的哪個部分。有紀錄的改動包括：DSO 與 Eurotransplant 量化了支撐本專題立論的物流與捐贈者短缺狀況；Prof. Urs Christen 對終身免疫抑制副作用的描述，推動團隊走向個人化的做法；Dr. Venugopal Gudipati 使結合子的準確性成為受體這一端的首要約束條件，Dr. Gregory Allen 則形塑了 synNotch 的設計；CAR-T 專家為一項自體療法設定了製造、物流與成本的框架。在捐贈議題的辯論上，團隊訪談了立場相對的兩位政治人物（Dr. Armin Grau 與 Helge Lindh），發現雙方都同意真正的缺口在教育，於是撰寫了一份政治提案，主張把他們的工作坊納入學校課綱的必修內容，並於 2026 年 9 月 22 日向德國聯邦議院跨黨派小組「Freiwilligkeit in der Organspende」提出，該小組同意納入考慮。最大的改動是程序上的：訪談有移植親身經驗的人之後，團隊發現 iGEM 有生物安全指引、卻完全沒有敏感議題的指引，詢問後 iGEM 自己的人類實踐委員會也確認如此，於是他們建立了 TRUST（Talking Responsibly and Understanding Sensitive Topics），合作者包括伯明罕 MASTERY 計畫的 Dr. Katharina Karcher、移植心理師 Dr. Angela Buchholz（她指出陌生的語彙製造的是恐懼、不是理解）、督導 Ariane Mantey-Strauss、倫理學者 Dr. Timo Sauer、護理師 Sanjin Krupic、DSO 的 PD Dr. Ana Paula Barreiros，以及前 iGEM 安全與保安負責人 Alonso Flores——後者反駁說，任何框架都無法把責任從隊伍自己身上移開。

**publicEngagement.** 一套五種媒介的策略（遊戲、工作坊、社會對話、印刷、聲音），建立在先訓練自己團隊的基礎上：19 位成員上了德國國家科學傳播研究所 NaWik 的「科學傳播基礎」工作坊，並以其核心訊息、四葉草與箭頭等工具作為之後一切工作的基礎。產出接著被量測、不只是計數：在兩所學校舉辦九場校園工作坊、觸及超過 140 位學生，知道「在沒有書面捐贈意願紀錄時由家屬決定」的比例從 66.1% 升至 91.9%，147 位學生中有 103 位表示會再去告訴別人（保守以每人四位計算，作為擴散效果的估計）。《HIDE & SEEK》是一本在藥局、診所與健身房發放的印刷版教育雜誌，使四道知識題的平均正確率從 88% 提升到 100%。他們在 Night of Science 設了問卷攤位、在 hr3 廣播（每日約一百萬聽眾）介紹 HIDE，獲 BIOspektrum、UniReport 與 Wissen wird 報導，上了 iGEM Lund 的播客《The Sequence》，做出 START 瀏覽器遊戲，並發送了數百張器官捐贈卡。

**realWorld.** 商業化策略是獨家授權協議：HIDE 保留智慧財產權，由一家大型製藥夥伴承接製造、通路與付費方的議價，之所以這樣選，是因為自體細胞療法所需的廠房、耗材與專業人力薪資成本，新創公司無法負擔。Miltenyi Biotec 已出具支持函。分析中指名的客戶鏈是製藥公司、法定健保與移植中心、而不是病人，因為先進細胞療法無法直接銷售給病人；並具體走過德國的給付制度：近乎全民的法定保險以所得的 14.6% 籌資，價格則由與製造商議價決定。該頁面附有每劑的銷貨成本、七年期預測、含里程碑與風險的法規路線圖、商業模式畫布、團隊自稱是誠實檢視自身缺口的 SWOT 與技能落差分析、PEST 分析，以及對聯合國永續發展目標的對應。意見來源包括 iGEM 創業訓練營、Innovectis 與柏林 Charité 的法規支援單位。

**給 GEMS：** 有兩點可以直接借鏡。第一是 HUSH 的立論前提：當你問題領域裡的標準工具是一個專有的網頁表單，這個缺口本身就是可發表的貢獻，所以就把開源版本做出來，把序列比對這一步整合進去，並把安全性檢查做成評分、而不是免責聲明。第二是把科普當成實驗來做，備好前後測工具（在單一事實題上從 66.1% 提升到 91.9%，比「我們觸及 500 人」有價值得多），並在學生執行任何涉及死亡、疾病或哀傷的活動之前，先建立一份 TRUST 那樣的書面規範。

### HFI — TWO EcN, ONE METABOLIC MISSION — 以益生菌協同療法治療罕見疾病高離胺酸血症
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/hfi/
HFI（廣州華南師範大學附屬中學國際部）為高離胺酸血症打造了一款口服的活體生物療法；這是一種由 AASS 突變造成的罕見疾病，目前沒有核准療法，發生率約為 1/411,000。他們把人體的 saccharopine 代謝路徑拆分到兩群 EcN 上——上游菌株表現 LKR 與 SDH，下游菌株表現 ALDH 與 AASDHPPT——並以 CRISPR-Cas9 剔除內源的 ldcC 離胺酸脫羧酶，以消除背景的離胺酸消耗；再以 eCPX 展示的 SpyTag/SpyCatcher 把兩個菌株以共價方式耦合起來，使中間產物在很短的擴散距離內於細胞間傳遞。生物安全由一個雙輸入致死開關處理：由阿拉伯糖驅動的 Bxb1 絲胺酸整合酶會把 lysis-E 卡匣反轉，而感測氧氣的 PcyoA 啟動子只有在離開厭氧的腸道環境後才會啟動。此專題之所以勝出，是因為乾實驗確實引導了濕實驗（NetLogo 篩選在選殖之前就選定了 RBS）、元件集合以 HPLC-MS 做了完整特性分析，而教育與 IHP 的規劃對一支高中隊伍而言異常地系統化。

**frameworks.** 兩個互補的模型，都是用來做決策、而不是裝點 wiki。第一個是在 NetLogo 3D 7.0.4 中建的代理人隨機接觸模型：200 個細胞（100 個 SpyTag 的 A 型、100 個 SpyCatcher 的 B 型）在 -16 到 16 單位的週期性邊界盒中隨機漫步，擴散速度為每 tick 0.17，交互作用半徑 1.4，共 2,000 個 tick；每一次成功的 A-B 接觸就建立一條無向圖的邊、把兩個細胞剩餘的結合容量各減一，並合併群集 ID，因此一個細菌聚集體實際上就是圖上的一個連通分量。他們掃過七個 RBS 元件（B0032、B0033、B0035、B0029、B0031、B0030、B0034），對應到 5 到 100 個表面展示位點，並追蹤平均群集大小、最大群集大小與完整的大小分布，其中把雜訊較大的 30 位點條件擴充到 60 次重複執行，以描述其隨機變異（最大值 109.6 +/- 34.5）。第二個是一個質量守恆、含 13 個狀態變數的隔室 ODE 模擬器，描述離胺酸的串聯反應：代謝物 L（離胺酸）、S（saccharopine）、A（AASA）與 P（AAA），分布在三個隔室（胞外培養基、上游 SpyCatcher 的細胞質、下游 SpyTag 的細胞質）；採 Michaelis-Menten 速率式、半飽和常數 0.2，並以一個飽和式的接觸訊號 H = B/(0.05+B) 把已佔用的結合容量轉換為額外的跨菌株交換傳導 g_CT，以四階 Runge-Kutta 積分、基礎步長 0.001（報告的骨幹質量平衡誤差約 3.77e-15），並以梯形法 AUC 彙總具毒性的 AASA 暴露量。

**datascience.** 乾實驗被明確用來填補量測上的缺口：他們在濕實驗中無法定量短命的中間產物 saccharopine 與 AASA，於是用 ODE 模型預測，並藉此揭露一個明確的設計取捨——在 SC:ST 為 2:1 時離胺酸清除最快（殘餘離胺酸 0.0519），但 AASA 的峰值也最高（0.3767，AUC 10.43）；而在 1:2 時 AASA 維持在低位（峰值 0.1123，AUC 3.14），卻有 0.2980 的離胺酸未被消耗。這種「兩個目標無法同時最大化」的框架，決定了實際測試的共培養比例。群集模型預測中等展示量（B0035、15 個位點，最大群集平均 48.67 個細胞，約為整個系統的 24%）落在可用的中間區域，而 50 個位點以上則會讓 91-98% 的細胞塌縮成單一巨大連通分量；這項預測接著在實驗檯上以螢光顯微鏡檢驗，並用 ImageJ 定量紅綠重疊的群集數與核心面積（2:1 時每視野 3 個群集，1:1 升至 16 個、1:2 為 14 個，核心面積平均 15.04 至 19.41 um2），模擬得到的比例排序與 HPLC 測得的離胺酸移除排序一致。量測方面：以 FDAA 衍生化的 HPLC-MS 校正了一套便宜的 ninhydrin 比色篩檢（離胺酸衍生物滯留時間 17.04 分鐘、m/z 398.1，校正曲線 R2 = 0.9985）。

**dataviz.** 兩個模型都移植成內嵌於 wiki 的互動網頁，使評審或讀者不必在本機安裝任何東西就能拉動滑桿、即時重跑模擬：ODE 代謝模擬器在 https://2026.igem.wiki/hfi/static/model/metabolism.html ，NetLogo 群集模型在 https://2026.igem.wiki/hfi/static/model/netlogo.html 。輸出為動態的群集視覺化、代謝物時間曲線與定量讀數。除此之外，他們報告了完整的群集大小分布（不只是平均值）、以顆粒加權與以數量加權的分布對照，以及一張把每個 RBS 元件編號與其轉譯強度等級、模擬結果並列的表格，使這次電腦篩選可供查核。

**software.** 沒有釋出獨立的軟體工具，但兩個模型以可獨立運作的互動網頁發布在 wiki 內（metabolism.html 與 netlogo.html），而完整的 NetLogo 原始碼（setup、go、update-cluster-distribution、avg-cluster-size、max-cluster-size、sweep-rbs、scan-catcher-series 等程序）則完整印在 Model 頁上，讓其他隊伍可以重跑這次篩選。程式庫：https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/hfi 。他們也向 Registry 貢獻了一組有完整文件的元件集合，包括 BBa_26S7HLMM（ldcC 標的序列）與 BBa_269KMPAL（pEcgRNA-ldcC），另有兩個模型列為社群貢獻。

**ihp.** IHP 以一個命名過的六步循環（LYSERA：Listen、Yield、Shape、Execute、Reflect、Apply）貫穿六個依序推進的階段——以興趣／影響力矩陣繪製利害關係人地圖、一份 434 份回覆的公眾問卷、技術驗證、臨床與病友端接觸、商業與法規諮詢，以及同儕審閱——之後再把第 3 到第 6 階段跑過第二輪。改動相當具體。四川大學的孫明軍博士（合成生物學與 AI 蛋白質設計）指出，從偵測到離胺酸到酵素表現之間的時間落差會讓益生菌錯過餐後的治療窗口，於是 HFI 徹底放棄了對離胺酸有反應的啟動子，改為讓所有分解酵素都以組成型表現；他也警告 SpyTag/SpyCatcher 的聚集風險會隨表現量上升，建議建一個運算模型、而不是靠試誤，這正是 NetLogo 群集模型與選用中低強度 RBS 的直接來源。霍丽洁教授則質疑腸道內的離胺酸濃度究竟是否與血中離胺酸連動，迫使他們重新檢視產品的生理學基礎與定位。公眾問卷改變了所有科普材料的用語：所有材料中的「基因改造」都換成了「工程改造」，因為問卷顯示前者會引發不安；又因為 76.04% 的受訪者聽過罕見疾病但說不出任何一種、只有 8.29% 能說出三種，教育內容便重建為從最基本處開始。問卷顯示 56.22% 支持納入國家醫保、59.45% 偏好以處方藥方式管理，這佐證了先走醫院的上市路徑與分級定價。病痛挑戰基金會的霍国东先生強調病人不該被其疾病定義，這確立了所有材料的非汙名化用語政策與「不給假希望」原則。安全性方面的意見（蛋白酶降解風險）則讓實驗計畫加上了模擬腸液的穩定性測試。

**publicEngagement.** 教育工作是依問卷資料設計、而非憑猜測，並依他們命名為 CLEAR（Connect、Layer、Engage、Assess、Reinforce）的明確五步循環運作，其中每項活動都必須回報一項可量測的結果與下一輪的一項改動。亮點包括：一本自行創作的微生物學漫畫，發行粵語與國語方言版本，並錄製英語、日語與德語有聲書，另提供阿拉伯語、德語、俄語、法語、韓語、葡萄牙語、日語、泰語、西班牙語與印尼語的文字版——文字版是刻意提供的，讓各地教育者能用 AI 文字轉語音自行生成團隊成員不會說的語言的音檔。他們在 HFI 國際部辦了一場 100 人以上的學生會議、一場包含動手做水果 DNA 萃取的 HFI 學術高峰會，在 iGEM Video 與 Bilibili 上發布實驗技術影片課程（吸量操作、瓊膠電泳、無菌操作檯，另有一則 SMA 罕病案例研究），在騰訊會議上辦線上問答，在大學生物科系展覽張貼海報，辦了一趟戈壁沙漠生物考察，成立了合成生物學學生社團，到廣州市社會福利院做科普，並與匯豐銀行合辦一場金融素養的專業講座。成效以前後配對問卷量測：在學術高峰會（n=24）中，能正確辨識合成生物學的比例從 79% 升至 96%，「合成生物學只是基因檢測的另一個說法」這個迷思從 8% 降到 0%，而正確理解 DNA 存在於每個活細胞、包括水果細胞中的比例從 42% 升至 88%。他們也誠實追蹤平台數據，指出 15 篇微信貼文獲得 248 個讚、955 次瀏覽、63 次分享與零則留言，由此判斷單向傳遞行不通，轉而採用互動形式，之後影片課程才首次出現留言。

**realWorld.** EcN-BioShield 有一份完整的商業文件，涵蓋未滿足需求、TAM/SAM/SOM、PESTEL、波特五力、SWOT，以及對照無離胺酸醫療食品（如 Hyper LYS Anamix Infant，英國 NHS 每 400 g 罐約 54 英鎊，約每年 1,500-2,000 英鎊）的競爭分析，另有商業模式畫布與一份 20 年財務預測。價格在就可負擔性諮詢利害關係人後，訂為每瓶 30 顆膠囊 2,000 人民幣（每位患者每年 24,000 人民幣），模型推算初始資金需求為 1,260,000 人民幣，於第 16.79 年損益兩平，到第 20 年累積回報 59,020,546 人民幣——對一份學生計畫而言，這種長期視野的誠實相當罕見。他們並行規劃了三條法規路徑，因為高離胺酸血症並未列入中國的罕見病目錄，而活體生物治療產品也沒有定案的註冊途徑，其中包括向 NMPA 藥品審評中心申請孤兒藥資格。風險管理依法規、臨床、商業、技術、公眾接受度、競爭與財務分別拆開，並附一條短／中／長期（1-5、5-10、11 年以上）的里程碑時程。倫理承諾包括分級定價並同時倡議納入國家醫保、不誇大技術成熟度、提供符合各年齡層的劑型，以及病人資料保密。

**給 GEMS：** 值得借鏡的是 HFI 讓乾實驗擔任濕實驗守門人的習慣：一個免費的 NetLogo 代理人模型篩過七個候選 RBS 元件、在一個質體都還沒做出來之前就選定了 B0035，而一個 ODE 模型則預測了團隊實際上量不到的中間產物——兩者之後都以可在瀏覽器即時操作的滑桿重新發布，讓讀者能自己重跑。第二項可移植的做法是他們 CLEAR／LYSERA 的紀律：任何科普活動或利害關係人會面，若沒有產出可量測的結果（前後配對問卷、互動數據，包括那個令人難為情的零留言結果）以及下一輪具名的改動，就不予登錄。

### KAUST-KSA — SHIHAB
Overgrad · Saudi Arabia · https://2026.igem.wiki/kaust-ksa/
Stocking an inventory of medicines for long-duration missions costs payload mass, so SHIHAB makes the medicine instead: a small library of lyophilised engineered microbes ('pills'), each producing a different nanobody, plus a compact automated bioreactor and purification train that an untrained astronaut can run. The wet lab integrated Dsup, the tardigrade damage-suppressor protein, genomically into three chassis (Bacillus subtilis, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Pichia pastoris) and quantified radiation resistance against UV-C and X-ray doses with four complementary readouts, then expressed and purified a payload protein by HisTrap. The dry lab answered which host, what feedstock and when to induce using genome-scale metabolic models plus an ODE layer, and COMSOL CFD decided the rotor geometry for mixing under Mars, Moon and transit gravity. It won Best Hardware and Best Space Project; the whole platform was taken out of the lab and run on desert dunes to prove the 'anywhere' claim.

**frameworks.** Flux balance analysis on three published genome-scale reconstructions (Yeast9 for S. cerevisiae, iBsu1147 for B. subtilis, iMS837 for Synechococcus elongatus PCC 7942, itself built on iJB792), plus a dynamic ODE layer integrated with scipy.integrate.solve_ivp (RK45) because FBA assumes steady state and cannot answer a timing question. Shared constraints are stated: glucose exchange 5, glycerol 0, oxygen 10 (aerobic) or 0 (anaerobic) mmol/gDW/h, nitrate capped at 10 for anaerobic Bacillus, habitat-analogue light at 145 mmol photons/gDW/h for the cyanobacterium, maximum nanobody flux computed with no growth requirement. The team repaired iBsu1147 by adding two reactions (NadB L-aspartate oxidase for de novo NAD+ synthesis and PyrD/PyrK dihydroorotate dehydrogenase for orotate), each justified with in-vitro literature evidence, because the published model failed without oxygen. Results: under oxygen restriction B. subtilis out-produces yeast roughly 3.4-fold on nanobody flux provided nitrate is supplied, and loses 46% of growth capacity against yeast's 82%; an engineered cyanobacterial supplier raises anaerobic yeast growth 13-fold (0.014 to 0.18 /h) once its sucrose export (0.81 mmol/gDW/h, tripled by capping the supplier's own growth) and oxygen (up to 4.2 mmol/gDW/h) are passed in as uptake bounds; the supplier is nitrogen-limited rather than carbon- or light-limited, and candidate gene knockouts do nothing. The ODE layer returns a closed-form optimal induction window of 6.5 to 7 h. Hardware modelling is COMSOL Multiphysics CFD comparing three rotor geometries for bubble fate, air distribution and vortex depth at 50-400 rpm across Earth, Mars, Moon and transit gravity.

**datascience.** Measurement was designed as a framework rather than a set of assays: wild-type and Dsup-expressing B. subtilis, S. cerevisiae and P. pastoris were exposed to UV-C (0-30 mJ/cm2, and 0-300 J/m2 series) or X-rays (mock to 2000 Gy in 200 Gy steps) and read out four complementary ways (serial-dilution spot assay, OD600 time course, resazurin dye-reduction and FUN-1 staining), so a resistance claim has to survive four independent readouts rather than one. Three Dsup integration strains per host were compared against wild type and a nanobody control. On the engineering side the team derived a calibration mapping the analog voltage of a DFRobot SEN0189 turbidity sensor to NTU and then a linear OD600 = a(NTU) + b fit against reference spectrophotometer readings, following Fan et al. (2016) on Bacillus coagulans, which is what makes automatic IPTG induction at OD600 0.5 possible with no human in the loop. The modelling output is explicitly handed to the bench: a 'For the Wet Lab' box tells the experimenters where to start the co-culture and what growth cap to impose on the cyanobacteria.

**dataviz.** The dry-lab page is an interactive model map: a scheme of the three chassis plus the cyanobacterial supplier where every label is a clickable result, and a 'TRY ME' prompt tells the reader to select a label to open that finding and jump to the section that develops it. Each result is also stated as a one-line claim before any plot ('Induction window: 6.5 to 7 h', 'Knockouts do nothing', 'Capping growth triples sucrose export'), with headline deltas as large-type stat tiles (3.4x, -46% vs -82%, 13x, 2 reactions). Table 1 is the most unusual piece of visualisation discipline on any of these wikis: for every link between models it states what is actually passed between them and labels the link Modeled, Identified or Assumed, so the reader can see exactly where the chain is evidence and where it is an assumption. The hardware page carries an animated 3D walkthrough of the purification sequence in its carry case, labelled 'illustrative flow, not measured data', and a live simulation of the bioreactor's touchscreen dashboard where the reader can drag the motor-speed dial and change temperature and pH setpoints. CFD results are shown as four-gravity comparison panels. All stat tiles and dashboards are reader-operable rather than screenshots.

**software.** No standalone released application, but the code is published: ODE models and GEM notebooks are linked from the model page, and the whole wiki plus hardware design lives at gitlab.igem.org/2026/kaust-ksa under CC BY 4.0. The hardware itself is the deliverable and is documented for reproduction: an Arduino Mega control stack with a touchscreen dashboard in a compact enclosure, closed-loop temperature (DS18B20 probe to heating elements), pH (DANOPLUS KIB-87 probe with signal-conditioning board to acid/base dispensing) and OD (turbidity sensor to IPTG induction), hollow structural supports routing all wiring, a filtration unit with user-selectable stages of decreasing pore size in gasketed modules (Kapton, paper, Acrodisc), syringe-pump buffer handling and affinity chromatography, all released with a Hardware User Manual, a Radiation Resistance Testing Handbook and a Protein Expression and AKTA Purification Handbook.

**ihp.** Over 30 activities and 15 named conversations, and the wiki is explicit that seven parts of SHIHAB changed, with an interactive map letting the reader pick either a person or a component. The team built their own ORBIT framework (Observe, Reach, Build, Iterate, Translate) and four values (autonomy, adaptability, responsibility, accessibility). Documented changes: Dr. Christopher E. Mason's feedback made Dsup one of the protective genes in the chassis-engineering strategy and added the Comet assay to the experimental workflow; Konstantinos Vergos and Dr. Akshay Chandrashekhar converged on microgravity as a mandatory part of validation, which is why the COMSOL simulations exist (as a precursor to parabolic flight); Sarah Al Harbi's point about crew supervision load produced the dry-lab monitoring dashboard and shaped the hardware; KAUST Health, Safety and Environment directly wrote the structure of the Safety Handbook (hazard identification, risk assessment, containment failure, accidental exposure, environmental release, emergency response) and shaped the Hardware manual; a regulatory expert pushed them to prioritise therapeutics by the conditions astronauts actually face on specific missions rather than by ease of production, which is how Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome and carcinogenesis entered the payload list; and conversations with humanitarian responders Rachel Kessler and Jonathan Grant replaced a generic 'disaster zone' use case with a stated principle, design for a specific context, not an abstract disaster zone.
