Professor Ma Ming Yao established that the kit must be positioned as a screening flag prompting medical follow-up, never a diagnosis, and that false positives and negatives must be managed responsibly, and that high-risk patients are the target - which reshaped how the whole wiki speaks about the product and prompted a community education workshop for the elderly. A medical laboratory technologist insisted on a clear, reasonable cut-off concentration for the target miRNA, rigorous quality control, timely sample processing, and a larger sample size for credibility, which pushed the team towards a multi-target design. E-SENSE Innovation & Technology Limited said clinicians will only recommend a home test backed by real-world clinical data with low false-positive and false-negative rates, which pushed the wet lab to run the cell-free EGFP validation and the HCR sensitivity series. Public input was quantified: a street interview of 137 people and an online survey of 283 found 52% had never heard of CKD or diabetic kidney disease and only 28% had heard of both, 60% did not know or were unsure that early kidney disease can be symptomless, and 63.2% of street respondents cited absence of symptoms as their reason for not getting screened.

**publicEngagement.** Education reached over 800 participants and was built on three stated principles - a Cascading Peer-Educator Model, Gamified Educational Experiences, and Reflective Learning. The peer-educator model is the distinctive one: rather than only teaching end-learners, they trained non-iGEM junior-form Science Team members as Student Facilitators with both content and facilitation skills, then had those facilitators independently run workshops for their schoolmates, and published a training guide for holding a secondary school workshop plus a CKD brochure for older adults so the materials outlive the team. Activities were designed per audience and deliberately low-cost and replicable: at Salesian Yip Hon Millennium Primary School's STEAM Day (about 600 students and parents) they ran a micropipette drip-art station, a magnetic miRNA detection game in which only the target miRNA card hides a magnet so it alone sticks to a paper toehold-switch model, and a health-knowledge ping-pong ball toss into an illustrated face; at Shek Lei Catholic Primary School, strawberry DNA extraction delivered entirely in Cantonese with terms simplified ('cell walls' became 'the surface of the strawberry') and a 'Blood Vessel Clearing Game' using paper, drawing supplies and a hand-made wooden vessel model, with students drawing their own food items and testing whether they fit through. Secondary outreach covered St. Paul's School (Lam Tin) with 169 participants and Hoi Ping Chamber of Commerce Secondary School with 19, using a micropipetting precision-dyeing challenge and a 'Detective on Call' online DNA fingerprinting game. They also ran a card game for community-centre children including ethnic-minority children, an elderly workshop, a Hong Kong Joint Secondary Schools Science Fair booth, and regional middle-school outreach in the Greater Bay Area. Reflection was built in with structured worksheets, exit cards and open Q&A, and every activity records what they changed next - after noticing their terminology was too advanced for young children they switched to plainer language, more gestures and more Cantonese, and they adapted in real time when a student asked 'Why strawberries? Why not apples?' by adding an impromptu discussion.

**realWorld.** The intended product is an at-home urine screening kit, costed against a system where each Hong Kong dialysis patient runs about HKD 50,000 per year and where confirming CKD currently needs repeat clinic visits over a three-month window because uACR varies by 30% or more day to day and cystatin C is several times the price of creatinine and rarely reimbursed. Every design decision is pulled towards deployability: urine rather than blood, no centrifuge, enzyme-free isothermal amplification at room temperature, and a colour change readable in natural light without any instrument. The team is consistently careful about regulatory and clinical positioning - the kit is repeatedly described as a screening flag that prompts follow-up and complements, rather than replaces, eGFR and uACR, and the kit visualisation is explicitly captioned as a research concept, not a validated diagnostic product. What is not present on the wiki is a business model, pricing, manufacturing plan or named regulatory pathway; industry engagement with E-SENSE is framed around clinical credibility and usability requirements rather than commercialisation, and the honest gap they name is the need for real-world paired clinical data before a home device is justified.

**給 GEMS：** Two things to steal. First, NUPACK plus a reused iGEM software tool (Wageningen's miRADAR) is a complete, free, high-school-feasible dry lab: HongKong-HS ranked 16 candidate switches on explicit thermodynamic criteria (HMFE vs TMFE, downstream secondary structure blocking the RBS, equilibrium base-pair probability) and predicted the background-leakage failure mode before the gel showed it. Second, their wiki proves that the best data visualisation is mechanism animation plus per-figure provenance - every statistic carries its own population, year and source, and the AI-generated product imagery is labelled as such, which is exactly the standard a research centre's outputs should hold itself to.

### XJTLU-China — dogmaOS — 以程式化的轉譯節奏提升可溶性蛋白質表現
Undergrad · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/xjtlu-china/
XJTLU-China 要問的是：在 E. coli 中難以表現的重組蛋白，其可溶產量能否透過刻意規劃轉譯*在哪裡*變慢來提升，而不是靠把表現量最大化。他們的乾實驗室系統 catmaOS（Codon-Aware Translation Modeling and Analysis Operating System）串接四個模型：結構上的共轉譯摺疊優先度（M1）、演化上保守的慢密碼子證據（M2）、含受限 Pareto 選擇的五層轉譯動力學與核醣體流量引擎（M3-A 至 M3-E），以及宿主 tRNA 庫的干預設計（M4）。這套框架從六個候選中挑出單一個同義密碼子設計（W1-S），以及一個工程化的 BL21-AlaPro 載體株，兩者都進了濕實驗室；接著以 Four-Leaf Clover RT-qPCR 量測實際的 tRNA 剔除程度，再把這個數字回饋進 M3-A 作為更新後的宿主情境。本專案獲得 Best Model（大學部）與 Best Education（大學部）。

**frameworks.** catmaOS 是一條四模型、五層的多尺度管線，並且異常明確地說明每一層「是什麼」與「不是什麼」。M1 是結構生物資訊評分模型：它由 PDB 座標（G-CSF，PDB 1RHG 鏈 B，UniProt P09919，RefSeq NM_000759.4）建立殘基層級的證據表，以 DSSP 取得二級結構與相對溶劑可及性，隨鏈長增長求解一個自我一致的原生接觸佔據模型（Jacobs-Shakhnovich），以 1 kBT 自由能下降為閾值、4 Angstrom 接觸截斷來偵測摺疊事件，再加入 Kyte-Doolittle 疏水暴露、半胱胺酸鄰域分數、DSSP 轉換與 beta 起始軌跡，以及 AGGRESCAN 式的聚集傾向，然後以考量資料可得性的權重融合成 0-100 的優先度分數，並依 35 個密碼子的核醣體出口通道偏移往下游位移（並掃描 30-40 個密碼子做敏感度分析）。M2 是比較基因組學模型：以 MAFFT L-INS-i 做蛋白質比對、用 PAL2NAL 投影回密碼子，取用 GtRNAdb/tRNAscan-SE 各物種高可信度 tRNA 基因套數，搭配一張凍結的密碼子—反密碼子搖擺懲罰表，將 tRNA 適應度式的有效供給 W_s(c) 轉換為物種內的相對「阻力」，以阻力前 25% 標記慢密碼子，施加嚴格的同一胺基酸過濾，並以 Henikoff 位置式序列加權產生一個加權慢密碼子保守度分數，另附明確的有效覆蓋度軌跡。M3 是動力學核心：M3-A 把密碼子的內在停留時間分解為解碼（有效同源/搖擺供給的倒數，加上近同源競爭項，K_dec = 0.80、gamma_near = 0.50）、胜肽基轉移（脯胺酸/EF-P 停滯情境）、基礎轉位，以及以 ViennaRNA RNAplfold 局部未配對機率表示的 RNA 阻力，並以四組消融設定 A0-A3 歸因機制；M3-B 把該速率向量輸入兩套獨立的核醣體流量後端——一個是確定性的含延伸物件核醣體流量模型（RFMEO）穩態解，一個是隨機 Gillespie 動力學蒙地卡羅的延伸物件 TASEP（5 次重複、SEM 帶、捨棄暖機段）——並以 Pearson、Spearman、一致性係數與前 k 名熱點重疊度交叉驗證，另加一張 alpha-beta 邊界敏感度網格；M3-C 繪出流量安全的停留時間包絡、出口通道可得性閘門、相對接觸次序的摺疊需求、一個在 0.5/1/2 尺度網格上執行的有限狀態生產性路徑傳遞子 p_{L+1} = p_L exp(s Q_L dt_L)（只有當正負號在各尺度間維持一致時才稱該方向「穩健」），以及一個時間加權的未滿足原生接觸暴露代理量 E_U = sum_L U(L) tau(L)；M3-D 以 scikit-learn 的 mRNA 衰減預測器（訓練於 5,486 筆整理過的 E. coli 半衰期記錄，Chen 2015、Selinger 2003，按基因分群切分為 3,883/765/838）閉合一階穩態 mRNA 平衡 M_ss = k_tx / (k_deg,eff + mu)；M3-E 在讀框、GC 含量、motif、限制酶切位與同聚物等限制下產生同義候選，並以四個凍結目標的受限 Pareto 支配進行選擇（最大化末端通量 J、最小化核醣體負載 R、最大化生產性路徑 C4、最小化暴露 C5），小搜尋空間用精確列舉、大空間用 NSGA-II，並以對照精確 Pareto 前緣的精確率/召回率評分。M4 把設計延伸到宿主：它將目標密碼子對映到 BL21 的 tRNA 基因、基因簇與啟動子，使用加權的 K-12 到 BL21 轉移分數（S_map = 0.45 S_signature + 0.20 S_ordered + 0.15 S_count + 0.15 I_80 + 0.05 I_200），提出降低套數或在 29 bp 啟動子核心做 1-3 個置換，對應 15/30/50% 的弱化層級，並以三模型 ML 整合（訓練於已發表 MBRS L4 資料庫的 112,955 個實測核心啟動子，Zhou 2025，依 -35/-10 motif 配對留出，67,978/7,680/37,297）排序，在 log2(1+強度) 上達到 r = 0.677、MAE = 0.506。

**datascience.** 兩個監督式模型由公開量測資料訓練，另一個由團隊自己的資料訓練：mRNA 降解代理模型（D2）以 5,486 筆整理過的 E. coli 半衰期記錄訓練，並按基因/蛋白質/CDS 分群切分；29 bp 啟動子強度整合模型以 112,955 個實測核心啟動子訓練，依 -35/-10 motif 配對留出（這是真正的分布外切分，r = 0.677）；密碼子佔據回歸則用了橫跨 125 個基因的 107,627 筆密碼子層級 Ribo-seq 觀測值，記錄了 14 nt 的 P 位偏移、排除頭尾各 10 個密碼子，並採基因留出評估（22,025 筆測試觀測）。團隊公開稽核自己的資料來源：有幾個資料集的來源欄位被標註為「未確認」、「尚待確認」或「非來自有明確出處的已發表資料集規模」，而不是悄悄引用。模型 4 的 proL 啟動子篩選預測值為 0.727（原生）對 0.386/0.366/0.358（P1-P3）；建成的 BL21-AlaPro 菌株隨後以 Four-Leaf Clover RT-qPCR 量測，顯示以 rpoD 正規化的成熟 tRNA 由 63.98 降至 23.42（alaXW）、由 6.828 降至 2.254（proL），而這些實測值被送回 M3-A 作為新的有效供給表，完整重跑 A-E。濕實驗室的主要讀值：在工程宿主中，模型設計序列 TolB-G-CSF 的可溶/不可溶比平均達 0.140，相較於野生型宿主中商用序列的 0.075（以 DnaK 正規化，n = 3 生物重複，約 1.87 倍）。關鍵的是，團隊也誠實報告負面結果——PfCHT1 與 leptin 的不可溶條帶變弱，但沒有出現明顯的可溶性富集，結果圖的標題就直接寫著「Solubility Gains Remain Unclear」（可溶性提升仍不明確）。

**dataviz.** 十八張編號的模型圖，讀起來像一條完整的論證。對齊的多軌剖面圖把六條正規化的結構特徵軌（F1-F6）放在考量可得性的綜合分數之上，讓讀者看出是哪個特徵推高了某個峰；優先度剖面圖下方必定配一條證據覆蓋度軌，使「高分但證據薄弱」不會被誤讀成發現。圖 8 是通道長度敏感度熱圖（列為假設的出口通道長度 30-40 個密碼子，行為密碼子位置，固定 0-100 的藍綠色標尺，真正無資料的格子以淺灰表示而非以零填補），讓讀者看見高優先度帶隨著假設改變而遷移。圖 11 是密碼子層級的稽核矩陣（18 列同源蛋白 x 密碼子 110-121，綠色代表在該物種的 tRNA 情境下為慢密碼子，白色代表可比較，灰色代表不可比較）。圖 14 是只限於被編輯位置的 log2(候選/WT) 停留時間熱圖，x 軸明確標示為非連續，圖例也說明 +1 意即 2 倍。圖 16 是以 WT 正規化的通量、核醣體負載與暴露三面板點圖，候選列彼此對齊，刻意不壓縮成單一分數。KMC 軌跡附有 +/- SEM 帶，並把未受阻的停留與受阻的等待分開呈現。圖說都標明偏好的方向，以及該量是實測值還是相對的模型代理量。

**software.** catmaOS 4.02.06 以可下載的 Windows x64 原始碼版本發布，附 Setup.cmd/Start.cmd、鎖定版本的 requirements-lock.txt、私有 .venv、在 127.0.0.1:8767 上執行的本機瀏覽器工作區（序列絕不離開使用者的機器）、一份 28 頁 PDF 使用手冊，以及四個預先計算、嵌入 wiki 的唯讀互動示範，可匯出 JSON/CSV。每次執行都會產出一份可重現性包：request.json（具型別的輸入、標籤、來源、參數）、採版本化綱要 1.0.0 的 result.json（含輸入雜湊、模組狀態與可重現性記錄）、curves.csv、metrics.csv、exact_candidates.csv、native/evidence-result.json 與 run.log，全部依 run_id 打包成 zip。頁面上明文寫出的設計規則——「缺失值就保持缺失」以及「一次完成的執行只確認所請求的任務已結束，不代表每個模型都真的跑過」——正是多數隊伍缺少的紀律。

**ihp.** 他們從利害關係人對話中萃取出一套 CARE 框架：Create Accessibility（創造可及性）、Accountable Storytelling（負責任的敘事）、Real-world Alignment（與真實世界對齊）、Ethical Design（倫理設計）。它源自 Dr Lanlan Han 的一個問題：究竟誰會受益，以及證據有多強。訪談時間軸依「問題／設計／範圍」編排，團隊也記錄了自己如何收斂主張：起點是「提升 E. coli 中的異源蛋白表現」，但文獻以及與 Dr Antony Kam 和產業專家 Dr Xijun Piao（蘇州 CATUG Biotechnology）的訪談，促使他們把成功重新定義為「可用的可溶性蛋白」而非總表現量，並明確聲明 dogmaOS「並不被定位為通用的蛋白質生產平台」。中期與 Dr Yongtao Zhu、Dr Chun Chan、Prof Sheng Yang（中國科學院上海生命科學研究院）、Prof Zhiliang Lu、Dr Avinash Pandreka（牛津蘇州先進研究中心）、Dr Kozo Hamada 與 Prof Zhongmei Liu（江南大學）的諮詢，說服他們單憑轉譯速度無法解釋摺疊結果——這正是模型 3 與模型 4 誕生的原因。

**publicEngagement.** Best Education 得主（大學部）。團隊建立的是明確的教育框架，而不是一串活動清單：一條四層的「終身學習路徑」（興趣啟發、知識建構、跨領域共創、專業影響），以參與深度取代年齡分層，再與四階段活動結構（觸及、建構、對話、延伸）交叉，並以 Gardner 的多元智能理論作為選擇活動形式的設計視角。他們透過 21 場活動——工作坊、展覽與 Learning Mall Premium 線上平台——觸及超過 2,000 人，並產出 18 套可重複使用的教育工具包；「延伸」階段是刻意設計的，讓每場活動都留下一個遊戲、手冊或工具包，而不是在活動結束時就終止。

**realWorld.** 標的的選擇由真實需求驅動：G-CSF、leptin、PfCHT1 與 FGF2 是與研究人員及蛋白質生產公司共同選定的，它們都在 E. coli 中難以表現，且在公共衛生、罕見疾病與基礎研究上有明確的研究或臨床用途。團隊把專案對應到 SDG 3、9、12 與 17。可及性就是其商業論點——catmaOS 不以服務販售，而是以免費的本機軟體釋出，讓只有基本 E. coli 設備的學術實驗室與 iGEM 隊伍能自行做上游最佳化，而不必付錢去反覆試誤。生物安全內建在設計中：使用非病原菌株、遵循 BSL-1 操作、廢棄物高壓滅菌，並在 lambda-Red 基因組編輯後以 FLP-FRT 移除卡那黴素抗性卡匣。

**給 GEMS：** 為每一個模型分數都配上一條明確的證據覆蓋度軌，並對你最站不住腳的那個假設（此處是出口通道長度）做敏感度掃描，讓一張圖不只呈現答案，也呈現其中有多少是真實資料；同時把互相競爭的目標維持為各自對齊的面板，而不是加總成一個自創的分數。這兩件事用 matplotlib、一個有心的 16 歲學生就做得到，而且立刻能讓模型變得誠實。

### Uni-Padua-IT — C.O.S.M.I.C. (Cyanobacterial Oxygen Supply for Martian Inhabitant Complexes)
Undergrad · Italy · https://2026.igem.wiki/uni-padua-it/
Uni-Padua-IT engineered the filamentous cyanobacterium Nostoc sp. PCC 7120 as a Martian life-support organism: it fixes CO2 into breathable oxygen, degrades the perchlorates that poison Martian water (via native NarB and a heterocyst-compartmentalised pcrABD plus chlorite dismutase), and carries pprA from Deinococcus radiodurans for radiation-damage repair, behind a copper-dependent MazF kill switch. Because no free codon optimiser listed their chassis, they forked TIsigner into ReTIsigner, a frequency-weighted codon optimiser that reads any of the 35,799 Kazusa codon usage tables, enforces GC bounds, actively excises RFC restriction sites and reports CAI, GC and translation-initiation opening energy. ReTIsigner was validated in silico over 100 sequences and four hosts, then in vivo: a ReTIsigner-optimised eYFP gave a 2.16-fold common-effect increase in specific fluorescence across DH5-alpha and BL21 (p = 0.002, permutation test stratified by strain). They also built an open-source acoustic (piezo + Arduino) bubble sensor so oxygen production can be followed without opening a sealed culture.

**frameworks.** SvelteKit single-page frontend built from scratch, talking to a Flask backend over a single documented HTTP endpoint (POST /optimise); a worker pool behind Flask shells out to the compiled scientific binaries. The whole stack is shipped as a two-stage Docker image (Node.js 22 build stage; Miniconda runtime pinning Python 3.6.9, ViennaRNA 2.5.1 and Infernal 1.1.5) exposing port 5050.

**datascience.** In silico benchmark over 100 coding sequences optimised for four hosts spanning roughly 31-75% GC, recording GC, CAI, opening energy and failure rate with and without a codon usage table: supplying a table cut the failure rate from 52% to 2% while leaving opening energy essentially unchanged (mean difference +/-0.06 kcal/mol). Wet-lab validation used independent cultures as the unit of replication, three cultures per sample each in technical triplicate, fluorescence compared at matched optical density rather than fixed time, two detection channels, and a permutation test stratified by strain; the team explicitly states the confidence interval (about 1.6-2.8x) and what the data does not license them to claim.

**dataviz.** Results view compares input against each optimised sequence in a results card showing CAI, GC content and opening energy, so sequences no longer have to be analysed one at a time in external tools. A built-in guided tour walks a first-time user through every field of the run configuration. Exports in three reproducible formats (CSV, PDF, FASTA), each recording the full run configuration plus the computed analyses. Validation figures (specific-fluorescence bar charts and ratio plots with 95% CIs) are published as SVG on the wiki, and the system is explained with two architecture diagrams: the POST /optimise request path and one iteration of the annealing loop.

**software.** ReTIsigner is a free, Apache 2.0-licensed codon optimiser for non-model hosts, and it is the clearest example this year of forking an existing scientific tool rather than rebuilding one. The team started from TIsigner (Bhandari, Lim & Gardner), contacted its authors for feedback on their proposal, and then added four things TIsigner lacked: frequency-weighted synonymous codon sampling driven by any Kazusa codon usage table (35,799 organisms) instead of one-amino-acid-one-codon, an optional GC bound enforced as a feasibility filter, active position-targeted removal of restriction sites with a re-check for newly introduced sites, and in-app CAI/GC analysis per output sequence. The restriction-site work is the headline engineering result: optimising perchlorate reductase subunit A for Nostoc under RFC 10 and RFC 1000 constraints was still running after 15 hours under the original random-substitution behaviour, and completed in seconds afterwards, yielding registry part BBa_268WDVEB. Architecturally the optimiser sits behind POST /optimise so it is usable headlessly without the Svelte interface, and the Docker image removes the platform problem that ViennaRNA and Infernal binaries create on Windows ('docker build -t retisigner . && docker run -p 5050:5050 retisigner'). It ships a user guide, a development guide documenting the system and its API calls, a video tutorial (https://video.igem.org/w/rN6WnodTKYxiNitzfSUVZ3) that optimises BBa_E0040 GFP for Clostridium acetobutylicum ATCC 824, and a public repository at https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/uni-padua-it/retisigner-svelte (team repo: https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/uni-padua-it). It is self-hosted via Docker rather than offered as a hosted public web service, which is the one gap: there is no URL a stranger can click. They also positioned ReTIsigner honestly against the field, reproducing Table 1 of Demissie et al. (2025) and adding their own row with a tilde rather than a tick in the CAI column, and comparing feature-by-feature against the two previous iGEM codon optimisers (HebrewU 2018, MIT 2023). They published an open call for collaboration on 9 August 2026 offering to optimise any team's sequence for their chassis and received no replies, and they say so on the wiki.

**ihp.** Human practices is written as a sequence of questions with an explicit 'what we changed' and, unusually, a 'what we couldn't fix' for each. Consultations with photosynthesis and cyanobacteria professors (Nicoletta La Rocca, Daniela Billi) cut the cold-tolerance module. iGEM Darmstadt 2025, who had built the same perchlorate constructs in B. subtilis, warned them off pcrABCD's oxygen sensitivity, which led to testing native NarB first and then compartmentalising pcrABD in heterocysts. A presentation to NASA's Open Science Data Repository Analysis Working Group moved the radiation module from survival-at-high-dose to genome integrity over generations, and pushed them toward a terrestrial use case (perchlorate in groundwater near propellant plants) when the Moon turned out to have no perchlorate. ESA flight-operations engineers (Davide Vertuani, Paolo Ferri) made them reason about the journey, not just arrival. Philosopher Telmo Pievani and space-habitat designer Serena Crotti changed how the bioreactor is framed within a crew's daily life. Most relevant to a dry-lab centre: they took their hardware manual and code to an instrumentation professor and an electronics PhD student (Simone Del Favero, Samuele Faccin) before publishing, and as a result weakened their own claim (the sensor detects gas bubbles, it does not measure oxygen), redrew the circuit with no crossing wires, documented timing resolution, and added a table separating proven from untested.

**publicEngagement.** A public survey on space research and biotechnology directly reshaped the team's communication: 76.5% of respondents rated using living organisms for oxygen and water highly while only 28.2% rated colonisation highly, so the team separated the usefulness of the technology from support for settling Mars; 42.2% knew little or nothing about GMOs, so explanations of what they modify and why were rewritten more accessibly; and 94.8% called a genetic safety system fundamental or very important, so the kill switch and confined bioreactor were given more space. Education activities grew out of the same consultations.

**realWorld.** The team identified a terrestrial application independent of any Mars mission: perchlorate contaminates groundwater near propellant and pyrotechnics manufacturing and is regulated, and biological removal is already an active research area. They were unable to secure an ionising radiation source (INFN Legnaro's Van de Graaff accelerator unavailable; IOV Padova's linear accelerator caps at roughly 6 Gy/min against a 6 kGy LD50), and report that the pprA radiation claim is therefore untested rather than glossing over it.

**給 GEMS：** Fork and extend an existing, cited scientific tool instead of building a new one, and validate the extension at the bench: ReTIsigner's credibility comes from a 2.16-fold wet-lab expression result, a 52%-to-2% failure-rate benchmark, and a published 'what we are entitled to claim' section that names its own limits. A research centre should also copy their packaging discipline, one Docker command plus a documented HTTP endpoint so the engine is reusable headlessly, and their habit of sending documentation to an outside instrumentation expert before publishing it.

### HBUT-China — IGNITE — oHSV2-Neo-IL-2
Undergrad · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/hbut-china/
HBUT-China targeted microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer, the roughly 80-85 percent of advanced cases that behave as immunologically cold tumours, by arming an attenuated oncolytic herpes simplex virus type 2 with an engineered interleukin-2. Their Best New Basic Part, Neo-IL-2, is an AI-guided interface redesign that weakens binding to IL-2R-alpha (CD25) while keeping signalling through the IL-2R-beta/gamma-c complex, so it activates CD8 T cells and NK cells without driving the regulatory T-cell expansion and dose-limiting toxicity that have crippled wild-type IL-2. The cassette was recombined into an HG52 backbone already deleted for ICP34.5 (neurovirulence) and ICP47 (TAP inhibition, so MHC class I presentation is restored), replacing a CMV-GFP cassette at the gamma-34.5 locus. They won Best New Basic Part in the Undergrad section and Best Oncology Project.

**frameworks.** Two named, reusable frameworks offered as contributions: SHIELD, a six-module full-chain safety paradigm covering safety-by-design, wet-lab operational governance, hardware infrastructure assurance, emergency response, training and education, and public outreach; and HOPES, a closed-loop human-centred methodology for integrated human practices. Plus a documented chassis-comparison exercise weighing HSV-1 against HSV-2 across oncolytic capacity, payload size and other dimensions before committing.

**datascience.** AI-assisted protein interface design followed by multi-tool computational triage: molecular docking, affinity prediction, stability and manufacturability analysis, with PRODIGY used to forecast receptor-binding profiles at 37 degrees C and confirm reduced CD25 affinity alongside retained CD122/CD132 association. The design hypothesis is then tested rather than assumed, with SPR used for direct receptor-binding verification.

**dataviz.** Construction schematics showing the HG52 (ICP34.5-/ICP47-) backbone with TRL/IRL/IRS/TRS repeats and the homologous-recombination replacement of CMV-GFP with CMV-Neo-IL-2-BGH-polyA, three-round plaque-purification panels in bright-field, green and merged channels, flow-cytometry Treg percentage comparisons, qPCR and RTCA traces, tumour growth curves and survival plots, and a watercolour shield diagram linking the six SHIELD dimensions.

**ihp.** Patient, clinician and expert interview transcripts were analysed alongside a public questionnaire on understanding of cold versus hot tumours and a review of previous iGEM human-practices cases, organised through their HOPES closed-loop framework. Safety input came from named virologists, including Qiu Yang, a researcher at the Wuhan Institute of Virology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, who works on viral vector safety evaluation and animal model assessment, with multiple rounds of interviews on virology and animal experimentation feeding the risk-assessment design.

**publicEngagement.** Tiered outreach designed per audience rather than one talk repeated: young children (storybooks, five published as PDFs), special-needs children and groups with intellectual disabilities, university students, and elderly communities, including a graded calisthenics set with a basic and an advanced version so seniors of different fitness levels can use it. Formats span hands-on experiments, physical teaching aids and salons.

**realWorld.** There is no venture here and the team does not pretend otherwise, so the instructive material is the part and the safety practice. On reusability, Neo-IL-2 is one of the better-engineered iGEM parts because the characterisation is layered rather than single-assay: SDS-PAGE for expression, qPCR and ELISA for transcript and protein, SPR for direct receptor binding, a Treg selective-activation assay and a T-cell activation assay for the functional claim that actually matters, RTCA for real-time cytotoxicity, and crucially a stability test of Neo-IL-2 expression after high-passage propagation of the recombinant virus, which is the test that tells a downstream user whether the part survives in a working vector. They also state the reuse envelope explicitly and in vector-agnostic terms: the coding sequence is intended for any context needing selective CD8 T-cell and NK activation without Treg expansion, and they name oncolytic viruses, mRNA-LNP and chassis strains as delivery platforms it can move into. Eight new parts were built (six basic, two composite), two existing parts reused, and functional annotations and characterisation descriptions on the Registry entries were deliberately expanded, with a named Part Leader owning the documentation. That combination, a design rationale, a computational prediction, an orthogonal physical measurement of the predicted property, a functional assay of the intended benefit, and a passage-stability result, is what makes a part genuinely inheritable rather than merely registered. On safety, the standout is institutional rather than technical: HBUT initiated and led a five-school joint biosafety manual for anti-tumour synthetic-biology projects with four other university iGEM teams (ZJU-China, BNU-China, JLU-FBH and ZJUT-China), covering oncolytic-virus modification operating standards, GMO leakage hazards and waste-disposal guidance, published as a downloadable PDF and explicitly designed with internally unified but differentiable risk-assessment protocols, since the five teams use different carriers. Their reasoning for doing it is the honest one: an individual iGEM team is limited in research vision, experimental conditions and risk-assessment competence, so cross-team safety communication is how those limits get overcome. Safety is also built into the construct rather than bolted on, with ICP34.5 deleted to cut neurovirulence and improve tumour selectivity and ICP47 deleted to restore antigen presentation, and they state plainly that genetic attenuation cannot eliminate risk entirely because viruses are inherently infectious. Wet-lab practice is documented at BSL-2 with risk assessment, PPE, waste handling and training, photographed down to biosafety-cabinet operation, eyewash stations and fridge labelling. The blunt limitations are theirs: the project is explicitly still in progress, systematic toxicity assessment requires expansion to multiple animal models, and the AI protein-screening system needs further experimental iteration.

**給 GEMS：** For any part GEMS wants other groups to reuse, publish the five-layer evidence stack HBUT used for Neo-IL-2: design rationale, computational prediction of the specific property changed, an orthogonal physical measurement of that property (SPR, not just docking), a functional assay of the intended benefit and of the harm avoided, and a stability result after many passages in the working vector. Separately, copy the five-school joint biosafety manual: co-author a shared risk-assessment document with other groups working on the same hazard class, since one lab's risk-assessment competence is narrower than five labs'.

### NFLSHS-CHINA — CroTeen
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/nflshs-china/
NFLSHS-China built a fully heterologous crocetin pathway in E. coli (idi, CrtE, CrtB, CrtI, CrtY, CrtZ upstream to zeaxanthin; CsCCD2 plus Neurospora crassa NcALD downstream to free crocetin), then re-engineered it after wet-lab failure from a two-plasmid system into a single-plasmid, two-T7-cassette construct (pET-Ds-Cro) for strain stability under scale-up. They used AlphaFold3, PrankWeb and CB-Dock2 to guide semi-rational mutagenesis of the rate-limiting CsCCD2 enzyme, with the N366G mutant giving a 1.13-fold yield increase confirmed by HPLC. The commercial side is unusually disciplined for a high-school team: a named B2B beachhead, a filed and accepted patent application on the CsCCD2 mutant, two physical MVPs with full formula tables, and an explicit separation of what is designed from what is still unvalidated. They won Best Entrepreneurship and Best Presentation in the High School section.

**frameworks.** Lean Canvas (problem, solution, UVP, key metrics, customer segments, channels, unfair advantage, cost structure, revenue streams), TAM-SAM-SOM with an explicit refusal to take a percentage of the macro market, SWOT, a risk-assessment matrix, a stage-gated Gantt chart from 2026 to 2032, three named exit options, and Techno-Economic Analysis plus Life Cycle Assessment named as future obligations.

**datascience.** HPLC quantification of crocetin as the core analytical readout; mutant screening comparing predicted variants against measured titre (N366G at 1.13x). No fermentation kinetics model or cost model with numbers.

**dataviz.** Nineteen numbered entrepreneurship figures: pathway maps for the two-plasmid and single-plasmid constructs, the biomanufacturing-to-application three-stage chain, a capability-gap table, a partnership-network map with a disclaimer about which relationships are confirmed, a risk matrix, a SWOT quadrant and an SDG panel. HPLC chromatograms carry the quantitative claims.

**ihp.** Five explicitly staged iHP phases, each written as motivation, action and integration, with dates and named interlocutors. Phase I traced the supply chain to source: an online interview with Iranian saffron grower Ali Norouzi (17 March) produced concrete constraints (15-20 day harvest window, 1-2 g dried saffron per person per day, water shortage, currency volatility), and visits to Daofengtang Rende TCM Clinic and chain pharmacies produced a real price point of 60-90 RMB per gram and the observation that pharmacies barely stock it. Phase II is the strongest: after near-zero crocetin yield on 12 May, Dr Huang Danqiong diagnosed metabolic burden and plasmid instability and told them to collapse to a single plasmid, which they did; Prof Huang Guanqin then reviewed the single-plasmid circuit against scale-up cost on 20 June; Fapon's technical director on 22 July pushed them off blind screening onto AI-guided rational design. Phase III used Associate Professor Li Chenyang twice to kill an unstable aqueous formulation on physicochemical grounds and pick the oil and capsule routes, and a perfumer, Ms Weng, taught the actual blending process. Phase IV took the business plan to Attorney Zhang on 17 September for NMPA/FDA classification, licensing and labelling risk, which changed their claims language across the wiki and social media. This is iHP that visibly rewrote both the construct and the marketing copy.

**publicEngagement.** An online survey plus street interviews run 12-17 March 2026 across mixed demographics found over 60 percent of respondents had never heard of crocetin and routinely confused it with crocin, and that over 40 percent would pay only 5-10 RMB per day for a mood-soothing product. That cognitive gap triggered a dedicated education page and a Xiaohongshu (Rednote) account translating biosynthesis into public infographics. They also presented at the 10th iSCRM and the 1st Grand APiC conference, and built peer resources after hearing that team members elsewhere felt unsure their assigned role mattered.

**realWorld.** This is a real venture attempt, not a canvas exercise. The business model is specifically B2B-first: the beachhead is small-to-medium functional skincare brands and boutique cosmetic R&D labs, chosen because they have shorter decision cycles than multinationals, and the first deliverable is explicitly not a consumer product but standardised samples plus HPLC chromatograms to support a customer's own formulation prototyping. Market evidence is real but qualitative: interviews across the full chain (Iranian grower, TCM clinic and pharmacies, boutique formulators, Fapon, an iGEM-mentor founder, a lawyer), a public survey with reported percentages and a willingness-to-pay band, and a visit to Shenzhen University's fermentation facility. They refuse to multiply the roughly USD 2.0 billion TAM by a made-up share and instead say SOM must be computed from reachable R&D nodes times sample volume per test, which is the correct instinct even though they then do not finish the arithmetic. Hard assets exist: a patent application, Carotenoid Cleavage Dioxygenase 2 Mutant, Preparation Method and Application, filed and accepted, and two physical MVPs with published formula tables down to percentages (essence oil at 0.03 percent crocetin, 0.5 percent vitamin E in cold-pressed olive oil; capsule at 70 percent crocetin-olive oil, 15 percent L-theanine, 13 percent soy lecithin, 2 percent vitamin E). The regulatory path is credible and specific, naming NMPA and FDA classification, production and distribution licensing, and the prohibition on medical claims, with a consequence they actually implemented, standardising functional claims site-wide. The continuation plan is a stage-gated Gantt from 2026 lab validation through 2027 customer testing, 2028 CDMO pilot and 2029 B2B commercialisation to 2030-2032 international registration, where each gate has named prerequisite resources and a numeric-in-principle pass condition, plus three exit routes (trade sale to BASF, Givaudan or DSM-Firmenich; technology licensing with royalties; VC/PE buyout). What is genuinely missing is the money: there are no unit economics, no cost of goods, no price per gram, no funding raised, no registered entity and no incubator place, and the partnership map carries its own honest disclaimer that everything except university support and paid service relationships is a prospective contact rather than a formal agreement. They also list, in their own words, the data still absent before industrialisation, including yield, purity, recovery, batch consistency and pilot-scale mutant validation. Even the downside is faced squarely, including the possibility that fermentation's carbon footprint exceeds agriculture's and that cheap biomanufacturing could destroy saffron growers' livelihoods, for which they propose market segmentation that leaves the high-end plant premium alone.

**給 GEMS：** Copy their honesty architecture: a 'Current Validation Status' block that splits completed designs from data still required, and a partnership map annotated to say which relationships are confirmed and which are merely prospective contacts. Pair it with their stage-gate habit, where each phase of the roadmap names its prerequisite resources and the single pass condition that unlocks the next phase, so a project cannot drift forward on enthusiasm.

### CalPolySLO — Accessible Science: Expanding the Synthetic Cell Toolkit for All
Undergrad · United States · https://2026.igem.wiki/calpolyslo/
Cal Poly SLO built a cell-free and synthetic-cell platform aimed at putting synthetic cells into undergraduate hands. The science problem is that PURE-type cell-free reactions run out of energy and that commercial creatine-phosphate regeneration is one of the most expensive parts of the kit, so the team screened a library of polyphosphate kinase 2 (PPK2) enzymes, filtered from roughly 18,000 sequences down to 16 phylogenetically diverse candidates, that regenerate ATP from cheap inorganic polyphosphate. To compare those enzymes they had to build the measurement first: a scalable, interference-corrected luciferase ATP assay with matched standard curves, published protocols, OpenTrons scripts and Excel templates. They also designed a 3D-printed emulsification 'washboard' and a tip-wipe recovery step to make hand-made vesicles reproducible, and wrote the whole thing into CHEM 471, a new undergraduate synthetic-cell lab course.

**frameworks.** Design-Build-Test-Learn applied separately to the assay, to the 3D-printed emulsification device (v0 to v8) and to the course materials; an explicit 'problem -> approach -> solution -> outcome' framing on every major page; measurement treated as a prerequisite for enzyme screening rather than a reporting step; Human Practices feedback logged as 'feedback -> action' pairs that changed protocols.

**datascience.** The core contribution is an ATP assay that was validated before it was trusted. Three quench methods were compared head to head (cold dilution, 95 C heat stop, EDTA chelation) by sampling a DrPPK2 reaction at fixed reaction times and then varying the hold time before adding CellTiter-Glo; a flat line means the reaction stopped, a rising line means it did not. EDTA was chosen because it scales to 16 enzymes in pre-poured plates, and the concentration was then tuned from 10 mM to 5 mM when enzyme load dropped from 50 to 7.5 ng/uL. The team then defined the assay's reliable ATP range by testing whether they could extend Promega's 10 nM to 1 uM window in either direction, found they could not (0.061 nM ATP still read above 10,000 RLU; the 100 uM standard deviated from linearity), and committed to reading only inside that range and never extrapolating, discarding data that fell outside. Because EDTA, AMP and ADP all suppress luciferase, every sample is compared against ATP standards prepared at the same pre-reagent EDTA concentration and the same substrate concentration, and the ratio of slopes gives per-condition correction factors (tabulated for all eight AMP and ADP levels at both 1:25 and 1:50 dilutions, e.g. AMP CF 0.0822 at 2 mM and 0.6113 at 0.0156 mM) that are hard-coded into the published Excel templates. Correcting recovers the kinetic trend that inhibition had destroyed: the same DrPPK2 AMP dataset moves from Km 0.020 mM / Vmax 5.66 uM/min uncorrected to Km 0.139 mM / Vmax 23.2 uM/min corrected, and the 2 mM AMP point is openly excluded from the fit because the correction does not fully recover it. Benchmark kinetics are reported with R2 (DrPPK2 ADP Km 0.985 mM, Vmax 11.7 uM/min, R2 0.9894; ManPPK2 ADP Km 2.67 mM, Vmax 42.6 uM/min, R2 0.9993; FtPPK2 ADP Km 3.16 mM, Vmax 80.05 uM/min, R2 0.9963). Reproducibility was tested as an experiment in its own right: three team members ran the same full-range assay on the same enzyme aliquot on the same day, giving Km 0.0775 +/- 0.0145 mM and Vmax 8.62 +/- 1.39 uM/min, and the team states plainly that these do not match the earlier full-range values and lists the candidate causes (different purification batch, new polyP lot, new AMP lot) as unresolved. Microscopy is handled by a named pipeline, CellScope, which runs Cellpose segmentation at 1.332 um/pixel after 4x downsampling, exports one row per object per timepoint to parquet (over a million objects on one plate), applies a QC gate on diameter 5 to 60 um, circularity 0.80 to 1.25 and no saturated pixels, reports each well as fold over its own background, and runs a two-mode (delta-BIC) test for subpopulations; a dedicated figure documents a case where the segmentation silently failed on a visibly good well, which the team published rather than hid. Every bulk plate carries a 0.125 uM fluorescein well as a dye reference, and the wiki maintains an explicit glossary distinguishing RFU (plate reader) from AU (microscope) as non-comparable units.

**dataviz.** Interactive charts embedded in the wiki (per-condition time courses, Michaelis-Menten fits, reproducibility datasets) with selectable conditions; side-by-side uncorrected vs corrected Michaelis-Menten fits; log-scaled ATP standard curves; per-cell log10 GFP scatter plots across 24 timepoints with per-timepoint median lines and a dashed per-plate subpopulation threshold; a two-clock explainer diagram teaching readers how to read the quench-validation figures; SolidWorks drawings of every finalized 3D-printed part.

**software.** OpenTrons OT-2 Python protocols for dilution-plate creation and dilution execution (full-range and confirmatory, four enzymes), published as .py downloads; Excel analysis templates for the full-range AMP, full-range ADP and confirmatory assays with correction factors built in; a master-mix calculator, titration design workbooks, plate-map template and osmolarity worksheet; the CellScope image-analysis pipeline (Cellpose segmentation, OzaLabCP/Imageanalysis) with a published vesicle_pipeline.txt; STL files for the washboard insert and rubber-band sled; raw time-course data and raw image data/masks released. All downloads are collected on https://2026.igem.wiki/calpolyslo/downloads and the lab manuals are released under CC BY 4.0.

**ihp.** Consultations with ethicists, legal and biosecurity scholars and industry scientists were run as feedback-to-action pairs. Dr Hank Greely advised publishing safety and containment thinking before starting work, so the team published aims, protocols, lab manuals and safety forms. Dr Ryan Jenkins recommended survivability testing as risk-assessment evidence, so the team tested whether synthetic cells survive outside the tube across pH, salinity and real environmental water samples (Los Osos Creek wetland, Avila Beach ocean water, campus pond, tap and deionised water) and found the cells lyse outside pH 7 +/- 1, at seawater salinity and in every environmental sample; he also prompted a lab-notebook safety checklist. Dr Keith Robison raised dual-use scenarios, which produced a benefits-vs-misuse framework. Dr Tae Seok Moon raised public perception, which produced IRB-approved surveys (Cal Poly IRB #2026-194 and #2026-195) of 10 CSHL Summer Synthetic Biology participants and 30 Cal Poly FSURP students on comfort, trust and regulation. Dr Zachary Sun's view that education may be the realistic near-term application reshaped the project's scope toward enzyme characterisation and teaching.

**publicEngagement.** The team designed CHEM 471: Engineering Synthetic Cells, described as the first known undergraduate synthetic-cell course in the US, wrote and tested ten open-licence (CC BY 4.0) lab manuals plus an instructor packet with prep lists, reagent costs, timing and common failure points, taught it to ten students in spring 2026, and surveyed them before and after. Confidence rose in 9 of 12 skills; the three that did not became design inputs. Students rated fluorescence microscopy lower at the end than at the start, so the microscope protocols were rewritten and re-tested by the team's least experienced members; manual cytosol-recipe maths was replaced by auto-scaling Excel calculators; NanoOrange/A280 protein quantification was replaced with a Bradford assay plus BSA standard curve; and the Promega AMP/ADP protocol was replaced with the team's own real-time assay. A student's suggestion became the tip-wipe oil-removal method that was then tested against the standard method.

**realWorld.** The framing throughout is cost of access rather than novelty: PPK2 plus polyphosphate is pursued because it lowers the price floor of cell-free protein synthesis, and the 3D-printed washboard replaces a hand-raking step that varies between operators. The course is explicitly packaged as a template other undergraduate institutions can adopt, with reagent costs and set-up in an instructor packet, and the full protocol set released so other programmes can either reproduce the six enzyme-characterisation experiments or swap in their own enzymes. Six characterised PPK2 enzymes and sixteen candidate-panel enzymes are deposited as registry parts with their datasets linked.

**給 GEMS：** Before comparing anything, prove the measurement: validate the quench, establish the instrument's honest linear range and refuse to extrapolate outside it, then build a separate standard curve for every interfering condition and hard-code the resulting correction factors into the analysis template you ship. Then test reproducibility by handing the written protocol to people who have never run it, and publish the disagreement when their numbers differ from yours.

### DTU-Denmark — Enzymatic degradation of wind turbine blade epoxy
Overgrad · Denmark · https://2026.igem.wiki/dtu-denmark/
DTU engineered laccases (ItL-03 from a spruce bark beetle gut metagenome, CueO variants and homologues) and unspecific peroxygenases (PaDa-I, WamPa, PabUPO-II, MroUPO, Fett) to attack the amine crosslinks of cured epoxy from wind turbine blades, layered on top of a published acid-plus-peroxide solvolysis pretreatment. They used NNBT, a small water-soluble molecule carrying the tertiary amine of the crosslink, as a defined model substrate, and showed by MALDI-TOF that PaDa-I performs N-dealkylation on it with Purpald confirmation of lactaldehyde release. The decisive work is a prospective comparative life-cycle assessment in SimaPro (ReCiPe 2016 Midpoint H) of five end-of-life routes, which found their own enzymatic route is NOT the best option on almost any indicator - and they published that. Seven interviews across DTU Wind, DTU Sustain, DTU Chemistry, SDU and industry, plus documented non-responses from Siemens Gamesa, Orsted and MAKEEN Energy, drove changes to the chemical target, the model substrate, the host organism, the enzyme-ranking criterion and the project's stated goal.

**frameworks.** 在徵詢 2025 年隊伍乾實驗室負責人的建議後，確立三條並行的酵素探索管線：「容易」路線為文獻中已知能氧化相關鍵結的酵素，「中等」路線為同源蛋白探勘，「困難」路線為理性工程與生成式設計。此外還有一項前瞻式比較 LCA（SimaPro、ReCiPe 2016 Midpoint H，功能單位為葉片質量，切割／運輸／金屬分離因在各路線間相同而排除），以及一個以 Kremser 方程式建立的逆流溶劑萃取段模型。

**datascience.** 以 UniProt、Pfam 與 BLAST 做序列探勘，而非總體基因組資料庫；以多序列比對把 PaDa-I 的有機溶劑耐受突變轉移到 GroGu 與 PabUPO-II 上；以一套新的底物進入通道探索流程取代以嵌合親和力排序；分子動力學模擬；在 DTU HPC 上執行生成式酵素設計。每一個 LCA 參數都連同來源、來源與實際用途之間的落差，以及一個「最弱環節」標籤一併公開（例如分配係數取自 1980 年一篇使用 MIBK 而非乙酸乙酯的酚萃取論文，明確標示出來）。

**dataviz.** 一張可互動點擊的製程流程圖，可由五路線總覽放大到各酵素路線，每個方塊上都標出參數（酸的莫耳濃度、溫度、滯留時間、以 mg/L 表示的酵素投加量、再利用次數、回收率）；每一項 SDG 各自一張圖，負擔畫在零線以上、效益畫在零線以下；還有一張可互動的利害關係人地圖，點選圖釘即展開該場訪談，並以顏色標示互動狀態，讓無回應者仍然看得見。

**software.** LCA 的輸入資料、假設與對映程式碼皆以開源釋出，讓其他隊伍能在 SimaPro 或其他工具中重建模型；講座、工作坊與指南則整理在貢獻頁面上。

**ihp.** DTU 的 IHP 是一條決策軌跡，而不是一本訪客簽到簿：每一張訪談卡都附有明確的「落實」清單，另有一個專節說明他們「選擇不走」的方向。最大的一次轉向來自 Dr Javier（DTU Sustain 博士後，該組少數研究樹脂化學而非玻璃纖維回收的人）在 2026 年 3 月 3 日與 6 月 24 日的兩場訪談。他提出了團隊認為整個專案中最犀利的實驗問題——酵素能否取代裂解溶劑，直接作用在已膨潤但仍交聯的網狀結構上？——並建議他們從文獻中記載完整的前處理出發，而不是自己發明一套，再在上面疊加酵素。結果是一次徹底的重新定位：酵素步驟不再是獨立的降解主張，而成為溶劑分解的補充，並新增一個明確目標——測試酵素能否取代部分溶劑裂解步驟，同時開出第二條研究線，為酵素工程化出溶劑耐受性。Justine Beauson（DTU Wind 複合材料製造與測試資深研究員）是第一位聯繫對象；她確認現在退役下來的正是熱固性環氧樹脂，把團隊轉介給一家風機原廠（OEM），並在 10 月 6 日的電子郵件追問中說明，Blade Material Passport 的編製完全沒有考慮處置問題，只會告訴你葉片是環氧樹脂，卻絕不會給你配方——這正是團隊放棄去比對真實葉片樹脂的原因，也是「生產業與廢棄物管理業之間的協作」成為永續頁面核心主張的原因。接著 Jesper Kjaer Jorgensen（DTU 複合材料博士後）提供了完全固化的 SWANCOR 2519-1A/BS，一款無保密協議限制的商用胺固化雙酚 A 環氧樹脂，並同意團隊的假說：三級胺交聯是脆弱點。團隊直言「沒有那些方塊，我們手上要麼沒有可用的材料，要麼是另一種材料」，標的也因此從環氧樹脂主鏈轉到胺類交聯，改變了他們要攻擊哪些鍵結、如何量測降解，以及期望回收哪些產物。Robert（真核分子細胞生物學博士生）給出最嚴厲的現實檢驗——熱固性材料降解已被大量研究、該領域有許多缺少對照、底物未經鑑定的低品質論文，而一個六個月的學生專案不可能跑完整的總體基因組探索——團隊的回應逐條列出：他們篩選約 33 個酵素而非數千個、以公開資料庫而非總體基因組資料庫為起點、採用比色分析而非螢光報告子、加入 MALDI-TOF，並讓博士後而非學生執行危害性的環氧樹脂前處理。Carlos G. Acevedo-Rocha（BRIGHT 計算蛋白質工程資深研究員）告訴他們不要把結論建立在嵌合親和力數值上，因為那與實驗活性並無顯著相關，同時認可他們早期階段的通道探索流程：於是他們放棄以 Boltz-2 親和力分數篩選同源候選的計畫，改以通道幾何加上分子動力學重建候選篩選。Cecilia Castellvi Domingo（研究 UPO 異源表現的博士生）改變了宿主與操作流程——改用帶 episomal AP17 骨架的 Komagataella phaffii，而非 S. cerevisiae 或 E. coli；第 5 天而非第 6 天收取以減少蛋白水解；降低誘導溫度；以及 CO 差異光譜分析，讓他們得到正確折疊、含血基質酵素的直接量測值（六倍濃縮樣品中為 0.019 uM），這是活性分析做不到的。Lykke Margot Ricard（SDU 永續創新副教授，曾為丹麥環保署盤點丹麥葉片處理選項）問了「接手的人是誰？」，於是每條工作線都被要求指名一項可回收的產物、它需要達到的品質，以及可能的買家——這也是團隊主張理想製程應回收產物而非焚燒殘渣的原因。歐洲環境署答覆說他們並未掌握退役葉片管理的資料、WEEE 指令並不涵蓋風力機、也沒有專門的歐盟法規，因此不存在通報義務；團隊於是在 LCA 中把掩埋比例標記為無法驗證的輸入，而不是引用一個數字。最不尋常的是，他們把自己接觸失敗的部分也公開了：Siemens Gamesa 從未回信，在 DSE 就業博覽會上也沒有相關專家；Orsted 沒有人能談葉片生命終期；MAKEEN Energy 未回覆。團隊直接寫出，對採用與否影響力最大的那些群體「因此也是我們討論中代表性最低的，限制了我們的分析」，並把這些缺口標示在利害關係人地圖上——該圖分別以對採用的影響力與興趣程度評比每個群體，連回收化合物的潛在買家也標為「未知」，因為尚未有證據顯示市場存在。

**publicEngagement.** 教育瞄準的是這個專案所揭露的特定盲點，而不是泛泛的合成生物學：團隊走訪國際高中，講授風電產業的生命終期排放，以及及早以完整永續循環來思考的觀念；一場 Lifelong Learning 工作坊則把同樣關於低衝擊回收的討論帶給在職專業人士。對 iGEM 社群，他們辦了 BioBrick 工作坊、一場智慧財產權入門課（Protecting Your Ideas）、一場 World Cafe 形式的隊際圓桌，以及一集 podcast，並在 Nordic iGEM Conference 上報告。State of Green 則提供了舞台，讓他們把葉片廢棄物問題帶到部會、學界與能源業人士面前。

**realWorld.** 需求是被量化的瓶頸，而不是一句口號：丹麥的葉片廢棄物目前進入混合廢棄物掩埋場，或以卡車與渡輪運往國外；丹麥風電業自願性的掩埋禁令自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起生效；丹麥環保署的篩查在葉片材料的每一次槽式浸出試驗中都檢出雙酚 A；而歐洲環境署確認，在《循環經濟法》修訂 WEEE 之前，歐盟對風力機廢棄物根本沒有任何法規或通報義務。各項 SDG 都以團隊自己 LCA 的數字逐一標的論證，而最醒目的發現是多數隊伍會藏起來的：在工業規模放大的基準情境（推估至約 2035 年）下，酵素路線每公斤葉片排放 2.1 kg CO2 eq，相較溶劑分解為 1.4、熱裂解為 0.9；人體致癌毒性增加 0.38 人當量，相較溶劑分解為 0.022；用水量多約 36%；而水泥共處理在幾乎每一項指標上都最佳——於是他們明白寫出，酵素路線與溶劑分解是唯二有明顯淨負擔的路線，將熱點追溯到 H2O2 供應鏈與 UPO 生產，並把它轉化為研究方向（提高 UPO 生產效率、回收產物而非焚燒殘渣、重複使用固定化酵素並計算損益兩平的再利用次數）。SDG 標的與他們自己的資料一對一對應，涵蓋 SDG 3（危害性化學物質致病）、6（用水效率）、7（再生能源佔比與潔淨能源研究合作）、8（Energy Transition Alliance 估計英國葉片回收產業可為離岸風電 2030 年 6 萬個就業目標再增加 2 萬個工作機會）、9、12、13、14、15 與 17。限制條件寫在 SDG 分析之內，而非埋在角落：反應產物未知、未在真實葉片材料上展示酵素效能、只用一種葉片類型、運輸被系統邊界排除、微塑膠與 BPA 浸出未被 ReCiPe 納入特徵化，以及在截斷模型中沒有對玻璃纖維作為資源的損失給予懲罰。接下來的走向：LCA 的輸入、假設與對映程式碼皆為開源；OEM 的要求（能以合理成本與速度處理多材料葉片）被記錄為未來開發的需求而非已達成的成果；與 State of Green、Center for Biosolutions 及 DTU 的關係則被描述為可在 iGEM 之後延續的合作。

**給 GEMS：** Run a comparative LCA against the incumbent technologies early enough that it can still change the research plan, and publish it even when it says your own route loses - then convert each losing indicator into a named engineering target, and record the stakeholders who never replied so the gaps in your evidence base are visible rather than invisible.

### GreatBay-SCIE — Expelliodor — 除去體味，由你決定
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/greatbay-scie/
腋下體味的成因是 Staphylococcus hominis 透過胜肽運輸蛋白 PepTSh 把無味的前驅物 Cys-Gly-3M3SH 送進細胞，再轉換成 3M3SH。GreatBay-SCIE 沒有選擇殺死皮膚細菌，而是從三個方向攻擊這個攝入步驟：一個從頭設計的小分子結合蛋白把前驅物隔離起來、一個從頭設計的蛋白質結合子把 PepTSh 鎖在朝內的構形、以及一個經改造的環糊精葡萄糖轉移酶（CGTase）為前驅物加上糖基，使運輸蛋白不再認得它。這是本屆所有高中隊伍中最精巧的從頭蛋白質設計工作——RFdiffusion3、Proteina-Complexa、ProteinMPNN、RoseTTAFold3 共折疊、搭配 MM/GBSA 的 50 ns 分子動力學，以及由 SPURS 指引的熱穩定性工程——並圍繞他們自創的兩套框架組織起來：在 DBTL 之前加上一個 Characterize（特性描述）階段，以及一條漏斗狀、設有決策關卡的流程，讓昂貴的方法只花在通過便宜方法篩選的候選上。實際進入體外測試的有九個前驅物結合子與五個運輸蛋白結合子，其中 9 個中有 4 個、5 個中有 4 個顯著降低了 3M3SH。

**frameworks.** 兩項方法論貢獻框定了全部工作。CHARACTERIZE-DBTL 框架在 Design 之前插入一個階段，內含四個子階段——問題界定（設計必須達成什麼、在什麼情境下、有哪些可介入的切入點）、標的界定（要工程改造的確切分子、蛋白質、構形狀態、介面或反應，並劃出邊界）、機制特性描述（依實驗、結構與運算證據評估所提機制的合理性），以及設計規格（把上述一切轉譯為明確要求，直接成為設計工具的輸入）。DECISION-GATED WORKFLOW（設有決策關卡的流程）則是一個漏斗，其中每一道後續評估都比前一道更昂貴，因此一大批生成結果先被便宜的共折疊指標篩掉，之後才有東西進入分子動力學，最後只有少數幾個上實驗檯——他們明白說這是因為自己是濕實驗資源有限的高中隊伍。Characterize 階段在三條路線上都帶來具體收穫。在前驅物結合子方面，特性描述確立了 3M3SH 以兩種氣味不同的立體異構物存在，其中帶汗味與洋蔥味的 (S) 型才是與體味相關的那一種，而深度學習設計工具經常引入立體化學錯誤——因此設計規格就寫成「以立體化學明確定義的 Cys-Gly-(S)-3M3SH 作為輸入，並在結構生成後、任何候選晉級之前，先驗證配體掌性」。他們並行跑了兩條獨立的設計路線以作比較：RFdiffusion3（經由 Rosetta Foundry，以 ProteinMPNN 重新設計序列、以 RoseTTAFold3 共折疊驗證，並依 RF3 自身的 ranking_score 排序）與 Proteina-Complexa（一個部分潛在的流匹配模型，依自訂的複合分數排序）。兩條路線中最佳的結合子都進入 50 ns 分子動力學，以配體 RMSD 與 MM/GBSA 結合自由能評分。在運輸蛋白結合子方面，特性描述引用已發表的分子動力學研究，顯示由內向外的轉換是 PepTSh 運輸循環的速率決定步驟，因此穩定住朝內狀態應可阻斷運輸；他們取用實驗測得的朝內晶體結構（PDB 6EXS），在 SWISS-MODEL 中建出朝外的同源模型，兩者相比以找出只在朝內狀態存在的胞外靜電網絡（K64-E323，以及 R184/D182/E340/R337 這組）與疏水區塊——這些就成了標的介面，規格則訂為 80-120 個殘基的結合子，並偏好結構緊緻的設計，以提升穿過革蘭氏陽性細胞壁的可及性。設計流程為 RFdiffusion3 生成骨架、ProteinMPNN 設計序列、RF3 共折疊、介面位置過濾，再以 0.50 x 標準化 ranking score + 0.25 x 標準化 pLDDT + 0.25 x 標準化 PAE 倒數的複合分數排序，最後進入分子動力學。在 CGTase 方面，特性描述列舉了前驅物上三個可修飾的官能基（胺基、羧基、羥基），並依與實際應用環境的相容性來挑選反應——弱酸性的人體皮膚，沒有外來的 ATP 或 NADH 供應——這排除了需要輔因子的化學反應，剩下由 CGTase 進行的羥基轉糖基化；以 1CXL 為模板的分子對接並對結合姿態做群聚分析，接著對野生型複合物做分子動力學，顯示這個非天然受質能穩定地容納在催化口袋中，也指出哪些交互作用較弱（羧酸根附近與疏水尾端），這些就成了九個點突變體的理性設計標的，每一個都再以分子動力學重新評估。之後還有兩輪最佳化：CGTase 的熱穩定性以 SPURS（一個 AI 穩定性預測模型）進行，先排除保守殘基、配體結合殘基與配位鈣離子的殘基，再以 FireProt 式的兩兩相容性過濾，並用保留多樣性的 beam search 在 2、4、6、8 個取代的深度上組裝多點突變體；前驅物結合子的親和力則以改寫過的 LASErMPNN 神經網絡校讀策略進行，對配體 5 埃以內的位點做飽和點突變，跨不同解碼順序與 dropout 平均機率以降低對單一預測的敏感度，依 delta-NLL = ln[P(a)/P(b)] 排序，並濾掉那些被引入卻沒有合適氫鍵的埋藏極性殘基。

**datascience.** 此處真正不尋常之處在於，團隊把自己的評分指標當成有待用濕實驗資料檢驗的假說，並在結果不利於自己時也誠實公開。原計畫 22 個結合子（每套設計工具 11 個）中有 9 個受測；9 個中有 4 個顯著降低 3M3SH 生成，運輸蛋白結合子則是 5 個中有 4 個，最大降幅 21%。把指標對結果做相關分析，答案隨路線而異：在 RFdiffusion3 這一支，介面指標與實驗一致，三個分子動力學指標（MM/GBSA 的 delta-G，以及 10-50 ns 間配體 RMSD 的平均值與標準差）都呈現預期趨勢；而在 Proteina-Complexa 這一支，自訂的複合分數相關性最好（Pearson r = 0.76、Spearman rho = 0.60），但分子動力學指標卻不一致——團隊並提出一個具體的機制性解釋：RF3（與 RoseTTAFold3 一樣是擴散模型）對 Proteina-Complexa（部分潛在的流匹配）的輸出可能預測得較不準，因此配體 RMSD 有部分可能量到的是一個不佳預測姿態的鬆弛過程、而非真正的不穩定。對運輸蛋白結合子，他們提出了更鋭利的統計教訓：「在一組已被篩選過的候選中，單一指標的變異量可能太小，不足以支撐對實際實驗表現的可信預測」——也就是說，拿某個指標當關卡篩選，會毀掉你驗證它所需的變異量。他們直白說明候選集太小「無法建立具統計顯著性的關係」、結果「無法確實驗證我們所設定的單一指標與加權指標是否有用」，並點名修正方向：更多次獨立的分子動力學、明確的熵修正、在自由能計算中加入隱式膜模型、第二個折疊工具（例如 AlphaFold），以及更大的資料集以重新校準權重。熱穩定性這部分在兩個方向上都得出真實且可解讀的結果：以 T370R/F183W 為親本時，WR2、WR4 與 WR8 都優於親本、WR8 最佳，顯示 SPURS（以兩兩突變資料訓練）可以學到能外推到多點突變體的規律，也顯示該設計引入了有益的上位效應；但以 T370K 為親本時只有 KR2 改善，更高階的突變體則沒有，團隊診斷這是 beam search 的路徑依賴性——在深度 4 引入的一個無效突變，會被每一個更深的突變體繼承。他們對構築失敗同樣坦白：原本要做的 T370K 突變體回來時變成 T370L，因此只有 T370R/F183W 是依設計受測，理性設計的假說「因資料集有限而未完全驗證」。

**dataviz.** 結構圖是當成論證使用、不是裝飾。朝內與朝外的 PepTSh 比較畫成四張對齊的面板——朝內結構、其完整靜電網絡的特寫（虛線標示接觸、並標出殘基名稱）、朝外的同源模型，以及同一區域顯示那些接觸已斷開的特寫——讓讀者自己看出為什麼朝內狀態才是值得穩定的那一個；配色（綠色 C 端束、藍色 N 端束、橘色 TMA/TMB）在每張面板間保持一致。標的介面接著以三種方式呈現：在整體結構上標出該區域、一張以箭頭標示胞外方向的側視圖，以及一張特寫，圖中橘色的熱點殘基圍繞著綠色的疏水區塊。Characterize 階段與漏斗狀的決策關卡流程各畫成一張示意圖，漏斗明顯隨每道評估關卡收窄。三套系統的分子動力學軌跡都以影片內嵌。最有價值的是圖 7 與圖 11，把運算指標對實驗結果作圖——A412 訊號降幅，計算方式為 100 x (1 - 結合子 A412 平均值 / 對照 A412 平均值)——每個受測結合子為一個點，附 OLS 迴歸線，並同時報告 Pearson r 與 Spearman rho，兩條設計路線分開呈現。每則圖說都給出 n 值（RFdiffusion3 為 n = 4，Proteina-Complexa 與運輸蛋白結合子為 n = 5），並把完整的複合分數公式連同權重寫出來，使圖可以被重新推導。試驗圖都帶誤差棒（+/- SD，n = 3）並定義顯著性星號。

**software.** FoundryUI 是一套以節點為基礎的視覺化程式設計工作台，用於從頭蛋白質設計，明確受 ComfyUI 啟發（並以 Blender 與 GameMaker 作為把技術流程變得平易近人的先例）。它把 Rosetta Foundry 的四個工具——RFdiffusion3、RoseTTAFold3、ProteinMPNN 與 LigandMPNN——包裝成可互連的節點，涵蓋輸入、生成、序列重新設計、折疊、過濾、視覺化與儲存，連接有型別、會拒絕不相容的連線；並提供 3D 選取器，讓殘基與原子可以直接在介面上從結構點選、而不必以索引輸入；還有工作階段與執行紀錄，使結果在連線中斷後仍然保留。它內附預建的工作流程，涵蓋配體結合子設計、蛋白質結合子設計、酵素設計、MPNN 序列設計與折疊預測，並可讀寫 PDB、FASTA、mmCIF、SMILES、JSON 與 CSV，讓輸出在別處仍然可用。他們聲明的動機中，協作與易用性同樣重要：命令列不會顯示某一步為何被選擇、資料如何在各階段之間流動，而一張流程圖會——這讓工作流程更容易解釋、修改並交給下一屆隊伍。他們用教學來測試它：FoundryUI 被用在校內社團的教育活動中，讓學生能透過生物學上的決策、而不是透過指令來接觸蛋白質建模。所有自動化腳本都以可重複使用的工作流程上傳，供未來的 iGEM 隊伍取用。

**ihp.** 46 次利害關係人互動，涵蓋本地與國際問卷、潛在客戶訪談、專家討論、產業會議、書面提案與社群講座，組織成一套五階段框架，並依「他們如何影響團隊」與「團隊如何影響他們」把利害關係人分成四類，最後附一個「Feedback to Future」段落，說明他們如何決定要優先處理哪些意見，以及如何回頭再找利害關係人反思。整合確實發生過的最明確證據是，它改了專題自己的名字：他們一開始用「Expelliodor — Expel the Odor」，之後在社會科學研究者就汙名化提問的促使下，自問「expel（除去）」是否暗示體味是每個人都該消除的東西，以及為什麼腋下體味要被用和髮色或眼睛顏色不同的標準評價。他們的結論是，腋下體味是自然的生理特徵、不是待矯正的缺陷，要不要處理它應該是個人選擇，於是把標語改成「Expel the Odor, on Your Terms」——保留科學目標，同時加上個人自主。醫學專家推動安全性，產業人士推動實際可行性，而整個「不廣泛抑制皮膚細菌、不阻塞汗腺」的設計哲學，正是從這些交流而來。

**publicEngagement.** 本隊獲包容性獎，整套工作建立在一個框架（LIFT+：Learn、Intervene、Feedback、Transfer、Beyond）之上，並指名六個在中國可觸及、且在接觸合成生物學時面臨障礙的對象群體——盲人社群、聽障社群、自閉症譜系兒童、社會經濟弱勢者、建模初學者，以及受正式教育有限的年長者。每個群體都由一位出身該社群的真實科學家開場，並搭配一項有出處的統計數據：Wanda Diaz Merced，開創以聲音化呈現天文資料的盲人天文物理學家，對應的數據是全球僅 2.1% 的盲童能取得特殊教育服務；Temple Grandin，對應自閉症者四年制大學的 14.95% 入學率；Derek Braun，建立 Gallaudet 第一座分子遺傳學實驗室的聽障遺傳學家，對應中低所得國家約 80% 學齡聽障兒童未就學；FLi Sci 創辦人 Gabriel Reyes，對應 OECD 資料中弱勢學生有 37% 的科學表現落後、優勢學生則為 12%；以及只受過高中教育的周口店古人類學家賈蘭坡，對應 55-64 歲與 25-34 歲成人在高等教育上 17 個百分點的世代落差。成果包括為盲人社群製作的 20 張觸覺生物學圖、涵蓋 5 大類 20 個主題，以及——直接與其乾實驗相連——以 FoundryUI 作為運算蛋白質設計初學者的教學載體。該頁面本身同時提供互動動畫版與純文字替代版，這正是把包容性原則套用在自己的 wiki 上。

**realWorld.** 創業論證建立在族群遺傳學上、而不是模糊的市場規模：與體味相關的 ABCC11 等位基因在非洲族群出現率約 99.99%，歐洲 97.48%、大洋洲 96.05%、美洲 92.42%、南亞 62.22%、東亞 21.54%，因此即使在出現率最低的東亞，以絕對人口計仍可能有數千萬人受影響——而公眾認知不足又加劇了誤解、汙名與歧視。團隊把 Expelliodor 對照既有產品真正的失效模式來定位（以香味遮蓋、以鋁鹽止汗劑抑制排汗、以廣效抗菌劑擾亂腋下微生物相），並主張他們的三套策略在時間上互補：前驅物結合子捕捉已經存在的前驅物、CGTase 持續修飾新分泌的前驅物、運輸蛋白結合子則阻斷攝入。CGTase 的熱穩定性最佳化是專為工業生產與運輸而做，這也是儲存期間的耐熱性之所以成為設計目標的原因。

**給 GEMS：** 在 Design 之前加上一個 Characterize 階段：把生物機制、精確標的與應用環境寫下來，並轉成一份明確的設計規格，讓它直接成為工具的輸入——GreatBay 在規格中規定使用 (S) 立體異構物、並在生成後驗證掌性，這一步就擋掉了一整類無聲無息的 AI 設計錯誤。接著把你用過的每一個運算指標對濕實驗結果作圖、報告相關性，連同那個誠實的發現也一併報出：拿某個指標當關卡篩選，會把你驗證該指標所需的變異量給消掉。

### Oxford — NECTAR
Undergrad · United Kingdom · https://2026.igem.wiki/oxford/
NECTAR is a programmable RNAi pipeline: FORAGER (computational dsRNA design with off-target screening against the Apis mellifera transcriptome), microbial production in yeast, and delivery to hives in a pollen patty. Varroa destructor, the single biggest threat to honeybees, is the first real-world case study. The team built HIVE, an explicit four-step human-practices decision procedure (Hear, Investigate, Verdict, Evaluate) run over six open project questions with 28+ named stakeholders including US EPA/FDA/USDA staff, the Chair of the UK Advisory Committee on Releases to the Environment, and the Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity. Stakeholder evidence changed the chassis (living engineered Snodgrassella alvi to heat-inactivated yeast), the delivery format, the off-target screening stage, the survey instrument and the definition of success.

**frameworks.** FORAGER, a three-stage standardised dsRNA design pipeline: target gene identification (most abundant transcripts of well-connected genes, weighted by known Varroa RNAi data), within-gene region selection (endogenous Varroa siRNA sequence features, guide competence, RNAplfold target accessibility, combined as three equally weighted complementary evidence layers rather than one fused score), and off-target analysis. Also a BEEHAVE-based colony population model and a bespoke partial-equilibrium economic model.

**datascience.** Construction of a clean Varroa destructor small-RNA dataset from public sequencing, basic population feature analysis of that sRNA pool, sequence feature analysis, whole-region homology and local exact-match screening against the honeybee transcriptome (16-nt strict mapping plus relaxed whole-region similarity), BLAST-based non-target screening, and a documented limitations table stating that the three evidence layers are equally weighted only because no Varroa RNAi efficacy data existed to fit weights.

**dataviz.** Hand-drawn mechanism illustrations throughout (FORAGER stages, the five-step path of a dose through the hive, the SDG goal map), a geocoded stakeholder map with latitude/longitude per interviewee, and per-cycle engineering tables; the wiki is a custom React/Astro-style build with light and dark themes.

**software.** FORAGER is released with one file per stage and a documented frontmatter/body contract so other teams can re-run it; the HIVE method and its full interview question bank are released under CC BY 4.0. Hive insert and PCR-tube feeding adaptor are downloadable 3D-printable hardware.

**ihp.** Oxford's IHP is the strongest kind: a documented decision procedure with a mandatory 'How we implemented the advice to change NECTAR' field on every one of 28+ interview write-ups, and a rule that 'We considered their feedback is not an implementation'. The largest single change is the chassis. Danny Le Feuvre (CEO, Australian Honey Bee Industry Council) and Mike Allerton (VP and Biosecurity Officer, Amateur Beekeepers Australia) both preferred a persistent living engineered Snodgrassella alvi gut symbiont because it minimises beekeeper labour; the team did not simply follow them but took the question to regulators, and Laura Bowden (GM manager, Science and Advice for Scottish Agriculture), Elizabeth Frost (NSW Department of Primary Industries), Tom Hartley (Senior Certification Officer, Soil Association Certification) and the Scottish Government Honey Bee Health Team pushed the opposite way, so the team switched to heat-inactivated, dried engineered yeast and stated plainly what that cost: the persistence that made S. alvi attractive, meaning repeat dosing and more beekeeper labour, against the preference of beekeepers they had interviewed. Austein McLoughlin of the Convention on Biological Diversity Secretariat then confirmed the inactivated product is not a living modified organism under the Cartagena Protocol, but also refused to let the team stop at SDG alignment, pushing them to ask whether NECTAR produces 'measurable improvement' - which is why the sustainability analysis widened to the whole NECTAR lifecycle and built baseline comparisons into the modelling. A joint meeting with Mike Mendelsohn and Alan Reynolds (US EPA), Adam Moyer and Laura Epstein (FDA) and Alan Pearson (USDA) then 'prevented us from treating our shift to heat-inactivated yeast as a universal regulatory shortcut', forcing jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction regulatory mapping instead of one global classification. The deepest economic chain runs through Prof. Wally Thurman (Agricultural and Resource Economics, NC State, interviewed 29 July 2026) and Prof. Brittney Goodrich (Agricultural and Consumer Economics, Illinois, 7 August 2026): Thurman set five methodological commitments (start from an average commercial operation not an industry aggregate; use existing treatments as the counterfactual; assess costs and revenues not survival rates; use simple partial equilibrium; restrict to paid pollination markets), and Goodrich's operation-level cost structure redefined the cost of Varroa to include labour, colony replacement and lost honey and pollination revenue rather than just the price of acaricide. The team then ran the chain backwards - what a beekeeper can afford, to allowable cost per dose, to allowable manufacturing cost, to required mass of intact dsRNA per gram of dry yeast - converting 'high expression' into a pass/fail wet-lab specification of 0.005 mg dsRNA per g yeast for US viability and 0.05 mg/g for both markets, against a fermentation cost of about 2.33 USD per gram. They also deliberately recruited dissent: the Oxfordshire Natural Beekeeping Group (about 20 chemical-free hobbyists) and treatment-free beekeeper Mark Sandham argued that treating removes the selection pressure that would produce tolerant bees, an argument against the entire premise; rather than abandoning the project the team narrowed its target user to commercial operations and wrote that OxNatBees changed 'not the molecular mechanism of NECTAR, but the problem we believed NECTAR should - and should not - try to solve'. Smaller but equally traceable: Lord John Krebs (first FSA Chairman) and Prof. Jim Dunwell (Chair, ACRE) made environmental fate and off-target effects explicit engineering requirements, moving non-target organisms into the FORAGER off-target screening stage and adding in vivo dsRNA-persistence experiments; Prof. Paul Lam (environmental chemistry, Hong Kong Metropolitan University) drove the adoption of BLAST off-target screening and reframed public engagement as risk management rather than promotion; Dr Michael Morrison (HeLEX, Oxford Law) rewrote the survey instrument so it asked separately about pollen patties, constitutively active engineered bacteria and inducible engineered bacteria rather than about 'GMOs' in general; Dr Théotime Colin's point about secondary pests prompted dsRNA constructs for wax moth and small hive beetle; Prof. Giles Budge's reassurance kept the adult-bee oral delivery route alive and produced the 300/500/700 bp length comparison; and Melanie Teece (Head of Technical, Hilltop Honey) and Wade Ford (Hive & Wellness) turned honey purity into a reason for additional in vivo work. The published HIVE guide names its own failure modes (interviewing agreeable people, treating 'the public' as one stakeholder, letting the Verdict drift into a summary, consulting regulators too late to change anything) and requires every Verdict to state what was decided, what was rejected and what that cost.

**publicEngagement.** Buzz In, a three-episode stakeholder podcast built deliberately to put stakeholders who disagreed with each other into contact rather than collecting views in isolation: episode 1 paired Varroa-resistance academic Prof. Stephen Martin with commercial beekeeper Paul Horton on whether to treat at all; episode 2 brought together the CEO of the Australian Honey Bee Industry Council, Amateur Beekeepers Australia and Hive & Wellness; episode 3 set the project against social, environmental and economic lenses with a social scientist, a bee researcher and an agricultural economist. GMO 101, a joint Zoom workshop with NYU Abu Dhabi iGEM on 8 October 2026, measured participation through Nearpod (24 participants, 83% took part). A beekeeper survey received a favourable opinion from a subcommittee of the Oxford Central University Research Ethics Committee (ref MS IDREC 3973787), with public task as the lawful basis and informed consent before questions; 100+ respondents, 63% reported struggling with Varroa at mean severity 5.74/10 and 70% said they would be open to a GMO-based treatment. School sessions at St Clare's summer course were run as a two-way choice exercise (present two delivery routes with honest trade-offs, ask which students would accept, measure the acceptance shift before and after) rather than a lecture. Plus street interviews, a bee campaign, Instagram and TikTok.

**realWorld.** The need is framed with numbers rather than adjectives: Varroa is an invasive alien species across most of its range and the most serious pest of the western honeybee; Australia's failed eradication attempt cost A$101 million and destroyed about 30,000 hives, and surveyed US commercial operations lost around 62% of colonies in 2024-25, estimated at over $600 million. SDGs are chosen, not collected: 15 (Life on Land) and 2 (Zero Hunger) are the primary goals with 17 and 4 as enabling goals, each mapped to named sub-targets (15.8 on invasive alien species is the headline, plus 15.1, 15.5, 15.9), and the analysis extends into the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework targets 7, 10, 11 and 17 at the CBD Secretariat's suggestion. The team then writes a dedicated negative-impacts section on goal conflicts - accessibility across economic status, pollution, ecological threat, and whether healthier managed colonies put pressure on wild pollinators (goal 15 against goal 2) - and admits an unresolved contradiction: stakeholders insisted cost was decisive while 48% of their own survey respondents ranked cost least important, with the honest line 'We have not resolved this'. Deployment rides on existing practice (dsRNA-bearing heat-killed yeast in a conventional pollen patty laid over the frames, plus a 3D-printable hive insert), the regulatory path is mapped per jurisdiction after the EPA/FDA/USDA conversation, and the cost model gives both a per-colony net private benefit and the titre threshold manufacturing must hit. They are unusually candid about what is not demonstrated: no dsRNA titre was measured against the model thresholds, the yeast could not be cloned and the E. coli route gave no detectable dsRNA, so 'this is a case for the approach, not a demonstration of the product'. Handover material - FORAGER, the HIVE cycle and question bank, the bee research guide, protocols and hardware files - is released CC BY 4.0 for future teams.

**給 GEMS：** Make the write-up template itself enforce integration: every stakeholder record must carry a 'what this changed' field, and every verdict must name what was decided, what was rejected and what that cost - then run the affordability chain backwards from what the user can pay to a numerical pass/fail specification for the bench.

### BGI-College — BioH2
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/bgi-college/
BGI-College took Clostridium beijerinckii S63, a strain newly isolated from sediment at Yundonghai Wetland Park in Foshan, Guangdong (a site of interest because of unusually high natural soil hydrogen in the Sanshui Basin), and turned a non-model anaerobe into a working chassis. They sequenced it to a single circular 5,870,246 bp chromosome, measured 40.20 plus or minus 3.45 percent hydrogen in its gas output, built a metabolic flux model that identified PFOR and HydA overexpression plus thl deletion as targets, and established an electroporation transformation system through three documented DBTL cycles, two of which failed outright. Their economic check then did something unusual: it proved their own original premise impossible, since breaking even on glucose alone would need 6.70 mol H2 per mol glucose against a hard biochemical ceiling of 4.0, which forced a redesign around byproduct valorisation. They won Best Alternative Platform in the High School section and were nominated for Best New Basic Part and Best Presentation.

**frameworks.** Explicit DBTL cycles used as the organising structure for platform development, each written as Design, Build and Test, then Learn, with the failed cycles kept in place. A metabolic flux framework integrating pathway stoichiometry, carbon allocation and electron transfer, released with a visual interface so non-modellers can use it. Hydrogen pathways benchmarked in a four-way comparison table (grey, blue, green, bio-green) on carbon footprint, levelised cost, supply-chain risk and commercial status.

**datascience.** The modelling is used as a decision tool, not decoration: it put theoretical yield at 2.46 mol H2/mol glucose for wild type rising to 3.60 under an idealised engineered scenario, and the HPLC product profile (acetate and butyrate dominant, little lactate) is what selected thl as the deletion target rather than a generic guess. The economic model is the standout piece of quantitative reasoning: industrial glucose at about 3,000 RMB per tonne against hydrogen at 40 RMB per kg requires 6.70 mol H2 per mol glucose to cover feedstock alone, which exceeds the 4.0 mol theoretical maximum of dark fermentation, so a hydrogen-only business is arithmetically impossible. Genome work includes ANI above 98 percent against C. beijerinckii DSM 791 (GCF_018223745.1), phylogenetic placement, whole-genome alignment and VFDB virulence screening, published as a separate PDF.

**dataviz.** Baseline versus engineered model runs shown side by side so the predicted yield change is legible, the full electroporation workflow drawn as a process diagram with voltages and buffers labelled, a parameter-sweep figure for the optimisation attempts, and, notably, photographs of the empty selective plates from the failed transformations alongside the successful ones. Field photographs of the wetland sampling site locate the strain in a real place.

**software.** A visual interface over the metabolic flux model, built explicitly to lower the barrier for researchers who do not routinely do computational modelling.

**ihp.** Human practices was run as a test of the project's core assumption rather than as outreach. They consulted academic researchers and industrial practitioners including engineers at China General Nuclear Power (CGN), and report the difference in how the two groups framed the problem: academics asked whether the pathway was technically feasible and rigorous, industry asked what it would cost and whether it would scale. Industry input on hydrogen's transport and storage barriers, combined with their own break-even arithmetic, is what turned a hydrogen-only project into a closed-loop biorefinery. A second consultation was decisive technically: after two failed DBTL cycles, Dr. Youduo Wu of Dalian University of Technology told them to reconsider anaerobic handling across the whole workflow rather than keep tuning electroporation parameters, which led them to move the electroporator inside the anaerobic chamber and finally obtain transformants.

**realWorld.** Three things here are worth copying, and the honesty running through all of them is the reason the platform is credible. First, the economics. Their break-even calculation is the single most useful piece of commercialisation reasoning in this cohort precisely because it falsifies their own premise: at roughly 3,000 RMB per tonne of industrial glucose and 40 RMB per kg of hydrogen, covering only the sugar feed needs 6.70 mol H2 per mol glucose, while dark fermentation cannot exceed 4.0 mol, so no amount of strain improvement makes a hydrogen-only product profitable. They state that plainly and redesign rather than hedge. The replacement model is coherent: HPLC confirmed the broth still holds organic acids after hydrogen evolution stops, so instead of paying for chemical waste disposal they use the spent broth as a free substrate to grow commercial Bacillus subtilis and sell it as a liquid biofertiliser, a secondary revenue stream that offsets the feedstock cost and sidesteps hydrogen storage and transport entirely. Note what is and is not claimed: they say the biofertiliser revenue 'substantially offsets' feedstock cost when scaled against raw material inputs, but publish no kit price, no biofertiliser price, no yield per litre of broth and no full P&L, so the loop is a validated concept with the unit economics still missing. There is no company, no patent and no investor. Second, the platform. What makes S63 genuinely reusable by other groups is that they published the route in, not just the destination: the full electroporation workflow with buffers, voltage and cuvette gap specified, the parameter sweep they tried (OD600 0.2 to 1.0, 600 to 1800 V, 100 to 400 microlitres, 1 and 2 mm cuvettes at fixed 200 ohms and 25 microfarads), photographs of the blank plates from both failed cycles, and the one change that actually worked. They also record a failure that did not resolve, stating that the Thl-targeting editing plasmid could not be assembled even though all four fragments amplified and sequenced correctly. Fifteen basic parts were cloned from S63 as native promoter plus CDS plus terminator triples across three HydA and two PFOR genes, which is the right format for a non-model host where heterologous regulatory elements may not work. The genome is published as a separate annotated report. And they label the limits precisely: the transformation system is 'an early-stage platform, rather than a fully optimised or universally reliable protocol', the model 'is not a validated predictor of experimentally achieved hydrogen production', and the oxygen hypothesis 'needs further controlled experiments' to confirm its specific contribution. Third, the safety reasoning, which is more sophisticated than most undergraduate work. The chassis was changed from C. butyricum to C. beijerinckii during an early safety review to avoid strain-dependent pathogenicity risk; they explicitly refuse to let a species-level BSL-1 classification (ATCC 35702) transfer to their own isolate, and instead confirm identity by ANI and phylogeny and screen against VFDB, while recording the correct caveat that a database match does not by itself show a functional virulence factor and that several hits were partial or low-coverage. They are candid that as high-school students they depend on instructors for safety decisions and authorised tasks, do not adjust gas-supply settings or gas-line connections themselves, and they report that three students failed the safety assessment on first attempt and had to re-sit before the team reached a 100 percent pass rate. Continuation is framed as community reuse: the model, the parts, the transformation protocol and the troubleshooting record are offered so that future dark-fermentation teams 'reuse our rationales, protocols, and lessons rather than repeat them'.

**給 GEMS：** Run the break-even arithmetic against the biochemical ceiling before committing a year of lab work: BGI-College showed a hydrogen-only product needs 6.70 mol H2 per mol glucose while dark fermentation caps at 4.0, which killed their premise early and forced a byproduct-valorisation design that actually closes. And when publishing a platform for a non-model chassis, publish the failed cycles too — the parameter sweep that did nothing, the photographs of blank plates, the plasmid that would never assemble — because the route in is what another lab needs, not the destination.

### CAU-China — Fungal Sentinel, with the OptiX phone spectrometer
Undergrad · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/cau-china/
CAU-China built Fungal Sentinel, engineered yeast that senses mould volatiles such as 1-octen-3-ol through a GPCR and reports them as fluorescence, and then built the instrument to read it where the mould actually is. OptiX is a pocket spectrometer that uses the phone's own camera as the detector: a threaded interchangeable excitation source, a sample chamber with light-trap fins, a collection module, a frosted-glass slit, a transmission grating, and two USB-C reference lamps that calibrate wavelength and spectral response per device. The software is two programs implementing one written specification, a Python reference implementation and an Android deployment client, held together by a parity test suite that enforces numerical agreement between them. The result is quantitative fluorescence with a limit of detection of 0.81 nM purified EGFP on an early build with no emission filter.

**frameworks.** Five explicit hardware DBTL cycles, each stated as a bottleneck that the previous cycle exposed: separate wavelengths, reject excitation, calibrate wavelengths, block ambient light, collect fluorescence. The software is organised as one shared specification implemented twice, with a parity suite that holds the Python and Android implementations to identical expectations on the algorithms they share, so that a field result and a desk result are the same number rather than two approximations of it. Every validation result is accompanied by its limitations.

**datascience.** This is an unusually complete instrument-to-number pipeline. Raw pixel values are first made physical: exposure time is read from TIFF/EXIF tag 33434 and the sensor black level from DNG tag 50714, and the frame is normalised to (raw minus black level) over exposure time, so what leaves the first stage is proportional to a photon flux rate rather than to brightness. Wavelength calibration is two-point by design and validated on a held-out channel: blue and red LED peaks fit a linear pixel-to-wavelength model, the green peak at a nominal 522.5 nm is deliberately excluded from the fit and used only to turn a pixel residual into a wavelength error (reported as +15.3 px, i.e. +5.57 nm), with quality grades of PASS at 2.5 nm or better, WARNING to 10 nm and FAILED beyond, and a FAILED calibration blocking downstream steps unless explicitly overridden. Peaks are located inside valley-bounded windows and refined by a log-parabola vertex fit accepted only if the curvature is negative and the vertex falls inside the window, with a half-height edge midpoint as fallback, windows containing multiple local maxima tagged suspect, and the legacy intensity-weighted centroid still reported as a diagnostic so a reviewer can see how much the estimator choice mattered. Spectral response is measured per channel against a NICHIA white LED whose spectral power distribution the manufacturer publishes, inside a dual mask restricting the estimate to wavelengths both inside the usable 430 to 660 nm band and lit strongly enough, and the team deliberately does not smooth the response curves (smoothing fabricates detail the sensor never measured, exactly where the response is least trustworthy) and does not normalise them to each other (that would destroy the relative magnitudes that say which channel to trust where). Order of operations is enforced rather than suggested: blank subtraction is additive and clipped at zero before averaging so a noisy blank cannot produce a negative spectrum, then response division is applied only where the response exceeds 20% of its maximum and reported as zero elsewhere, because dividing before subtracting would multiply the background up as well. Spikes are removed by a local median-absolute-deviation test with a 2% amplitude floor so the filter does not fire on flat regions. Quantification uses spectral unmixing rather than band integration: the sample spectrum is fitted pointwise over an emission window as a linear combination of the measured reference emission shape (taken as the highest standard minus its own blank, on this instrument, not an idealised literature spectrum), the measured blank carrying scatter and Raman structure, and a constant offset, solved by ordinary least squares, with the metric being the fitted coefficient times the area under the reference emission. Because scatter and offset are fitted out before integration, the background no longer sets the detection floor, and with scattered excitation about 100 times stronger than EGFP emission at the lowest levels the unmixing gives a limit of detection ten times lower than blank subtraction alone (0.81 nM versus 7.8 nM). Three safeguards are built around it: automatic and auditable reference selection with a diagnostic naming every candidate's in-window area, a window that starts just beyond the measured scatter peak rather than a fixed symmetric band, and a t-test on the calibration slope (t below 3 is reported as not significant with the LoD and LoQ flagged unreliable rather than printed).
