They record what they killed as well as what they built: broad-spectrum pesticides were ruled out as leaving residues unacceptable for sites like the Forbidden City, and crude biocontrol strains were ruled out as too blunt for ancient wooden halls, each discarded idea costing weeks. Community work included six gatherings (NCIM meetup, Synbiopunk-CCiC Dalian, the 1st Grand APiC where TermiTox won Best Project, Synbio Challenge Shenzhen, the Peking-Rice International HP Summit they co-organised with 50+ universities, and the SZU green-bio roundtable).

**publicEngagement.** Education was pitched per audience: a 'Code of Life' session at Huangchenggen Primary School on 13 April 2026 explaining DNA, genes and proteins with locally resonant analogies (the double helix as a twisted Chinese fried dough twist) followed by hands-on strawberry DNA extraction with Grade 6 pupils using dish soap, salt and ethanol; lab visits connecting textbook content to a working research environment; interactive games on termites, evolution and biodiversity; a May Day fun fair co-hosted with PKUHSC; and a Biodiversity Fair booth, reaching primary and middle school students, university students, families and the general public.

**realWorld.** The application is cultural-heritage conservation — the Forbidden City, old temples and traditional courtyard houses — where residue-free, species-specific control matters more than speed. The modelling fed directly into deliverables: the colony model's counter-intuitive finding that Strain B must be *kept* in the bait when Strain A is added (because withdrawing B lets surviving larvae become replacement queens and the colony recovers) is implementable only with a refillable bait station, which the team designed as hardware; and the finding that multiple bait stations break the distance gradient and remove spatial refuges became a stated deployment principle for placing several recoverable stations around a protected structure. The quantitative deliverable is a usable specification: ~5% w/w dry yeast loading, ~65 days to collapse for a constrained colony of order 10^4 termites, ~10-10.5 months for a field colony of several hundred thousand.

**給 GEMS：** Before writing a single equation, build an evidence map: a table listing every process you want to model, the published experiment that constrains it, what that experiment can and cannot separate, and a verdict of identifiable / composite / not identifiable — then build only the smallest model those data support, and carry multiple scenarios where the verdict is 'not identifiable' instead of asserting one. Then anchor model time to reality by simulating a well-documented reference compound through the same pipeline.

### QingdaoAcademy — UPKeep
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/qingdaoacademy/
QingdaoAcademy (Qingdao, Shandong) built UPKeep around the Ulva prolifera green tides that wash onto the Yellow Sea coast each summer. Stage 1 uses a free, configurable cellulosome - four enzyme modules (Cel9A, Cel6B, Cel9B-N, BglC) docked onto a CBM3a-bearing scaffoldin via cohesin-dockerin pairs - to open the cellulose-rich cell wall; Stage 2 applies an INPNC-Uly1040 ulvan lyase fusion to depolymerise ulvan into oligosaccharides proposed as a cosmetic moisturising ingredient. Containment is an iron-responsive Fur/ccdB-TetR/ccdA toxin-antitoxin circuit, modelled as a 13-state ODE system, while interface selection rests on a 25-pair AlphaFold 3 screen with HADDOCK and PRODIGY follow-up. The Human Practices work is unusually well engineered for a first-year high-school team: thirteen numbered design decisions, each with the stakeholder, what was said, what changed and the follow-up evidence.

**frameworks.** Two linked models. (1) Cellulosome recognition: all 25 cohesin-dockerin pairings screened with AlphaFold Server (AF3), two protein chains plus two calcium ions per request, seed 101, five outputs each - 125 structures - ranked by five-output mean protein-pair ipTM with bidirectional interchain PAE, interface contacts and pose spread examined; seven pairs (the five intended A-a, B-b, C-c, F-f, T-t plus the two highest-scoring mismatches B-c and T-b) taken through HADDOCK refinement and PRODIGY affinity estimation against the native 1OHZ reference. (2) Iron-responsive containment: a 13-state ODE model (sensed intracellular iron, Fur RNA, total and iron-bound Fur, shared ccdB/TetR transcript, TetR, ccdA RNA, free CcdB, free CcdA, inactive complex, a damage proxy, log population and log survival) in hours, used to study response delay after iron withdrawal or restoration, how the iron threshold shifts with the chosen endpoint, and which parameters dominate that threshold.

**datascience.** Reproducibility is treated as a deliverable: submitted sequences, AF3 requests, structures, a configuration-status manifest, per-model metrics for all 125 AF3 structures and all 25 pair summaries are downloadable as JSON, with official page snapshots, plain-text logs and parsed values archived under a result-snapshots directory and task/cluster filenames linking models to local inputs. HADDOCK scores are reconstructed from saved energy terms with the default weighting (Evdw + 0.2 Eelec + Edesolv + 0.1 Eair) and reported as mean +/- population SD over four cluster representatives. Pose uncertainty is quantified rather than hidden (mean/max pairwise dockerin Ca RMSD after cohesin alignment of about 10.99/17.76 A for T-t), and the team notes that B-b and B-c Kd ranges overlap with median dG differing by 0.05 kcal/mol, so cross-binding must be tested experimentally rather than declared resolved. A process LCA on a basis of 1 t fresh Ulva at 90% moisture gives 34 kWh, 8,800 L water and 264 kg CO2e gross, with a residue-substitution credit sweep (0-1 kg soybean meal displaced per kg theoretical remaining dry matter) producing a 34.4-264 kg CO2e/t net range; a literature-based nutrient conversion gives 18-54 kg N and 2.5-9.2 kg P per dry tonne.

**dataviz.** Matplotlib-generated SVG figures throughout: an LCA climate comparison separating enzymatic gross emissions, the residue-substitution credit and the net result across three scenarios; log-axis water and energy comparisons; a 25x25 ipTM heat matrix with the intended diagonal outlined and the two mismatch candidates highlighted in orange; predicted Kd on a logarithmic axis with per-model dots and cluster spans; interactive 3D structure viewers with a pLDDT colour mode; a stakeholder influence-versus-impact map and an SDG interaction map, both downloadable as SVG and PNG; survey charts transcribed from original screenshots with each question's own denominator retained.

**software.** No standalone software tool. Dry-lab outputs are the AF3/HADDOCK/PRODIGY screening archive, the ODE reconstruction (independently re-derived from the report's equations and parameter tables on 20 October 2026, with added parameter stress tests), the LCA and nutrient-accounting workbooks, the downloadable activity-classification CSV, and an AP242 STEP CAD assembly of the Ulva collection ROV exported from Onshape.

**ihp.** Twenty-two HP activities across six activity types are compressed into a register of thirteen numbered decisions (D01-D13), each naming the stakeholder, the quote, the change and the follow-up record - and several of them killed the team's favourite ideas. D02 is the clearest: the team wanted one system in which E. coli produced enzymes and degraded Ulva in a single reaction, but Seawin's Technical Director explained that cells and different enzymes each need their own temperature, pH and nutrient conditions, and Vland's Chief Scientist added that cells themselves generate metabolic acid, so the one-step process was split into separate cell-culture and enzyme-reaction steps and the planned pH-based function switch was abandoned entirely (D03). D04 came from peer pressure plus specialist correction: CCiC judges and teams flagged the expression burden of an extracellular cell-anchored cellulosome, and a Shanxi University doctoral researcher warned against loading too many cohesins onto one scaffoldin because of cleavage risk, so the team moved to a free cellulosome, accepting extraction and purification as explicit tasks, and planned separate expression followed by assembly. D05 is an honest unresolved tension rather than a tidy win: the cellulosome researcher supported adding BglC to hydrolyse accumulating cellobiose while Vland warned that glucose would then inhibit downstream, so the enzyme was retained with the trade-off written into the reaction-condition study. D06 dismantled the CBS-inspired shortcut of feeding hydrolysate straight into culture - Bright Moon pressed on carbon, nitrogen and aeration and Vland demanded composition analysis and experimental validation, so growth and enzyme production became separately measured questions, later yielding the observation that at pH 7 a 40% hydrolysate medium supported growth and target-protein expression with a longer lag phase. D07 is the strongest stakeholder-to-design chain: a beauty-salon manager said she would hesitate to trust Qingdao Ulva as a raw material because of possible pollution, which the team carried into a joint consultation with Professors Ning Wu and Jing Wang at the Institute of Oceanology, CAS, where contamination resolved into two concrete, separately measurable requirements - seaweed's high salt content means inadequate desalting could cause osmotic imbalance on skin, so ultrafiltration desalting and concentration entered the sample-preparation plan, and because E. coli is the production host, endotoxin must be specifically measured and controlled for higher-end or damaged-skin use. Biosafety specialist Prof. Zhihang Chen then converted an end-stage pair of controls (heat treatment plus a kill switch) into process-wide control, separating live cells, nucleic acids and endotoxin, each with its own treatment and assessment target, and prompting work on ClearColi and Rosetta chassis compatibility. D08 had Gather Great Ocean puncture the assumption that a mature brown-seaweed business implies a market for ulvan oligosaccharides - its Ulva powder goes to aquaculture feed, and it told the team to first establish what advantage ulvan oligosaccharides have over other materials - which sent them to the two professors for assay methods they could actually run (moisture uptake by desiccator and balance, in vitro antioxidant assays) and added molecular-weight profiling after the 500 Da skin-penetration literature. D13 reframed feedstock itself: the Yellow Sea Fisheries Research Institute separated ecological abundance, visible shoreline biomass and what a processor can reliably obtain, and added sand removal, dewatering and acquisition cost, so the team retained a reduced-supply scenario instead of assuming continued large blooms. Even packaging was corrected - YUTOECO's engineering manager said the proposal was still too broad, so inner contact packaging is now specified around sealing, barrier and storage needs and only the outer layer explores moulded plant fibre.

**publicEngagement.** Engagement was sequenced on survey evidence rather than instinct: of 259 respondents 228 had at least heard of Ulva (88.03%) but only 34 claimed familiarity, and 142 of 263 knew little or nothing about synthetic biology (53.99%), so the booklet starts with everyday coastal effects and existing post-collection uses before engineered bacteria, surface display or cellulosomes appear at all. A harbour interviewee's remark that online video would reach people better than a poster at the pier redirected the channel strategy to short videos on Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Douyin and WeChat Channels. A joint activity with OUC-Haide (the 17-C collaboration) was cross-checked before delivery and two content errors - a pH item and an mRNA pairing error - were found and corrected, with simulations, three-level hints and a reset path added. Continued participation runs through the school biology club and repeated lessons rather than one-off events, and the team keeps SDG 4 targets 4.4 and 4.7 separate from its claims about measured learning.

**realWorld.** The real-world case is anchored in the existing Qingdao system rather than in a waste narrative: harbour workers, the Municipal Marine Development Bureau and processors described coordinated pier collection, dewatering and drying, trucking to downstream companies, feed and fertiliser uses and decayed material returned to sea - so the team compares four handling routes on cost, product value and nutrient destination and positions UPKeep as an added high-value step, noting Gather Great Ocean's blunt 'there is no waste material'. SDGs are claimed at target level with the team's own numbers: SDG 12 (12.2, 12.5, 12.6, 12.8) carries the LCA, with the enzymatic scenario at 264 kg CO2e/t gross and about 35 kg CO2e/t net when each kg of remaining dry matter displaces 1 kg of soybean meal at 2.75 kg CO2e/kg, 34 kWh/t against 389 kWh/t for the feed-meal route, and 8,800 L/t water driven chiefly by membrane diafiltration; SDG 14 (14.1, 14.2) carries nitrogen and phosphorus accounting to final destination and marine-ecology consultation; SDG 9 (9.4) the process and enzyme-recovery work; SDG 3 (3.9) storage, odour and coastal handling exposure; SDG 4 (4.4, 4.7) education; and SDG 8 (8.2, 8.8) worker protection and cost responsibility. The SDG dialogue partner was Professor Pierre Failler (Economics, University of Portsmouth), whose advice - 'do the economics first, and don't mix the concepts' and 'doing a single project on its own is very difficult, you need a cluster model' - made the team keep the business plan and the LCA as separate documents. The most concrete real-world act is not a product: after Hongdao interviews about slippery coastal working conditions, on 6 October 2026 the team filed a proposal through Qingdao's 12319 public-service platform requesting anti-slip footwear and gloves for frontline sanitation workers, and received an official reply on 9 October describing purchase and distribution of anti-slip equipment, safety reminders, site inspection and weather-based adjustment of operations; the remotely operated Ulva collection vehicle (a 648 x 462 x 419 mm PVC-framed ROV with a forward nylon-mesh basket, published as an AP242 STEP model) is justified on the same worker-exposure grounds. Entrepreneurship is deliberately modest - the first offer is an oligosaccharide research sample plus production route, assay results and a proposed quality-information sheet to cosmetic ingredient developers, with a cream-base-versus-cream-plus-ingredient demonstrator, revenue only after formulation qualification, and cost priorities named as enzyme production and recovery, purification, drying, batch quality and packaging. Regulatory status is not claimed anywhere; residue destined for fertiliser is explicitly excluded where it contains engineered cells, and no packaging prototype has been made.

**給 GEMS：** Keep a numbered decision register like UPKeep's D01-D13, where each row is initial idea / stakeholders / what we heard / what we changed / why it matters, cross-linked to the interview record and to the experiment that tests the change - including rows where two advisers disagreed and the tension was retained rather than resolved. Their second habit is worth copying too: push a vague public worry ('Ulva might be polluted') to experts until it becomes separately measurable specifications (desalting, endotoxin, DNA residue, live-cell viability).

### UMA Malaga — Frida
Undergrad · Spain · https://2026.igem.wiki/uma-malaga/
Frida 使用 CRISPR/LwCas13a（SHERLOCK 型的旁側切割，以螢光讀出）篩檢罕見遺傳疾病背後的突變，以囊狀纖維化作為模式疾病，並以串聯 gRNA 組裝系統（Neith）實現多重檢測。由於單一疾病可能有數百個致病變異、每個都需要自己的嚮導，團隊開發了 Diana（diana-grna-designer）——一個免費、採 MIT 授權的網頁應用程式、命令列工具與 F# 函式庫，能從疾病名稱、OMIM 編號或 MONDO id 出發，經過 ClinVar 的變異清單，產生排序並評分的嚮導 RNA、可直接下訂的寡核苷酸清單、組合式混樣（pooling）計畫，以及陽性孔位的解碼器。這個專案的工程紀律在 iGEM 中相當罕見：1,164 個單元與元件測試，加上 75 個 Playwright 瀏覽器測試、對每個頁面狀態自動執行 axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA 無障礙掃描、所有相依套件皆鎖定版本並驗證檢查碼，匯出的 GenBank、SBOL 3 與 SBOL 2 檔案還會在測試套件中由 Biopython 與 pySBOL3 讀回驗證。最醒目的是，濕實驗室推翻了軟體的核心啟發式規則，而團隊照實公開：在所嘗試的放置位置上，人工錯配取代規則並未能區分對偶基因，於是該規則從承諾降級為一個可供比較的選項。

**frameworks.** 一個單一的 Blazor Server 應用程式（ASP.NET Core 9、C#、以 SignalR 承載的 Razor 元件、Bootstrap 5），在同一行程內直接呼叫一個 F# 函式庫（gRNA），並以 grna 命令列工具作為第二個前端、呼叫完全相同的介面，因此網頁與終端機永遠一致。原生科學工具以子行程執行：以 Bowtie 1.3.1 對 GRCh38 no-ALT 索引比對脫靶，以 Python 3 呼叫 ViennaRNA 做結構摺疊。所有東西都裝進一個 Docker 映像（Compose v2），並刻意把基因組索引烘進映像，因為 Bowtie 以記憶體映射方式讀取索引，改用 volume 或 bind mount 會讓比對慢上十倍以上。對外呼叫僅限 NCBI E-utilities、dbSNP Variation Services、ClinVar 與 Monarch Initiative。這個 F# 函式庫也可建置成 NuGet 套件（未發布），供任何 .NET 專案引用；程式庫中另附一個 agent skill，讓 AI 助理能安裝、啟動、健康檢查並操作這個工具。

**datascience.** 驗證以一張矩陣呈現工具每個部分各自建立在什麼基礎上，並誠實分成三類：自動化測試、真實序列與線上服務，以及濕實驗室；其中「已測試」意指實驗工作已開始但尚無結果，而「未顯示」被記錄為一項結果而非缺漏。數字如下：1,164 個 NUnit/bUnit 案例（1,151 通過，13 個在缺少線上服務或 ViennaRNA 時自行跳過）、75 個以確定性管線替身為對象的 Playwright/Chromium 測試、在許多 (V, K) 組合上證明的混樣不變量（每個嚮導恰好出現在 R 個孔、沒有任何池超過 K、每個嚮導都有唯一的孔位集合、兩種盤型的定址一致），以及針對單一命中、碰撞與漏失的解碼測試。人工檢查則從 NCBI 序列重建了 rs334 與 F508del 的設計，確認排名最前的缺失型嚮導只出現在被刪除的序列中，且與任何野生型視窗相距 6-8 個字母。整個網頁流程在 2026-10-18 以真實容器重跑一次（囊狀纖維化疾病查詢回傳 1,517 筆 ClinVar 記錄，以及五個設計、轉接子、結構、候選名單、混樣與解碼）。效能在容器內計時：轉錄本位置設計 8-10 秒、染色體位置設計 28-38 秒（主要耗在從 NCBI 下載整個 accession）、疾病查詢 17 秒、100 個嚮導的混樣計畫約 1 秒、100,000 個嚮導 97 秒。匯出正確性以結構方式檢查：標註的部件完整鋪滿序列、沒有空隙或重疊，並在 repeat、轉接子、側翼與 T7 啟動子的全部 64 種組合下都與寡核苷酸 DNA 相符；檔案再由 Biopython 與 pySBOL3 讀回，無任何錯誤或警告。

**dataviz.** 排序後的嚮導表格有九個可排序欄位（spacer、GC 分數、GC %、同聚物、脫靶數、摺疊能量、spacer 未配對比例、與另一對偶基因的錯配數、分數），可依分數、脫靶數、GC 範圍、對偶基因錯配與序列片段篩選，種子區以底線標示、突變以紅色標出，狀態同時以形狀與文字傳達，而不只靠顏色。脫靶標籤分為 none/unique/caution/6+ 飽和；展開一列會列出每一個 GRCh38 比對結果，含染色體、位置、股向與錯配數。RNA 結構以 dot-bracket 加上在頁面內繪製的 FORNA 力導向圖呈現，因此除非使用者點選「Open in FORNA」，序列絕不離開本機。混樣功能會產生可點擊、可用鍵盤巡覽的 96 孔或 384 孔盤位圖，滑過某孔即列出其中的嚮導，解碼後的陽性孔以加號標記。每個術語都附有平實語言的提示說明，統一放在一個檔案（HelpText.cs）中。另有亮色與暗色主題、跳至主要內容的連結、可鍵盤操作的頁籤，以及對每個頁面狀態橫跨 WCAG 2.0-2.2 A 與 AA 等級的 axe-core 自動掃描。

**software.** Diana 有三個彼此串接、但也可獨立使用的部分。「疾病變異」會在 Monarch Initiative 知識圖譜中查詢疾病，並列出 NCBI 連結到其 OMIM 編號的 ClinVar 記錄，照 ClinVar 自己的分類與審查星等呈現、不重新解讀，上限為 3,000 筆，截斷時會標示清單不完整。Builder 每次最多接受 50 筆輸入，可為 rsID（透過 NCBI Variation Services 解析，預設只保留與疾病相關的對偶基因，因此 rs334 只給出一種標記而非十二種），或嚴格的 HGVS，包括 NM_/XM_ 轉錄本上的 c. 位置——後者會用 GenBank 的編碼區範圍換算，並在通知中明示；若在基因組記錄上給 c. 位置則會被拒絕並附上建議，因為內含子會讓嚮導落在錯誤的位置。接著它在原始與突變序列的雙股上滑動視窗（預設 23 nt，允許 18-60），標示哪一股與 mRNA 互補並把它排在前面（因為 LwCas13a 結合 RNA），並以四項透明標準為每個候選評分：GC 含量相對 40-60% 的目標、長度 4 以上的同聚物、在 GRCh38 中容許最多兩個錯配的 Bowtie 脫靶命中數，以及在 Turner 2004 參數下完整嚮導的 ViennaRNA 最小自由能。候選以遞增鍵排序（脫靶數、-能量、-GC 分數、同聚物），而導出的 0-1 分數被明確說明為相對排名，不是活性預測。另有兩項結構檢查（摺疊後 direct-repeat 髮夾是否完整、spacer 有多少比例保持未配對）與一個對偶基因區辨計數（標的與另一對偶基因相差的最少字母數，為 0 或 1 時標記「無法區辨」），用於輔助選擇但不改變排名。完整的 gRNA 由 36 nt 的 LwCas13a direct repeat 加上 spacer 組成，可選擇再包上團隊自己的 Frida 轉接子（BsmBI Type IIS 切位加上 AAAC 與 GCTT 融合位，使 repeat 在 Golden Gate 組裝過程中取得，而不必為每個嚮導各合成一次）以及 BioBricks RFC[10] 前/後綴轉接子，兩者能正確嵌套，使接點恰好補完標準序列。選殖檢查會掃描真正會被下訂的 DNA（雙股）是否含有十種酵素的切位（BsaI、BsmBI、SapI、BbsI、EcoRI、XbaI、SpeI、PstI、NotI、EcoRV），並排除轉接子刻意帶入的切位，另顯示對應 Registry 自身組裝相容性規則的 RFC[10] 與 RFC[1000] 相容性標章。Guide Pooling 則提供三種組合式佈局（2D Fragmented、2D Matrix、3D）並列出各自的孔數公式，自動挑出最省的一種，把結果放到 96 孔或 384 孔盤上，並在篩檢後解碼，區分「確定」與「模稜兩可」的推論，而不是把碰撞情形藏起來；經典的二元 log2 模型被刻意排除，因為它要求 K = V/2，會違反每條串聯陣列最多五個嚮導的限制。以 100 個嚮導、K = 5 計算，這是 40 個孔而非 100 次反應，節省 60%。匯出格式包括：寡核苷酸 CSV（可選加 T7 啟動子、含上下股，並附一個限制酶切位欄位，讓警示隨訂單一起傳遞）、FASTA、有註解的 GenBank、SBOL 3（RDF/XML，使用 Sequence Ontology 角色）與 SBOL 2（純粹因為某個基於 libSBOLj 的工具拒收 SBOL 3 檔案才加上）。CSV 中以 =、+、- 或 @ 開頭的欄位會被中和，以免試算表將其當公式執行。部署刻意只在本機：「git clone https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/uma-malaga/diana-grna-designer.git && ./start.sh」，它會檢查 Docker、磁碟與 Compose，只有在 http://localhost:5000/healthz 有回應後才報告成功；約需 10 GB 磁碟與 3 GB 記憶體。沒有提供託管的設計 API，wiki 也說明了原因（4 GB 的索引與原生工具讓公開伺服器成本高昂，而本機執行能讓貼近病患的資料保持私密），接著又以同一函式庫寫出並實際執行一個極簡的 ASP.NET Core /export 端點，示範 HTTP 前端其實很薄，同時把這份草稿標示為概念驗證而非正式服務。真正上線可點的是 https://diana-grna-designer-7723f5.igem.wiki/ 的範例展示區，公開了 rs334（48 個候選 spacer）、F508del（36 個候選）與一份 100 嚮導混樣計畫的未經編輯 grna 輸出，每份都記錄日期（2026-10-19）、commit（19a8e08）、Docker 映像的 sha256、工具版本（Bowtie 1.3.1、ViennaRNA 2.7.2）、實際執行的指令，以及同日第二次執行得到完全相同設計的註記。文件分層撰寫：README.md 說明用法、架構、設定與疑難排解；docs/ 收錄執行期契約、函式庫用法、人工測試計畫與驗證紀錄；BIOLOGICAL_REPORT.md 則為非程式背景的讀者把每個生物步驟對應到程式碼，並列出尚未解決的科學問題。「Extending Diana」一節把一個具體的未來功能（考慮搖擺配對的對偶基因檢查）走過程式庫中會被動到的全部六個位置，並附上 F# 函式的草稿。授權為 MIT，並列出第三方授權（Bowtie 為 Artistic 2.0；ViennaRNA 學術使用免費、商業使用需另行授權），同時明確聲明部分程式碼是在 AI 程式助理協助下撰寫、由團隊審閱，責任仍由團隊承擔。

**ihp.** 人類實踐小組（取名 Athena）執行一套他們稱為 BARI 的迭代循環：Bibliographic research（文獻研究）、Application（應用）、Reflection（反思）、Integration（整合），並明確說明這不是線性流程，每一輪都可能把他們送回去重新檢視先前的某個假設。實質的轉向是不再把 Frida 當成一個技術缺口的填補：與病患、醫療專業人員、研究者及病友協會的對話揭露了西班牙各自治區之間新生兒篩檢的地域不平等、照護路徑的差異，以及診斷延誤的後果，使問題從「我們能不能做出一個偵測器」轉為「在診斷路徑的哪一個環節，這樣的工具才真的回應了某個需求」。團隊也記錄下：篩檢計畫並非確診工具，必須有確認性檢驗，而隨之而來的等待可能在嬰兒身上造成不可逆的傷害。濕實驗室回饋到軟體上的部分是所有整合中最明確的一項：實驗未能區分對偶基因（部分原因追溯到 LwCas13a 可容忍的 G-U 搖擺配對）被如實公開，使取代規則降級為排序候選中的一個選項，並把該規則的位置與 spacer 長度改成使用者可調的設定，讓修正後的放置方式無須改程式即可測試，同時把「考慮搖擺配對的對偶基因檢查」列為下一個功能。

**publicEngagement.** 一份 227 人的問卷調查探詢公眾對罕見疾病的認識，而團隊在報告時把限制攤開來說：90.7% 認同早期診斷的重要性、87.7% 知道新生兒篩檢在西班牙各自治區之間有差異，但只有 11% 能指出成本佔家庭收入的比例、只有 9.3% 答對真實的全球盛行率。他們也揭露了認知與行動之間的落差：63% 表示過去一年沒有參與任何罕見疾病相關活動（227 人中有 144 人選擇「以上皆非」）。人口統計資料完整公開（性別、教育程度、年齡、職業、是否認識病患），wiki 並明確指出這份樣本屬探索性質、百分比只描述該樣本而非一般大眾的推估值，而且參考答案本身也需要先經驗證，才能宣稱一個整體的知識分數。

**realWorld.** Frida 針對的是罕見疾病的「診斷漂流」：症狀表現異質、候選突變眾多，往往意味著數年的不確定與一再的就診。專案源自馬拉加大學既有的篩檢與早期偵測研究，指導教授的專業人際網絡則提供了最初的利害關係人聯繫。Diana 刻意為貼近臨床的場景而設計：不需帳號、不留存任何資料、僅綁定 loopback、容器以非 root 執行，且只能本機部署，使序列資料絕不離開研究者的機器。

**給 GEMS：** 公開一張驗證矩陣，把「自動化測試能證明什麼」、「對線上服務的真實執行能證明什麼」與「濕實驗室實際展示了什麼」分開，並把「未顯示」記錄為一項結果：Diana 的 wiki 直接寫明，它的排序順序、取代規則與混樣佈局都未在實驗室中驗證，而實驗結果還推翻了取代規則。研究單位應該把這份誠實，與 Diana 的兩項可重複使用的機制搭配起來：一個純粹的科學核心（F#），讓 GUI、CLI 與一個 AI agent skill 都只作為薄前端架在上面；以及一個釘住 commit、映像摘要與確切指令的公開範例展示區，讓陌生人不必安裝任何東西就能看到真實輸出。

### UiOslo-Norway — HePatch
Overgrad · Norway · https://2026.igem.wiki/uioslo-norway/
HePatch engineers the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) for thermostability so it could be delivered in a dissolvable microneedle patch without a cold chain, benchmarked against the WHO controlled temperature chain condition of 28 days at 37 C. The dry lab scored 2,260 ESM2/Rosetta substitutions on a 238-residue E. coli construct, retained 989 after a ddG filter, and ranked candidates for the bench. What distinguishes the team is that it put the project in front of ethicists, legal scholars, Norway's national research ethics committees, a medical officer in Kenya's highest-prevalence county and a youth-led organisation in Nairobi's informal settlements - and then published the places where those people broke the project's own premise. Each stakeholder round is closed with a 'What changed?' box naming the previous assumption, the new approach and the updated framing.

**frameworks.** A two-phase candidate-prioritisation pipeline for HBsAg substitutions. Phase 1 scores substitutions on sequence, structure and developability features; Phase 2 prepares checked ProteinMPNN and molecular-dynamics packages. Ethical reflection is structured on Kenneth Pimple's three questions for responsible conduct of research - is it true, is it fair, is it wise - with most of the human-practices work deliberately placed under 'is it wise'.

**datascience.** 2,260 ESM2/Rosetta-scored substitutions filtered to 989 by ddG; an earlier construct-v2 exploration ran AlphaFold2 and ProteinMPNN on six candidates, kept as a separately labelled history rather than merged. Provenance discipline is unusually strict: the pipeline records every input, output and source checksum, and the team states that the selected run reuses preserved ESM2 and Rosetta outputs whose original software versions and seeds were not recorded. Geospatial analysis used WorldPop 2020 constrained counts at 100 m, WorldClim 2.1 BIO1 at 30 arc-seconds, GADM 4.1 boundaries and OpenStreetMap amenity and road tags.

**dataviz.** Original GIS cartography made by the team rather than borrowed from publications: population density, mean annual temperature, road network and hospital locations for Turkana and Nairobi counties, rendered in QGIS at WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), with every data source, resolution and limitation stated in the caption. Plus per-variant structural figures (WT, S54T, T56A, T113S) and the recurring 'What changed?' three-column comparison boxes.

**software.** A reproducible released pipeline containing the reusable code, tests and a synthetic example, with a separate archive preserving the selected run and its full provenance history. The model page carries a blanket disclaimer that none of the in silico output establishes expression yield, solubility, antigenicity, disulfide bonding, particle assembly or biological function.

**ihp.** UiOslo's IHP is the clearest example in this set of engagement that attacks the project rather than endorsing it, and every round ends in a published 'What changed?' box. Professor Kristin Bergtora Sandvik (Criminology and Sociology of Law, University of Oslo, fifteen years on the legal and ethical side of global health including vaccines and cold chains) pointed out that in Norway a vaccination appointment is also when a nurse weighs the child, checks for malnutrition, asks after the mother and notices when a family stops coming - so the team had been thinking about removing the syringe and the fridge without noticing they were also removing the healthcare visit. Professor Kristine Baeroe (Institute of Health and Society) refused to let reduced healthcare involvement count as an automatic benefit, and said of the recipients that children are 'the vulnerable among the vulnerable'. The design consequence is explicit: they moved away from designing for full self-administration towards a trained person being present, began investigating community health workers as administrators, and now describe HePatch as replacing a healthcare visit rather than an injection. Baeroe also told them that studying one country in depth beats a general claim about low-resource settings, which is why the project now writes about Kenya and specifically Turkana County; and she made the communication risk concrete by asking them to imagine a patch arriving in a community with no prior context for it, described as a cure, noting that mistrust in that situation is not irrational and that an intervention can be read as something done to a child rather than for them. Then the team did the thing most teams skip: they designed the Kenyan conversations as a falsification test, stating in advance that the alternative they were genuinely prepared to find - that cold-chain dependence was not a leading barrier in either setting - 'would have undercut the premise of the project as a whole'. Dr Vincent Ebenyo, medical officer at Lodwar County Referral Hospital in Turkana (16.8% hepatitis B prevalence in KENPHIA 2018, the highest county figure in Kenya), partly did undercut it: asked for the single biggest driver of low birth-dose coverage he named unsterilised shared cutting instruments used in ceremonies such as scarification and late health-seeking behaviour first, not the cold chain, which taught the team that transmission prevention and vaccine access are two different problems and a delivery-technology fix only addresses the second. He did confirm the core rationale with a precedent - his hospital had already switched from oxytocin to heat-stable carbetocin because local power instability made cold storage unreliable - but located the cold-chain failure specifically at sub-county and outreach facilities rather than the referral hospital, and noted mothers travelling up to 100 km who arrive a week or a month after birth, far outside the WHO 24-hour window. On self-administration he drew a comparison the team had not considered, that insulin-dependent patients are trusted to self-inject after training, while insisting that training must cover recognising side effects and knowing when to seek care, not just application; and he named the Pharmacy and Poisons Board as the body that would need to run sample trials, which is why the team now treats engagement with Kenyan regulators as part of the project path rather than an afterthought. Edwin Odhiambo, June Alfreds and nurse Steve Donell of Youth and Urbanism in Nairobi's informal settlements went further: Odhiambo said flatly that if HePatch can still only be administered inside a hospital, a mother gains nothing from the fact that it no longer needs a fridge, because she makes the same trip to the same limited set of facilities - a distribution and licensing problem, not a temperature one. Alfreds added barriers the team had not identified at all: teenage mothers unaware of the 24-hour window and stigmatised by providers, Social Health Authority registration requirements that undocumented mothers cannot meet, financial dependency and intimate partner violence determining whether a mother can attend at all, and a day queueing at a hospital being a day of lost income. Donell showed that stigma is locally specific rather than generic - in Nairobi hepatitis B is wrongly linked to sexual behaviour and drug use and mentally associated with HIV, whereas in Turkana the same disease is more often mistranslated as an alcohol-related liver condition - and recommended routing messaging through trusted community health volunteers and faith leaders rather than through specialists or the project itself. The result is a conditional value proposition rather than one universal pitch: transport and storage resilience in remote off-grid Turkana, and expanded distribution to non-hospital providers in Nairobi only if paired with a licensing pathway. The team also publishes two arguments against itself - that solving the cold chain for one vaccine could remove a reason to fund and maintain the shared cold-chain infrastructure every other vaccine depends on, and that since the WHO already permits some vaccines outside 2-8 C under controlled temperature chain rules, protein stability may not be the real bottleneck at all - and names its remaining gap honestly, that the Network for Adolescent and Youth of Africa could not attend, so the adolescent perspective 'remains a genuine gap in what we can currently report'.

**publicEngagement.** Education ran from kindergarten upward - children building model viruses and extracting DNA, sessions at Forskningstorget (the Norwegian public research fair), and presentations to biology students - with photo documentation of each. A separate Dialogues page records the conversations held with ethics and legal experts. The notable choice is a principle adopted from a stakeholder and applied to their own outreach: June Alfreds of Youth and Urbanism told them that raising awareness of a vaccine a family then cannot obtain does not build trust, it destroys it, and the team now treats that as a firm constraint on their own public communication.

**realWorld.** The need is framed at the level of a specific failure point rather than a continent: hepatitis B birth dose must be given within 24 hours, the conventional vaccine is an aqueous aluminium-adjuvant suspension that loses potency irreversibly if frozen as well as if overheated, and the cold chain in Turkana holds at the county referral hospital but not at the generator-dependent sub-county and outreach facilities below it, across a county of about 68,700 square kilometres served by eight hospital-level facilities spaced one to two hundred kilometres apart, with mean annual temperatures above 30 C across most of the inhabited lowlands. SDGs are used as tests, not labels: SDG 3 as primary with named targets 3.3, 3.8 and 3.b and a quantitative benchmark (28 days at 37 C, the WHO controlled temperature chain condition), SDG 9 and SDG 10 as supporting, and an explicit statement that these are intended contributions and not measured outcomes. They decline to claim a fourth, environmental SDG at all, writing that removing refrigeration and sharps could cut some material and energy demand but the polymer patch, sterile packaging and manufacturing have impacts, so a life-cycle assessment would be needed before any environmental claim - a refusal that is rarer and more credible than a claim. A trade-offs table pairs each possible benefit with its risk and with what would have to be measured to settle it (for example, delivery closer to home against work shifting to already stretched community health workers, measured by training time, workload, follow-up and user preference). The regulatory path runs through Kenya's own Pharmacy and Poisons Board rather than an external or parallel route. On equity they commit that a patch must not become a cheaper, less supported option offered only where health systems have fewer resources, and that any future use needs the same safety, dose and protection evidence as other vaccine formats - operationalised as comparing HePatch against the vaccination a child would otherwise receive rather than against no vaccination, because 'measuring our option against nothing makes it look better than it is'. What they claim now is bounded: antigen candidates designed and tested, no complete thermostable vaccine patch, no demonstrated lower emissions, lower cost or improved coverage.

**給 GEMS：** Design the stakeholder conversation as a falsification test, stating in advance which answer would undercut the project, then publish it when it partly does - and close every round with a three-column box naming the previous assumption, the new approach and the updated framing, so integration is auditable rather than asserted.

### Vilnius-Lithuania — BMClick：一殼點擊萬物
Undergrad · Lithuania · https://2026.igem.wiki/vilnius-lithuania/
BMClick 在體外重建細菌微區室（BMC）——細菌用來區隔代謝反應的蛋白質外殼——並透過在以 amber 密碼子嵌入的非天然胺基酸上進行點擊化學，使外殼表面可程式化，把一套天然的包覆系統變成處理純化生物分子的模組化平台。目標是重現細胞所提供的組織性：保護治療用核酸不被核酸酶分解、分隔重建路徑中的各個步驟、擴大酵素可作用的溫度與 pH 範圍，同時保有體外條件的精確性。團隊也用 BMC-T 外殼蛋白做出具功能的巨觀材料，並以 HiBiT-SpyCatcher 載物示範體外包覆，再由 cryo-EM 確認。乾實驗的產出是 Ladder Detector：一個 React + FastAPI 網頁應用程式，先用 GelGenie 已釋出的 U-Net 模型分割電泳膠照片中的條帶，再判定標記道跑的是哪一種市售分子量標準品（ladder）——這一步是現有工具都沒有自動化的。

**frameworks.** React 網頁前端搭配 Python FastAPI 伺服器，對外提供以 OpenAPI 3.1 文件化的 REST API（Ladder Detector API 0.1.0，Apache 2.0），共五個端點，分為 Segmentation 群組（GET /segmentation-models、POST /segment-image、POST /extract-band-details）與 Ladder 群組（GET /markers、POST /detect-ladder）。刻意不設資料庫層：應用程式不收集也不儲存任何使用者資料，所有設定都放在伺服器上的檔案裡。部署採 Docker Compose，共三個服務（前端 5173、後端 8000、互動式 API 文件在 /docs），分割模型在建置時從 Hugging Face 上的 GelGenie 模型庫拉取，因此除了 Git 與 Docker 之外，還需先備妥 Hugging Face 存取權杖。

**datascience.** ladder 判定的評估是整份工作最紮實的部分。團隊向 Thermo Fisher Scientific 取得其 DNA、RNA 與蛋白質 ladder 的條帶圖譜，範圍限定在自家實驗室實際使用的六種 ladder，再結合自己跑的膠體、已發表文獻中的圖，以及向 Vilnius University Life Sciences Center 社群與 International Biology Olympiad 主辦方徵集到的照片，建成 172 個標記道樣本的資料集。由於演算法並非機器學習，但仍有可調參數，他們切出 30% 做參數調整、70% 做評估，在調參集內使用 K-fold 交叉驗證，並人工把來自同一來源或同一張影像的樣本歸為同一組，使相關樣本不會跨切分洩漏，同時依 ladder 分層。接著在保留測試集上比較四種組合：Dynamic Time Warping 的準確率為 52.42%（絕對移動距離）與 62.90%（相對移動距離），調整過的 Needleman-Wunsch 則達 89.52% 與 91.13%。他們公開各類別表格，明確列出兩條相關基線（六選一隨機猜測約 17%，永遠猜最常見類別約 26%），也診斷了自己的失敗案例：Protein_6 一直被誤判為 DNA_14，因為兩種 ladder 的條帶數相同，平常能區分不同條帶數 ladder 的 gap penalty 因此提供不了訊息，只剩條帶位置可用。整體準確率相近，他們仍選相對移動距離而非絕對值，因為它在 Protein_6 上表現較好（61.9% 對 47.62%），而且是兩者中較簡單的做法。實測端到端標註時間約一分鐘以內。

**dataviz.** 核心輸出就是標註好的電泳膠影像本身：上傳照片，必要時裁切或旋轉，標出標記道，應用程式便偵測條帶並把大小標籤寫上去。可接受的輸入格式為 PNG、JPEG、WebP 與 TIFF，標註結果以 PNG 回傳。在自動化不完美的地方，使用者拿到的是真正的編輯工具，而不是只能全盤接受或放棄的答案：筆刷、橡皮擦與魔術棒可修正條帶偵測，也可以直接覆寫判定出的 ladder 或編輯指定的數值。專案可存成 .gelproj 檔再載回，檔內帶著條帶分割與道次標記；前後端之間以 JSON 交換資料。

**software.** Ladder Detector 解決的是一個真實又不起眼的問題：電泳膠標註都靠手工，重複而且不一致；團隊發現雖然已有數種膠體分析工具，卻沒有一個把標註這一步自動化，即使幾乎每張發表的膠體圖都有標註。流程分兩階段。條帶分割選擇沿用而非重造：GelGenie（Aquilina 等人，Nature Communications 2025）已證明輕量 U-Net 與 nnU-Net 明顯優於傳統 Watershed 與 Multi-Otsu 方法，因此 Ladder Detector 直接執行 GelGenie 釋出的模型，預設為 Universal 輕量 U-Net（在普通 CPU 上只需數秒），另可選用 nnU-Net 與針對銳利條帶微調的版本。ladder 判定才是團隊自己的貢獻，而背後的設計決策很值得參考：他們最初的想法是對標記道裁切影像做影像分類，在一次諮詢後放棄，理由有兩點——他們蒐集不到足以可靠訓練的樣本量，而且影像分類器很可能抓住的是解析度、打光或膠體來源，而不是真正能區分 ladder 的條帶位置。他們改用數值資料，從分割遮罩取出條帶質心，推導出絕對移動距離（距道次頂端的距離）與相對移動距離（以道次高度正規化）。絕對法利用了移動距離對 log10（大小）近乎線性的經驗關係：對註冊表中的每一種 ladder，兩組序列都做 min-max 正規化、將 log 大小反轉、以調整過的 Needleman-Wunsch 對齊，再對配對點做最小平方直線擬合，並以 R-squared 減去每個未配對條帶的罰分來為該 ladder 評分。相對法則是與各 ladder 取自廠商圖表的參考圖譜比對，以 1 - RMSE 計分，並採同樣的未配對條帶罰分。流程刻意保留兩個人工檢查點——分割結果審閱與標記道選擇——wiki 也說明了原因：分割並非總是準確，而且當一張膠體上有多個標記道時，應用程式無法可靠判斷哪一道才是 ladder。API 的存在就是為了讓這個工具能成為自動化流程中的一個環節。它曾以公開網頁前端部署在 https://ladder-detector.onrender.com，這個直覺是對的，但查核時該服務回傳 'This service has been suspended by its owner'，所以今天唯一可行的路徑是自行架設：'git clone https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/vilnius-lithuania/ladder-detector.git'，在 backend/.env 加入 Hugging Face 權杖，再執行 'docker compose up --build'。限制也誠實列出：因資料可得性只支援六種 ladder；分割仍不夠準確、需要人工修正；而傳統的判定方法在資料集更大時，或許可由訓練過的模型做得更好。授權為 Apache 2.0；團隊自述這是一個原型。

**ihp.** 9 個月內超過 30 場利害關係人會談，形式是開放對話、以取得建設性批評為目的，而不是做簡報；每則意見事後都系統性評估，行不通的方向就放掉。他們把這個循環命名為 CLICK cycle（Consider、Listen、Implement、Check、Know your limitations），並提出五項價值，其中 Critical Reflection 被定義為檢視自己的預設前提，並在平台部分內容可能具治療價值的前提下誠實面對限制。建議都標在一條互動時間軸上，每場會談記錄 Description、Insights、Integration 與 Next steps，並有三個明確的修正節點。具體的轉向包括：2023 年「Exullose」與 2025 年「iXPOSE」團隊的校友幫他們把範圍收斂到九個月做得到的程度；Kerfeld Laboratory 就 BMC 組裝與蛋白質修飾提供建議；Prof. Rolandas Meškys 促成把體外自組裝的 BMC 蛋白轉為模組化平台的方向；在團隊自己多次試驗失敗後，Dr. Yali Wang 確認 BMC-T 功能性材料的形成是可行的；Ieva Lingytė（Biomatter Designs）與 Dr. Juozas Nainys（Atrandi Biosciences）的批評，把原本只看耐熱性的狹窄目標擴展到 pH 耐受性測試，並推動他們找出更有創意的應用，進而產生三條分支的工具箱；而與 Augustas Rinkevičius 的諮詢記錄為「Rethinking our ladder detection」，正是讓軟體從影像分類器轉向數值條帶距離比對的那場會議。

**publicEngagement.** 教育活動在一位利害關係人指出他們的規劃有問題之後，整個重做。團隊原本已勘好場地、聯繫學生組織，還打算為一場大型科學節請樂團演出；前任隊長 Ieva Lingytė 提醒他們，活動辦得更大並不等於觸及更多人，應該走向人群，而不是期待人群走過來。他們把原案全部作廢。新的架構借用 Ray Oldenburg 的「第三場所」社會學：家是第一場所，大學與正式活動是第二場所，而人們出於自願聚集的非正式公共空間（咖啡館、博物館、俱樂部、收容所）是第三場所，在那裡身分地位並不重要，交談才是主要活動。於是每場活動都放進一個本來就存在的社群裡，形式刻意保持平等、可隨時離席，讓沒有生物背景、當晚也沒打算遇到科學的人能自在參與：在貓咪收容所藉現場的動物談遺傳學、在 MO Museum 以繪畫工作坊（「Science Paints」）教真菌，並加入「BŪTENT!」討論節與 VU Alumni Festival 既有觀眾的場次。形式也經過迭代：第一場「Science Talks」顯示大家想要更直接的問題，第二場便把題目縮短並問得更尖銳；討論節則讓「辨識假科學行銷」浮現為民眾最容易被誤導的主題。另外與 Uršulė Barkauskaitė 和 Austėja Klevaitė 的個別諮詢，專門處理如何為年長者調整活動——這是團隊先前沒有資源好好納入的族群。

**realWorld.** 商業可行性是和業界一起檢視出來的，不是自己假設的：Biomatter Designs 的 Ieva Lingytė 與 Atrandi Biosciences 的 Dr. Juozas Nainys 審視並重新排序了專案的三條路徑，Dr. Ignas Galminas 聽取關於平台商業潛力的提案，Eglė Radzevičienė 就智慧財產權與產業現實提供建議，Vilnius University 創新部門則在 10 月做了市場分析。BMC 外殼作為藥物遞送奈米載體的治療可行性，也是向 Prof. Aurelija Žvirblienė 求證過，而非逕行宣稱。團隊另外在 Nordic iGEM Conference 發表。

**給 GEMS：** 用已發表的模型，而不是自己訓練一個，並且把理由說清楚：Ladder Detector 直接採用 GelGenie 經同儕審查的 U-Net 權重做分割，把自己的力氣花在沒人自動化過的那一步；並明確說明為何不用影像分類器——那會學到打光與解析度，而不是條帶位置。真正可移植的作法是他們的評估紀律：以分組與分層切分，避免同一張電泳膠影像的樣本在調參集與測試集之間洩漏；明列隨機猜測與多數類別兩條基線；提供各類別準確率表格；並公開診斷方法唯一失敗的那個類別。

### BNDS-China — OrbitColi
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/bnds-china/
BNDS-China built OrbitColi, an engineered E. coli probiotic designed to sense oxidative conditions arising from cosmic radiation and microgravity and respond by producing vitamin B2 and trehalose, replacing fixed-dose supplements that degrade over multi-year missions. The scientific framing is quantitative: ISS crews receive 100-200 mSv per year against a 20 mSv occupational limit, and a three-year Mars round trip may accumulate 300-450 mSv. The team's distinguishing contribution is methodological: they invented and applied a five-step education framework, R.E.A.C.H. (Recognize, Experience, Apply, Communicate, Harvest), to every single outreach activity, with a pre-event diagnostic survey and a matched post-event survey, and they report their own failures against it. Integrated Human Practices used a parallel STAR framework (Scan, Test, Assemble, Reflect) across five cycles.

**frameworks.** Two self-designed frameworks, both documented and reusable: R.E.A.C.H. for education (Recognize the audience's pre-existing attitudes before teaching; Experience through interactive formats; Apply by moving the audience from listeners to designers; Communicate to close the loop by harvesting informed project feedback into Integrated Human Practices; Harvest by quantifying the event's success and planning the next iteration) and STAR for iHP (Scan, Test, Assemble, Reflect) across five cycles: problem validation, end-user and market needs, technical design, biosafety and ethics, and production and final-product development. The REACH structure is published in detailed appendices so other teams can reuse it.

**datascience.** Systematic paired pre/post surveying with reported N and percentages, e.g. kindergarten cohort N = 14 matched responses, 21 student athletes aged 10-13 surveyed before and after, 16 valid responses per question from the elderly session, eight older adults aged 68-82 interviewed at the scoping stage, and two school-wide perception surveys on synthetic biology and on attitudes to engineered-bacteria consumption and space microbial applications, all published as downloadable files.

**dataviz.** Before-and-after bar charts of self-reported technique familiarity and interest; questionnaire-result figures published for each activity (pre and post); a timeline figure of all educational activities; pre-interview and final stakeholder influence/relevance maps for iHP, with the honest caveat printed on the figure that inclusion in the pre-interview map does not mean an interview took place.

**software.** The project includes hardware and software components presented to audiences for feedback; the team learned an AI protein-design workflow from team NBJF (generate structure, fill amino-acid sequence, in-silico screening, wet-lab validation) and explicitly reserved wet-lab capacity because high in-silico scores can lose function in reality.

**ihp.** Five iHP cycles (problem validation, end-user and market needs, technical design, biosafety and ethics, production and final product) were each run through the team's STAR loop. A pre-interview stakeholder map linked each cycle to the expert groups whose input it needed, and a final map recorded each stakeholder's influence on the project and the project's relevance to them. The team documented a hard limit transparently: regulatory restrictions prevented them from interviewing astronauts or national regulatory authorities. Aerospace food and nutrition experts defined the nutritional context; space medicine and clinical experts shaped the health-need and biosafety assessment. Education fed directly back into design, most notably the kindergarten children's biocontainment and mutualism questions. A cross-team exchange with team NBJF on AI protein design taught the team to compartmentalise the workflow and to avoid over-reliance on in-silico prediction, and they adopted NBJF's 'phenomenon-first, jargon-later' principle for explaining their AND logic-gate probiotic to lay audiences.

**publicEngagement.** BNDS-China's practice is distinctive because every activity is written up against the same five-step template, R.E.A.C.H., which forces a pre-event diagnostic, an interactive delivery, a design task, a project-feedback loop and a quantified post-event evaluation - and the team reports honestly where a step was skipped. The highest-value example is a kindergarten programme for pre-literate 5-6 year olds. The Recognize step established through a pre-event survey that children already saw microbes as invisible enemies (hand-washing framing) and that 71.43% preferred interactive games to lectures. The team then rendered BioBrick standard assembly as a colour-coded tactile block system: a blue 'switch' promoter block that must come first, a red 'function' coding-sequence block compared to a light bulb, a yellow 'stop' terminator block compared to a vehicle brake, and a green 'little house' vector and chassis block, with assembly order taught as a chanted mantra ('Flip open the blue switch, let the red function bloom, halt with the yellow brake, and live inside the green room!'). Children worked in pairs and trios called 'syndicates' with visual challenge cards posing local problems (make plants glow to light a path to a playground at night; make a flower that masks the smell of garbage). The cleverest design move: the team deliberately rationed parts, giving one table switches but no coding blocks and the next table the reverse, so children had to discover what they lacked, approach other groups and barter - a lived introduction to the open-source iGEM Registry. A five-act puppet show, 'Microscopic Defense Line', dramatised a grazed arm at cell scale, and deliberately avoided weapons or war imagery: the White Blood Cell puppet hugged the bacterium to represent phagocytosis, two red blood cell actors held hands to bridge a vessel, and platelet actors pressed yellow paper against stretchy cloth to show clotting. Measured results from matched surveys (N = 14): before, 78.57% did not know what it meant to pass a function from one organism to another and 64.29% did not know or only vaguely knew what a gene is; after, 92.86% described synthetic biology as 'building blocks', 92.86% knew the promoter starts expression and 100% knew the coding sequence determines function; 42.86% had thought the body fights invaders like 'little soldiers' and none knew clots form, versus 100% afterwards understanding both white blood cell clearance and platelet repair; 100% enjoyed the activities and 92.86% wanted more science stories. The feedback even changed the project: children asked why immune clearance has to kill ('Can't they just change them? Make them friends?') and worried what happens if the yellow stop block falls off, which the team mapped onto transcriptional runaway, biocontainment and biocontamination and used to question their own antagonistic-clearance therapeutic model. Other formats, each with REACH write-ups: a BioCamp lecture on the whole molecular toolkit (PCR, gel electrophoresis, Southern/Northern/Western blotting, qPCR, rtPCR, FISH, CRISPR-Cas9, gene circuits) where each technique was framed by the question it answers, with the team candidly recording that the Apply and Communicate steps did not happen and that students still found the techniques complicated without hands-on work, and publishing the fix (fewer techniques per session, add pipetting and gel loading, one workflow diagram); a formal debate on 9 March 2026 with the BNDS British Debate Club on whether synthetic biology should modify human traits unrelated to serious disease, supported by a purpose-written Synthetic Bio Debate Information Packet covering definitions, design principles, systems thinking, intervention targets, risks, ethics and governance, with pre- and post-debate questionnaires; a campus art exhibition on environmental protection with a pop-art digital painting and an explanatory signboard, made with a visual-arts student, where the recorded criticism was that the symbols were too abstract; a bilingual comic published in the school newspaper BNDS Review and released as downloadable Chinese and English digital versions; and merchandise-as-conversation-starter at the Hongchuanghui Fair and school carnival, with original E. coli, yeast and budding-yeast cartoon designs on postcards, stickers and acrylic hair clips, where the team explicitly explained which features were biological and which were artistic licence. The inclusivity work is specific about barriers. At Tianyun Rehabilitation Center in Liulihe, Fangshan District, Beijing, working with hearing-impaired children and children with genetic conditions, the team discovered the children had no independent electronic devices and that a conventional questionnaire did not suit their communication needs, so after consulting the centre's teachers they switched to an illustrated storybook, 'Little Chef Mimi and Her Magical Yeast Friends', plus a colouring activity, and relied on the teachers to interpret the children's sign language - concluding that inclusive science education is about making sure every child's voice can be heard, not just making knowledge easier. For children with osteogenesis imperfecta ('porcelain doll' patients), the team first interviewed directors of the Sun and Rain Center rare-disease organisation, who explicitly advised against treating participants as fragile or showing pity; sessions were kept short, and when the team noticed holding pens was physically hard for some children, they abandoned the planned drawing activity mid-session for an open discussion and a 'wishing' segment, then shifted their long-term approach to accessible online workshops and distributing game materials directly to hospitals. For 21 student athletes aged 10-13 with limited access to systematic biology teaching or lab equipment, three experiments (strawberry DNA extraction, saliva pH around exercise, ruler-drop reaction tests) tied biology to their own bodies; afterwards all 21 reported confidence in understanding and completing experiments and all answered the DNA and synthetic-biology questions correctly. A lecture for older adults, built on scoping interviews with eight people aged 68-82 whose concerns were medical safety, side effects and the reliability of health information, used genetically modified food, vaccines and microbial insulin as familiar anchors, taught how to spot misleading health advertising and how AI can help check claims, and included making DNA-themed bracelets and illustrated tote bags carrying health-scam reminders; of 16 post-event responses, 15 (93.75%) rejected a misleading miracle-product claim, all 16 answered the GM food, vaccine, insulin and AI-checking items as intended, 81.25% found explanations easy to understand and 87.5% called the activity very helpful.

**realWorld.** The project targets a documented gap in astronaut health protection: pre-packaged vitamins and antioxidants provide fixed dosing that cannot track real-time biochemical change, and shelf-life degradation makes them unreliable over multi-year missions. Education outputs were deliberately packaged for reuse: an openly available children's book, downloadable comic in Chinese and English, the debate information packet, lecture slide decks, bilingual activity PowerPoints, the strawberry DNA extraction protocol, and detailed REACH appendices so other teams and educators can replicate the structure rather than just the activities.

**給 GEMS：** Adopt a single named template for every outreach event - BNDS-China's R.E.A.C.H. (Recognize with a pre-event diagnostic, Experience, Apply, Communicate project feedback back into design, Harvest with a matched post-event survey) - and publish the results including the steps you failed to complete; the paired pre/post numbers and the honest gaps are what turn a scrapbook of events into evidence.

### McGill — LanTurn
Undergrad · Canada · https://2026.igem.wiki/mcgill/
McGill 改造 Saccharomyces cerevisiae EBY100，透過 Aga1-Aga2 系統將 lanmodulin 變異體展示於細胞表面以選擇性結合稀土元素，並以藍光 VP16-EL222 / C120 光遺傳學迴路驅動截短的 678FLO1 絮凝素，使細胞可依指令絮凝，讓吸附稀土的細胞以重力沉降取代離心分離。光誘導絮凝達 66-75%，暗處對照組為 24-25%；LanM 表面展示則以流式細胞術與共軛焦顯微術確認。其商業論證是完整的工業級技術經濟分析，而不是一張商業模式圖：涵蓋 gate-to-gate 的資本支出與營運支出、每公斤 REO 11.83-20.58 美元的單位成本、以魁北克 Nunavik 的 Ashram 尾礦為對象的全規模 NPV 個案研究，以及七項獨立的敏感度分析。他們入圍 Best Entrepreneurship（大學部）與 Best Biomanufacturing。

**frameworks.** 以技術成熟度等級（TRL，NASA 的九級量表；之所以選用，是因為加拿大的清潔科技與礦業補助計畫都以 TRL 作為門檻）作為四階段分期開發計畫的骨幹，每一階段都列出目標、具名合作夥伴、資金金額與來源，以及風險與緩解對策表。此外還有分成三部分的技術經濟分析（gate-to-gate、全規模個案研究、敏感度分析）、把競爭者分為直接、替代與未來三層的分析、四種選項的退場計畫、對照顧問團成員盤點的技能缺口分析、智慧財產權與 freedom-to-operate 檢視，以及附一頁式簡介的一年期公司設立計畫。

**datascience.** 真正達到工業水準的分析。以 Excel 建立質量平衡，條件為 PLS 年處理量 1,200,000 立方公尺、稀土濃度 1 g/L、目標回收率 80%；並以每公斤 TREO 的單位成本，對照溶劑萃取、管柱固定化 lanmodulin 與以 Caulobacter 為基礎的生物吸附劑做基準比較；高採用情境下 15 年 NPV 為 5,100 萬美元，低採用情境為 -20 萬美元，回收期 2.6-5.9 年。敏感度分析產出的是真正可用的工程目標：吸附容量約 23 mg/g 為損益平衡點，若計入混合 REO 的 20-30% 雜質折價，門檻升到約 35 mg/g；脫附效率每下降 5%，專案價值約減少 1,000 萬美元；獲利能力幾乎完全取決於 PLS 的初始 pH 值，而不是生物吸附劑的操作 pH 值；折現率高於 15% 時，低採用情境就轉為負值。另外，乾實驗室的 TORCH 專案以 GROMACS 分子動力學搭配 QM/MM 改造 LanM 的結合位點，其中還包括一段真實的除錯經歷：週期性邊界條件讓 RMSD 被放大十倍。

**dataviz.** 以分頁呈現的創業頁面，包含關鍵原料流向的 Sankey 流程圖、稀土需求與專案缺口圖、技術經濟分析的工作流程圖、gate-to-gate 與全規模兩種情境的資本支出與營運支出表、財務分析面板，以及七張敏感度圖表（吸附容量、脫附效率、產品純度折價、原料品位、酵母投加濃度、PLS pH 值、折現率），另有代工模式的製程示意圖與顧問團名錄。

**software.** TORCH，一套用於最佳化 lanmodulin 結合位點的 QM/MM 與分子動力學流程，並自行撰寫程式計算 RMSD、分群、徑向分布函數，以及依氧原子距離明確計算配位數。

**ihp.** 接觸超過 100 位利害關係人，並以一張諮詢地圖標示誰影響了哪一項決定、又被轉介給誰，明確主張沒有任何一次諮詢能獨立成立。真正造成影響的諮詢，都以推翻原案的形式記錄下來。在 Dr. Michael Free 等人指出分離因子無法支撐其主張、而且經濟性其實只取決於純度最後的 0.9% 之後，團隊徹底放棄稀土超高純度精煉，改將定位轉向溶劑萃取前的選擇性濃縮。原料選擇來自 CVW Sustainable Royalties 的 Dr. Jayme Fehyl-Buska 與 Dr. Kevin Moran；UNEP 的 Ms. Julia Vilela Carvalho 以責任歸屬與環境法規為理由，引導他們選擇新產生的尾礦而非舊有尾礦；Nuvau Minerals Corp. 的 Peter van Alphen、Bastien Fresia 與 Gilles Roy 確認礦場有足夠空間、也習慣處置新產生的物料，這正是製程被設計成圍繞礦場既有設備的原因，他們並建議採用代工模式。實驗流程層面的諮詢一再救回失敗的實驗：Dr. Denzel Ignacia 建議把絮凝誘導的 OD 提高到 3-5；Mira Loock 提供專為表面展示設計、在 OD 0.8-1.2 進行的實驗流程，終於做出金屬結合的陽性結果；Michael Bellucci 看出限制酶切位相距不到 30 bp 正是切割失敗的原因。Earthworks 的 Jan Morrill 反駁他們的永續論述，強調再開採可能造成與直接開採同等的傷害，並教他們自由、事先與知情同意（FPIC）的框架。Dr. Yvette Baninla 把分析擴及稀土境外加工的地緣政治與原住民族諮詢議題。

**publicEngagement.** 團隊自辦年度合成生物學會議 On the Verge，2026 年主題為 On the Verge of Running Out: Building the Bioeconomy，刻意圍繞資源開採議題，聚集企業界領袖、新創創辦人、政策專家、研究者與學生。他們也在學校與夏令營舉辦工作坊（微生物繪畫、酸鹼化學），並回應一位老師希望有更進階基因工程工作坊的請求，正嘗試以色素蛋白提供新的顏色選擇。

**realWorld.** 是 iGEM 2026 中商業化論證最紮實的隊伍之一，也是本組唯一有第三方書面承諾的隊伍。商業模式是 B2B 的現場代工服務：尾礦的所有權與法律責任留在礦場，LanTurn 在現場營運一座小型模組化廠房，交回濃縮的混合稀土氧化物，既省去運輸成本，也讓尾礦管理責任不落在 LanTurn 帳上。這個模式由 Nuvau Minerals Corp. 建議，之後又在 REM3 Executive Summit 上與潛在買方和原料供應者再次驗證。單位經濟是算出來的，不是喊出來的：gate-to-gate 每公斤 REO 11.83-20.58 美元，其中約 92% 的資本支出在脫附管柱與樹脂，54-68% 的營運支出在發酵；並與溶劑萃取（最差情況貴 12%，最好情況在不純的低品位原料上便宜 370-720%）、管柱固定化 lanmodulin（便宜 16-100%）以及鑭系結合標籤生物吸附劑比較。設計選擇逐項都有成本依據，這相當少見：表面展示對比固定於 agarose 樹脂的純化 LanM、絮凝對比連續離心（不過他們老實指出這只省下每公斤 TREO 0.21 美元，並不特別顯著），以及光誘導對比銅、乙醇或半乳糖誘導。Ashram 個案研究用的是真實礦床，有 51 Mt 浮選尾礦、TREO 品位約 0.4%；樂觀情境下 15 年 NPV 為 5,100 萬美元、回收期 2.6 年，悲觀情境下 NPV 略為負值、回收期 5.9 年，而他們把兩者都講出來，不只引用好看的數字。尾礦中鎖住 5,600 億美元價值這個標題數字是自己推導的，不是引用來的：尾礦噸數乘以稀土濃度乘以市場價格，並因為是混合稀土而非純稀土而打了 70% 折扣，接著立刻把它與全球稀土市場僅約 45 億美元的規模並列對照。機構層面的進展也很具體：2026 年 9 月進入 McGill Dobson Centre for Entrepreneurship 的 Dobson Lean Startup Accelerator；BoxOne Ventures 清潔科技投資經理 Felicity Meyer 持續提供指導；Chris Corkery 就 McGill 的研究商業化與技術移轉路徑提供建議；十一人顧問團涵蓋濕法冶金、礦業、創投、生物製造與法規事務；公開 Nuvau Minerals Corp. 的 Bastien Fresia 與 Kingston Process Metallurgy 的 Dr. Boyd Davis 的支持信；已從一家大型加拿大礦業公司取得真實尾礦樣品，對方並打算與他們繼續合作研究；放大生產設施也都指名（Concordia Bioprocessing Facility 的 1000 L 規模、KPM 位於 Kingston 的 10,000 平方英尺試量產廠及其 2027 年成立的生物採礦部門、Sudbury 的生物浸出設施）。募資計畫分階段而且寫得很細：實驗室階段四個季度約需 28,800 美元，來自校內經費與不稀釋股權的補助（NSERC、NRC IRAP、NFRF）；公司設立後再找天使與清潔科技創投；後續階段則指向 NRCan 的 CMRDD 計畫（TRL 6-8 通常為 400 萬美元以上）與 MICA Canada（TRL 7-9 最高 250 萬美元），並以實際的生物採礦募資案做對照（Allonnia 的 2,000 萬美元 A 輪、pH7 的 3,200 萬美元 B 輪）。智慧財產權的工作是真做而不是口號：他們查證酵母表面展示的基礎專利 US6699658B1 與 US7465787B2 已到期，找出仍有效的 LanM 專利（CA3170828A1、CA3223988A1、US20240183787A1），以及 Princeton 一件尚在審查的申請案 WO2025240129A2，該案明確主張在 S. cerevisiae 中使用 EL222/C120 光遺傳學，並據此結論他們必須在技術上做出區隔、在發表任何可專利內容前先向 McGill 技術移轉辦公室揭露，並進行正式的 freedom-to-operate 分析。保留事項也講得直白：公司尚未設立，只有一份一年期的設立計畫；沒有營收、沒有簽定的代工合約、也沒有投資條件書；他們並直言技術經濟分析中許多參數是文獻估計值而非自己量測的結果，而這正是敏感度分析存在的理由：它是給濕實驗室與乾實驗室的降風險待辦清單。他們的倫理自我評估罕見地不替自己說話，承認 LanTurn 既沒有修復尾礦，也沒有實質減少尾礦量；再開採可能把採礦的傷害重新帶回那些幾十年沒有新礦場的社區；而這些稀土多數會流向消費產品與國防，而不是清潔能源的故事，並明確承諾不會用後者來行銷。

**給 GEMS：** 及早做技術經濟分析，並讓敏感度分析的結果來設定實驗室的實驗目標：McGill 的技術經濟分析算出一個硬指標（計入混合氧化物雜質折價後約 35 mg/g 的吸附容量），這個數字成為濕實驗室的降風險目標；商業化工作要這樣才站得住腳，而不是擺在科學旁邊各做各的。再搭配他們以 TRL 分期的計畫，每一階段都寫明資金金額、資金來源與具名的合作設施，讓機構一眼就看出下一階段要花多少錢、需要誰點頭。

### NBJF — AI-assisted de novo design of a thermostable TdT for enzymatic DNA synthesis
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/nbjf/
NBJF tackled the write step of DNA data storage. Enzymatic DNA synthesis using terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase (TdT) avoids the toxic chemistry of phosphoramidite synthesis, but wild-type TdT has a melting temperature of roughly 40 C and a catalytic pocket that does not accommodate bulky modified nucleotides. Over seven Design-Build-Test-Learn cycles the team built an AI-assisted de novo protein design pipeline (RFdiffusion backbone generation, ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN inverse folding, ESMFold and AlphaFold refolding checks, TemStaPro and SaProt thermostability scoring), screened a large candidate library down to a shortlist, expressed 85 designs, and obtained a de novo TdT that retains DNA extension activity at elevated temperature and accepts oxyamino-modified nucleotides. A final cycle used 100 ns molecular dynamics at 300/350/400 K to explain why.

**frameworks.** Structure-based generative protein design plus all-atom molecular dynamics, not kinetic modelling. The design loop is: functionally constrained RFdiffusion backbone generation (motif scaffolding, keeping the DNA-binding region and active site as constraints) -> ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN inverse folding (LigandMPNN used for sequence design in the DNA-containing structural environment) -> ESMFold for structural recovery -> AlphaFold refinement -> TemStaPro (sequence-based) and SaProt (structure-based) thermostability scoring. Cycle 7 is a full biophysics workflow: AlphaFold 3 protein-DNA-dATP-2Mg2+-Na+ complex model, ORCA quantum-chemical geometry optimisation of dATP, RESP charges via Multiwfn, AmberTools parameterisation, ff19SB protein / OL21 DNA / OPC water / GAFF ligand force fields, energy minimisation, NVT heating, NPT density equilibration with gradual restraint release, then 100 ns production runs per system at 300 K, 350 K and 400 K.

**datascience.** Library-scale screening with explicit multi-metric criteria instead of a single score: two independent design batches of 100 backbones each, 1,000 inverse-folded sequences per backbone, scored on both RMSD to the design target and pLDDT, yielding 94 candidates meeting both thresholds. Later cycles add cross-model agreement (ESMFold recovery plus two orthogonal thermostability predictors) and a spatial-placeholder strategy to enlarge the catalytic pocket. Experimental side: 85 de novo sequences expressed under one unified B0034/expression framework, 25 giving detectable SDS-PAGE expression - reported as an application dataset rather than a success claim.

**dataviz.** Quantitative screening plots rather than decoration: RMSD-versus-pLDDT scatter of the whole candidate library showing the trade-off and the small fraction satisfying both criteria, representative predicted-structure overlays showing the failure mode (compact Rossmann-like folds instead of the open catalytic conformation), and MD analysis panels for RMSD, RMSF, DSSP secondary-structure occupancy, hydrogen-bond counts, radius of gyration, SASA, free-energy landscapes and Markov state model populations. The engineering page also carries a reading-guide layout that routes a non-specialist through four entry points.

**software.** No standalone released application, but the team wrote automated scripts chaining backbone generation, sequence design, structural validation, candidate screening and MD analysis, and publish this as a reproducible, scalable de novo protein design workflow explicitly intended to lower the barrier for future iGEM teams. The Software special-award page was not among the project's own pages.

**ihp.** An ASK -> LISTEN -> REFLECT -> INTEGRATE -> EVALUATE framework applied across four milestones, with the team stating up front that they did not want Human Practices to be a photo album. The decisive conversation was with Li Yang, an information-storage professional at Huawei, who pointed out that storage density alone decides nothing and that write/read/reliability/maintenance costs govern adoption - after which the team explicitly abandoned 'build a DNA storage device' and narrowed to the enzymatic-writing bottleneck. Han Minghao (synthetic biology / DNA engineering) then identified TdT thermostability, substrate compatibility and reaction controllability as the specific handles. Later stages cover intellectual property (two lawyers, Zhang and Wu, on who owns an AI-designed protein and on open science versus commercialisation), sustainability (Mr Liao on agricultural production, leading to a stated sustainability position on whether enzymatic synthesis is genuinely greener), and a Responsible AI section. Eight stakeholder categories were mapped.

**publicEngagement.** A seven-stage education programme that is unusually serious about access rather than reach: synthetic biology classes in schools; accessibility work including sign-language science communication and multilingual courses; creative formats (picture books, board games, art activities); community-specific sessions; digital microlearning; an explicit 'Inclusion and Equal Opportunities in STEM' stage; and international/cross-school scientific exchange. The team also co-built an educational website referenced by ZQT-Nanjing.

**realWorld.** The project is positioned as a tool-enzyme improvement inside a named industrial bottleneck rather than a finished product, which is the right call and was itself a Human Practices outcome. Deliverables for reuse: six new coding parts (BBa_263ET0E5 De novo TdT as the primary characterised part, plus five sequence-diverse variants BBa_26DIWVPI, BBa_266N6QG1, BBa_26BMB5EM, BBa_26NOOCP1, BBa_26YHUEKK), new application data added to the existing RBS BBa_B0034 documenting its behaviour across a library of 85 artificially designed coding sequences, and the automated de novo design workflow itself. The IP strand is unusually mature for a high-school team: they asked practising lawyers who owns an AI-generated sequence before assuming they could license it.

**給 GEMS：** This is the ceiling, not the benchmark: the generative-design half (RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, ESMFold, AlphaFold, TemStaPro) is genuinely reachable by a strong high-school team in one season because the tools are free, documented and runnable on Colab-class GPUs, but Cycle 7 - ORCA quantum chemistry, RESP charge fitting, four-force-field Amber parameterisation and 100 ns MD at three temperatures with Markov state analysis - is not something students assemble unaided. The limiting factors there are mentorship and compute in that order; a Taiwanese programme could reproduce NBJF's screening pipeline with a laptop and a cloud GPU, but would need a university collaborator to attempt the MD.

### SDU-Denmark — Shewanode
Overgrad · Denmark · https://2026.igem.wiki/sdu-denmark/
SDU-Denmark engineered Shewanella oneidensis MR-1 to improve extracellular electron transfer and built the hardware to measure it: first a two-chamber microbial fuel cell as proof of concept, then a single-chamber design with an air-breathing cathode and carbon felt electrode that became the team's primary electrochemical measurement system. The measurement work centres on the outer membrane vesicles that carry the MtrCAB cytochrome complex, asking how to isolate them reproducibly and how to quantify their size, morphology, charge and concentration. Each question is answered with complementary methods, each with stated calibration, controls, replicates and limitations. Along the way the team documented a working anolyte recipe, which the literature generally leaves as 'Shewanella basal medium', and released it for other teams.

**frameworks.** The measurement page is structured by goal rather than by technique: each goal states the question, the method, the calibration, the controls and replicates, the results, a discussion and an explicit limitations section. Complementary quantitative and qualitative methods are paired deliberately (preparative size exclusion chromatography with quantitative BCA; qualitative helium ion and scanning electron microscopy with quantitative DLS and zeta potential), and the team states where a method cannot support a claim.

**datascience.** Vesicle isolation is verified rather than assumed. A BCA assay against a BSA dilution series at 562 nm gives the standard curve, and each size-exclusion fraction is then measured twice, once untreated and once lysed with Triton X-100 for 10 minutes on ice, with an isolation-buffer-plus-Triton control confirming the detergent itself does not shift absorbance. The lysed fractions read 100 to 200 ug/mL against lower unlysed values, which is the argument that intact vesicles are present and only open on lysis; fractions above 2 mg/mL are explicitly flagged as exceeding the assay's upper linear range and excluded from interpretation. Morphology is imaged by helium ion microscopy and SEM and quantified in Fiji (wildtype n = 29 particles, mean Feret diameter 288.3 +/- 97.9 nm, circularity 0.837; mutant n = 18, 300.6 +/- 69.6 nm, circularity 0.767), and the team then states that without a buffer-only blank slide taken through the same fixation and drying the structures cannot be definitively identified as vesicles, and that some sharp-edged objects may be crystallised solvent. Size, concentration and charge come from a Malvern Zetasizer Advance Ultra Red Label with every instrument setting published (material refractive index 1.45, absorption 0.001, 25 C, dispersant RI 1.33, viscosity 0.887, dielectric constant 78.5), three biological replicates from different colonies, and technical replicates where the instrument allowed. Main-peak diameters cluster at 130 to 171 nm with z-averages of 87 to 147 nm, polydispersity indices up to 0.39 are read as genuine heterogeneity, and the team reasons through the candidate causes (subpopulations, artefacts, residual protein) using the BCA separation as evidence against one of them. Zeta potential is reported as wildtype -5.532 +/- 0.5955 mV versus MtrCAB-overexpressing mutant -4.671 +/- 0.3632 mV, the direction predicted by the hypothesis but a smaller change than expected, which the team attributes to PBS ions partially neutralising surface charge and proposes repeating in lower-ionic-strength solvents. The reported limitations are unusually candid: BSA is acknowledged as an imperfect standard for a mixed vesicle proteome; DLS is noted as sensitive to dust and aggregates, blind to morphology, and dependent on analysis models the team could not inspect because only data reports were produced; and technical replicates missing from some samples are identified as a possible artificial source of the observed subpopulations. Electrochemistry is logged as a voltage drop across a 100 ohm resistor on a PicoLog 1216, with the first current rise after about two days reported as indicative only because the experiment ran without biological replicates. The heme assay uses a standard curve to convert absorbance to micromolar concentration, with two biological replicates whose individual points are plotted alongside the means and the explicit statement that no standardised protocol exists for this application so the method would need further validation.

**dataviz.** BCA calibration curve of blank-corrected absorbance against BSA concentration; per-fraction protein concentration plots with lysed and unlysed series and a zoomed inset; DLS size-distribution-by-intensity panels with correlation functions for each biological replicate; full Zetasizer statistics tables reporting mean, standard deviation, relative standard deviation, minimum and maximum, and including the instrument's own intercept and fit error; current-versus-time traces from the single-chamber MFC and the H-cell; heme concentration bar plots showing both means and individual replicate points.

**software.** An Arduino-based voltage logger was built for the two-chamber MFC as a low-cost alternative to dedicated logging equipment; the single-chamber system was logged on a PicoLog 1216. A hardware parts list is published for download, together with the anolyte recipe and standard operating procedures for each measurement method.

**ihp.** Human Practices is the largest single page on the wiki and is credited with changing the project's direction. Stakeholder discussion moved the target away from large-scale energy production toward reliability of low-power generation, which reframed the application space around environmental monitoring sensors, decentralised low-power supply, wastewater treatment with simultaneous energy recovery, and biosensor-style monitoring of marine, agricultural and remote infrastructure.

**realWorld.** The application page sets out five pathways with explicit preconditions rather than claims: low-power generation for sensors triggered by a pollutant; decentralised continuous supply, conditional on storage; a battery alternative justified by the environmental cost of lithium, cobalt and nickel extraction; wastewater treatment, which would require redesigning the cell so water can flow through; and monitoring circuits where an interruption produces a signal. The team states that stability, output and maintenance all need assessment before any of these is feasible, and that the right application depends on matching the cell's capability to a specific device's energy requirement.

**給 GEMS：** Publish the instrument settings, not just the result: the refractive index, absorption, viscosity and dielectric constant used for a DLS run, the resistor value behind a current measurement, and the statistics the instrument reports about its own fit quality. A number without its acquisition settings cannot be reproduced or contested.

### UFABC-Brazil — Patchlepsy
Overgrad · Brazil · https://2026.igem.wiki/ufabc-brazil/
Patchlepsy is a toehold-switch biosensor designed to detect three tRNA-derived fragments (5'GlyGCC, 5'AlaTGC, 5'GluCTC) whose plasma levels rise before seizures in temporal lobe epilepsy, as reported by Hogg et al. (2019). Each switch releases a different chromoprotein reporter (mRFP1, AmilCP, fwYellow), read by a low-cost ESP32 plus AS7341 multispectral device and logged in a mobile app. To the team's knowledge these are the first toehold switches targeting tRFs rather than microRNAs. The cell-free assays never activated in either a CFPS extract kit or PURExpress, and the team publishes that failure with its two mechanistic hypotheses; the whole-cell system did work, with the GlyGCC/mRFP1 switch reaching a fold change of up to 23 in the presence of its trigger. The whole wiki is bilingual English and Portuguese.

**frameworks.** Design followed the Green et al. (2014) toehold architecture with the recognition domains rewritten as the complement of each target tRF, and domains c and d constrained by explicit sequence patterns (c defined first as N4VVVVVVVGAGGAGAWWWWN2AUG, then revised to N4VVVVVVVAGAGGAGAWWWWN2AUG with an added adenine to widen the RBS, with A4/C4/G4/U4/K6/M6/R6/S6/W6/Y6 runs and stop codons forbidden in domain d). Candidates were generated by an in-house script, 30 in the first round and 80 per target in the second, and ranked in NUPACK on equilibrium probability, predicted folding, free energy of toehold alone versus toehold-target complex, and probability of strand displacement. Structures were built in RNAComposer, docked in HADDOCK3, and the complexes simulated in GROMACS 2024 (steepest-descent minimisation, 100 ps NVT, 1 ns NPT, AMBER99SB-ILDN force field, explicit TIP3P water in a periodic dodecahedral box, 0.15 M Na+/Cl-, Particle Mesh Ewald, 1.0 nm cutoffs), reporting RMSD, radius of gyration, hydrogen-bond counts and per-nucleotide RMSF. Three switches are deposited in the Registry.

**datascience.** Two reproducible pipelines, both published on GitLab. The tRF quantification pipeline reanalyses the Hogg et al. (2019) small RNA-seq dataset across two collection sites: fastp preprocessing (minimum Phred 20, 15-50 nt), Bowtie2 alignment to a tRNA reference in --very-sensitive-local mode reporting up to 10 alignments per read because of tRNA similarity, and Samtools handling, quantifying at both isoacceptor and individual-fragment level as a built-in consistency check. The cross-reactivity pipeline runs BLASTn of query sequences against a genome panel and classifies alignments by similarity tier; run with three complete tRNA sequences against 150 E. coli genome assemblies it produced 12,480 unique alignments, predominantly moderate similarity, before anything was tested in the chassis.

**dataviz.** DataSUS and IBGE epidemiology is visualised as time series of hospitalisations and costs (2020-2026), choropleth maps of Brazil by state and of the seven ABC Paulista municipalities normalised per 10,000 inhabitants using IBGE SIDRA Tabela 6579, stacked contributions of epilepsy to all nervous-system disease hospitalisations and costs, Likert distributions for the 44-respondent survey, a before-and-after SWOT matrix pair, and a two-axis stakeholder interest-versus-influence matrix built from scores each interviewee gave on a 0-10 scale.

**software.** A Python acquisition and processing application drives the ESP32 and AS7341 across ten spectral channels, with background correction added after the first run saturated channels F2, F4, F5, F6, F7 and Clear at 65,535, and with raw readings preserved separately from background-corrected values for traceability plus an export function. A mobile prototype built in MIT App Inventor records readings, keeps a diary and raises an alert when a previously registered value recurs; the team states clearly that automatic sensor integration and spectral-marker interpretation were not completed.

**ihp.** The IHP is organised as a four-step causal chain and is genuinely integrated rather than consultative. Step one asked whether the problem is real, using DataSUS (SIH/SUS) with IBGE population denominators: epilepsy hospitalisations in Brazil rose from 49,204 in 2020 to 73,222 in 2025 (+48.8%) while their cost to SUS rose from R$ 43,692,171 to R$ 92,460,210 (+111.6%), so cost per admission grew faster than admissions; epilepsy accounts for 28-30% of all nervous-system disease hospitalisations nationally and 40-50% in the team's own ABC Paulista region. Critically, the team reads its own maps against itself, noting that Sao Caetano do Sul, long the highest-HDI municipality in Brazil, also records the most hospitalisations, which more plausibly reflects access to the health system than disease frequency, so 'the real burden is likely greater than what DataSUS is able to capture', and citing IEPS data that average travel time to an ICU bed is 3.3 hours in the Legal Amazon against 0.3 hours elsewhere. Step two put the team's own internal SWOT to the people who would use the device: a survey of 44 people with epilepsy, reached through ABE and approved by a Brazilian Research Ethics Committee, with each SWOT point converted into a Likert question and a rule for confirmation or refutation declared before the results were seen. Two assumptions were refuted and the matrix was redrawn: the expected concern about personal health data moved from weaknesses to strengths, and distrust of a seizure-predicting technology moved from threats to opportunities. Step three was eleven ethics-approved stakeholder interviews across research, clinical practice, industry and public policy, each closing with 0-10 scores for interest and influence that built a stakeholder matrix; the team's own conclusion from it is that the people with most influence over whether Patchlepsy reaches patients are not the technology developers but clinicians, industry and public policy. Step four is where the design actually moved, and the strongest chain is convergent rather than single-source: five stakeholders independently pushed away from a pipetted cell-free reaction, for five different reasons, with Prof. Cintia Marques Coelho (UnB Synthetic Biology Lab) saying the cell-free system is expensive, needs refrigeration, pipetting and controls and would make the device inaccessible, Fabricio Pamplona proposing a strip format and portability from the start, Karen Uchiyama recommending filter paper specifically because it makes the device safer and easier to document for ANVISA, Amanda Mendes do Carmo (clinical research pharmacist, market access) asking for something easy to maintain and carry, and Prof. Danielle Biscaro Pedrolli insisting the test must not depend on the qualification of whoever uses it. The hardware was rebuilt around a filter-paper strip inserted through a slot between the LED and the sensor, with the cell-free reaction embedded in the paper as the declared next step, citing Karlikow et al. (2022), who validated paper-based cell-free toehold assays on patient samples in Recife at US$ 5.48 per test against US$ 11 for RT-qPCR in a freeze-dried, refrigeration-free format. A second chain changed the DNA itself: Danielle flagged that the antibiotic resistance gene in the plasmids rules out home use and complicates disposal, Karen reinforced that ANVISA would require a documented use-and-disposal workflow, and because the team had kept BioBrick prefix and suffix on its toehold plasmids from the start it could produce the constructs as linear DNA with no resistance marker (untested at the deadline, and the team says so). A third chain made leakage the central technical question after Prof. Elibio Rech, Danielle and Luiz Caires independently warned about leakage and physiological tRF concentrations, which is why the team characterised leakage experimentally in its own constructs instead of relying on predictions. Two stakeholder inputs were integrated as honest downgrades rather than features: Prof. Alexandre Kihara made the team distinguish predicting an imminent seizure from monitoring seizure susceptibility, after which they describe their result as a proof of concept of tRF-responsive sensing and not prediction, and Elibio pointed out their tRF evidence comes from one population with gender differences, so they state plainly that they do not yet know for whom these biomarkers work. Dr. Cezzar Santos de Souza, a psychiatrist at CAPS Nucleo de Atencao Casa Aberta in the public system, showed them that for patients with intellectual disabilities who cannot recognise or communicate an aura, an alert is only useful if it reaches somebody else, which, with 93.2% of survey respondents saying early detection would help caregivers, became a committed design change: the alert goes to a registered support network. And because 40.9% said such a technology could itself cause anxiety, they decided the alert must communicate increased risk within a time window plus what to do about it, never a seizure as a certainty, with the user choosing how and whether they are warned.

**publicEngagement.** Engagement was built around stigma rather than around the technology. The team joined the Marco Roxo awareness walk organised by the Brazilian Epilepsy Association (ABE) in Sao Paulo in March 2026, produced an original documentary, 'Epilepsy: What You Don't See', featuring people living with epilepsy and their relatives, and on 29 September 2026 screened it with ABE followed by a roundtable with a pediatric neurologist (Dr. Daniela Bezerra), a person living with epilepsy (Gustavo Theodoro) and the mother of a child with a rare neurological condition associated with epilepsy (Angelica Akemi). Educational work was gamified: escape rooms in public state schools across the ABC region during Brain Awareness Week (10-14 March 2025, with Pense Brain and faculty, for 9th grade to 3rd year of high school, using puzzles, quizzes and 3D skull and brain models), and a synthetic-biology escape room at UFABC for Biotechnologist Day with LiNA Biotecnologia UFABC in which teams assembled complementary DNA sequences and constructed plasmids. Explanatory flyers were written separately for young people and for older adults, on the reasoning that informational needs differ by group, and they teach bystanders how to assist during a seizure safely. An Introduction to Synthetic Biology mini-course, a poster and talks at the II Brazilian Synthetic Biology Congress, Bio's Start and Semana de Biotecnologia round it out.
