SDG claims are tied to named sub-targets with the team's own evidence: 13.1/13.2/13.3 (melt-reduction test, policy reference materials, climate education), 12.2/12.4/12.5/12.8 (BC life-cycle, cited cradle-to-gate LCA by Forte et al. 2021, residue reuse), 9.5 (industrial fermentation feasibility, citing Dourado et al. 2016), 6.1/6.4/6.6 and 15.1/15.4, plus a candid spillover analysis flagging SDG 7 energy demand from scale-up, SDG 8 high-altitude worker safety, and an SDG 10 equity risk that high deployment cost would concentrate protection in well-funded locations. On cost the team refuses to overclaim: it states that agricultural by-products do not automatically make BC cheaper, that the alternative-carbon-source process is unvalidated and its yield unmeasured, and that a full-life-cycle cost model covering production, maintenance, replacement, waste treatment and recovery - expressed as cost per unit area and per unit of ice melt avoided - must precede any scale-up. Next steps are paired control/treatment plots on real glaciers with continuous monitoring through research stations such as the Aza Glacier Citizen Science Monitoring Site (now part of Polar Future's long-term observation network), plus a standing offer from Professor Xian-En Zhang (Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology) to host further experiments.

**給 GEMS：** Adopt RDFZ-China's Why-How-What-Adaptation template, where every stakeholder entry must end in a named design change or an explicitly rejected option, and copy their habit of converting a stakeholder's worry into a measurable bench test (wind-tearing concern becomes an 11.7 N tensile figure; reflectivity advice becomes an infrared transmission curve).

### SEHS — FusionDrive - an anti-TIGIT-IL-2v fusion protein for gastric cancer immunotherapy
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/sehs/
Starting from the high gastric-cancer burden in their home province of Shandong, SEHS designed FusionDrive, a fusion protein joining an anti-TIGIT antibody to an engineered IL-2 variant through a G4S linker. The antibody Fab blocks CD155-TIGIT inhibitory signalling to reverse T-cell exhaustion, while the Fc-fused IL-2v carries a low-alpha/high-beta modification that reduces CD25 binding and so biases stimulation away from regulatory T cells. Across five DBTL cycles the team built the antibody, the wild-type IL-2 fusion and the variant fusion in CHO cells and compared them by SDS-PAGE, TIGIT-binding ELISA (EC50 0.6317 nM for the antibody, 1.335 nM after IL-2 fusion) and flow cytometry for CD25 and pSTAT5. Because the iGEM high-school White List left Jurkat as the only available T-cell line, they used PHA induction to create CD25-high and CD25-low populations as a stand-in for the Treg receptor phenotype.

**frameworks.** No computational model of any kind: there is no Model or Software page on the site, and no docking, structure prediction or kinetic simulation anywhere in the project. The design reasoning is literature-driven (lowalpha/highbeta IL-2 variants, G4S linker flexibility) rather than simulated. The hardware page does include a comparative literature review of three published protein-detection instruments used to specify a device.

**datascience.** Dose-response curve fitting to extract EC50 is the real quantitative work, and it is done properly - including diagnosing why the first ELISA saturated (the TIGIT-Fc coating antigen was being detected by the anti-human IgG1-HRP secondary) and re-running with His-tagged TIGIT. Flow-cytometry gating is used to separate populations and compare signalling within each, with both %positive and MFI reported rather than one summary number. No inferential statistics (no ANOVA, no stated replicate counts or error bars in the text), so the analysis is descriptive rather than statistical.

**dataviz.** Clean, interpretable assay figures: concentration-response ELISA binding curves for all three molecular formats with fitted EC50 values, flow-cytometry panels reporting both positive-cell percentage and mean fluorescence intensity, PHA induction screening results, and pSTAT5 response split across CD25-defined subpopulations. Figure captions state what is being compared.

**software.** None.

**ihp.** Genuinely project-shaping, organised around four questions and a stakeholder table that pairs each input with the team's response and its outcome status. The pivot is documented honestly: the team began assuming alcohol consumption meant liver cancer, and oncologist Dr Meng Min redirected them to gastric cancer, pointing out that because gastric cancer is predominantly East Asian it receives less targeted-drug investment than globally prevalent cancers. Professor Yang Zhe's warning about excessive immune activation reframed the bifunctional design and set 'advanced gastric cancer, combination therapy' as the research context. Antibody engineer Professor Liu Zhifang's point that binding must be re-measured after adding modules is directly why TIGIT binding was tested separately for all three formats. A WuXi AppTec expert (anonymised as Dr Z) pushed them to distinguish a change in response bias from a change in overall activity, and reviewed their questionnaire wording. A patient's family member (Ms Wang) shifted the evaluation goal toward completing treatment rather than efficacy alone. The Safety and Security Committee exchange is what selected CHO cells as the chassis.

**publicEngagement.** Modest and mostly instrumental to the Human Practices work rather than a programme in its own right. There is an online questionnaire with 131 respondents (concerns clustered on efficacy, long-term side effects and cost, plus a stated appetite for disease knowledge), school outreach including a session with 15 final-year high-school students with a post-activity feedback survey, and a dual-use forum organised with two Shandong University academics after the iGEM Safety and Security Committee raised dual-use analysis. The Education page exists but is empty.

**realWorld.** The Alternative Platform page is the real deliverable and the most transferable thing here: a documented mammalian expression and functional-evaluation workflow built entirely inside the 2025-onward iGEM high-school White List, which bans Check-in and Animal Use forms. CHO cells produce the molecules, Jurkat cells measure the response, and the team shows how to translate a tumour-immunology question into something testable with only a whitelisted cell line - including the PHA/CD25 trick that substitutes a receptor phenotype for an unavailable cell type. Contribution also covers the fusion-protein workflow, the modular architecture, documented assay interference, and a compact organoid-chip detection device prototype (sample chamber, constant-temperature heating, illumination, image acquisition, control system) specified as a low-cost alternative to a microplate reader. The business plan covers staged financing and technology licensing.

**給 GEMS：** SEHS is a wet-lab-first project whose dry lab is thin but not decorative: EC50 curve fitting and subpopulation-resolved flow-cytometry analysis are real quantitative work and well within high-school reach, yet an antibody-cytokine fusion project with no structure prediction, no linker modelling and no docking is leaving free analysis on the table. The limiting factor is clearly mentorship rather than tooling or compute - the team had access to CHO culture and a flow cytometer, which is far rarer than a free AlphaFold or HDOCK run, so someone simply never pointed them at the computational side.

### SJTU-BioX-Shanghai — Dual-Armor（雙重護甲）
Undergrad · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/sjtu-biox-shanghai/
SJTU-BioX-Shanghai 做出 Dual-Armor，一款用於慢性傷口的工程菌敷料，針對的是生物膜——一項涵蓋 2,666 例慢性傷口的統合分析發現其中 68% 有生物膜；每年約有 1,860 萬人罹患糖尿病足潰瘍，約 65% 在五年內復發。該隊的包容性工作是 2026 年各隊中理論化最系統的：他們建立了一個雙層架構，以四個面向（VOICE、OPPORTUNITY、ACCESSIBILITY、PARTICIPATION）定位參與在哪裡受阻，並以五步路徑 HEALS（Hear、Examine、Act、Learn、Share）規範每一道障礙如何被回應。十二項活動都分別對照兩個層次寫成紀錄，病人的意見也明顯改變了產品：Dual-Armor 從獨立療法重新定位為清創後的輔助敷料，而病人對活菌接觸傷口的恐懼促成了實體圍阻硬體的設計。

**frameworks.** 自建的雙層包容性架構：四個面向各以它所提出的問題命名——VOICE（我能被聽見嗎？）、OPPORTUNITY（我能進得來嗎？）、ACCESSIBILITY（我能以適合自己的方式參與嗎？）、PARTICIPATION（我能留下來並有所貢獻嗎？）——再加上 HEALS（Hear、Examine、Act、Learn、Share），作為每一項活動共同遵循的行動路徑。教育工作對應到三條學習者路徑（學生：理解—學習—創造；大眾：接觸—理解；同儕教育者：分享—調整—延續），並以建構論與 UDL 3.0 為基礎，但是回溯性地當成一面檢視的鏡子，而非事前強加的框架。Photovoice 的使用也正確引用了 Wang 與 Burris（1997）。

**datascience.** 各項活動都採配對的前後測問卷：六份病人問卷與六場住院病人深度訪談，並公開去識別化結果（66.7% 在過去一年內有三次以上的感染、惡化或復發；83.3% 形容傷口對日常生活的影響為大或非常大）；「Beneath the Wound」角色扮演試玩收回五份匿名問卷，回收率 100%，五項核心概念的自評理解度平均從 1.8 升到 3.52/5，對 MRSA 的理解從 1.2 升到 3.4/5（增幅最大），包容性體驗平均 4.03/5，「每個角色都有實際份量」與「主持人不偏袒任何立場」都是 4.4/5；Life Science x AI 夏令營也做了前後測。該隊一再說明樣本的限制，而不是過度宣稱。

**dataviz.** 共同設計的照護歷程圖，以顏色標示的負擔貼紙標記疼痛、不便、費用與心理壓力；手冊開發流程圖；四面向與 HEALS 架構圖；納入族群的利害關係人總覽。

**software.** 兩項開源工具，都是從一項被指名的障礙出發做出來的。LabSafeMom 為懷孕、準備懷孕或哺乳中的研究人員提供逐一實驗流程的風險指引：送入一份流程，就得到結構化的風險總覽、安全管制措施與個人防護裝備檢核表，依據的是一個含 119 筆危害條目的知識庫，由 NIOSH 等公開職業衛生資料建立。關鍵在於它有兩個彼此分離的模式——Basic 完全在瀏覽器中依本地的確定性規則集運作，不用生成式模型，因此同樣的輸入永遠得到同樣的推論，每個分數都可追溯到明確的規則與出處；Enhanced 只在使用者自行提供 API key 時才加入自然語言的流程分析，而風險分數仍然來自可稽核的規則。每份報告都註明它是與校內 EHS 單位及合格臨床醫師討論時的輔助，絕不是替代。LabMate 則降低新進研究人員在實驗台上的摩擦：可讀入 PDF、TXT、Markdown、CSV 或直接貼上的中英文流程文字，生成準備檢核表，以智慧計時器引導步驟，保留可匯出的實驗紀錄（Markdown、純文字或列印），提供中英文切換、四種主題（Light、Lab、Dark、Sunset）與大字型選項，並以隱私優先的方式在本地離線運作。

**ihp.** 專案的起點是一位隊員自己跌倒受傷、並照護那處傷口的經驗。病人與照顧者的證據被當成設計輸入，而不是事後驗證：病房訪查的發現記錄在 Integrated Human Practices 頁面，並一路追溯到三項具體改變（產品重新定位為清創後輔助敷料、活菌的實體圍阻，以及決定與臨床人員共同撰寫照護手冊）。該隊明確提出一項原則：病人也許不決定基因迴路或材料參數，但他們決定這項技術必須回應什麼，而缺乏專業知識永遠不能成為把他們排除在設計之外的理由。限制是寫明的而非藏起來的——六位病人無法代表所有人，在假設性訪談中表達的接受度，仍然必須在真實使用中驗證。

**publicEngagement.** 值得借用的是那句定調的話：「開放還不夠。門可以一直開著，但有些人始終沒有機會走到門前。」在 VOICE 面向，該隊走訪上海市中西醫結合醫院的周圍血管科，收集六份病人問卷與六場住院病人深度訪談，並與主治醫師及病房照護員對談，再把雙語問卷工具與去識別化結果以 PDF 公開。病人最害怕的是感染復發、癒合時間、疼痛與截肢風險；臨床醫師關注清創、滲液管理與敷料貼合度；照護員指出出院後的換藥與消毒是整條照護鏈最弱的一環。這直接把 Dual-Armor 重新定位為清創後持續照護用的輔助敷料，也推動了實體圍阻硬體。接著的 Photovoice 研究把相機交給病人，由他們自己選擇哪些物件與場景代表自己的治療——輪椅、床邊設備、護理用品——並說明原因；對無法自己拍攝的住院病人，由團隊代為操作相機，但拍攝對象、說明內容與展示的同意權始終屬於參與者。這些經授權、去識別化的照片連同參與者自己的敘述，成為上海交通大學的一場展覽，參觀超過一百人次，並刻意排除臉部、傷口特寫、床號與病歷。該隊的反思格外有原則：「創造一個表達的機會，並不等於研究者取得了影像的所有權」，展覽的品質也絕不能優先於知情同意。共同設計走得更遠：病人、家屬照顧者與照護員一起畫出完整的慢性傷口照護歷程，用不同顏色的貼紙標記疼痛、不便、費用與心理壓力，照顧者還補上了陪同就醫與留意異常這些看不見的勞動。他們反覆提出的問題（「敷料黏在傷口上的時候該怎麼辦？」、「哪一種氣味代表出了問題？」）直接成為一本 23 頁《居家照護手冊》的實際目錄。手冊把專業指引轉譯成紅—黃—綠三級警示訊號、六步換藥法與可手寫填寫的照護紀錄表，刻意在每一句「不要這樣做」之後都給出一個可執行的替代做法，並針對都市與基層醫療場域分別提供換藥選項。草稿由燒傷整形外科與新陳代謝科的臨床醫師審閱，他們修正了碘與過氧化氫的使用指引、糖尿病足照護的時機，以及基層可用的敷料替代品。手冊以中英文免費公開，並附可列印的附錄表格，讓沒有數位裝置的人也用得上。該隊還寫了《Beneath the Wound》，一份 46 頁、由主持人帶領的倫理角色扮演腳本（另有 10 頁角色卡，分五人與六人兩種配置），玩家分別扮演一位 72 歲的糖尿病足病人、家屬、主治醫師與倫理相關角色，在約兩個半小時內做出一個沒有標準答案的決定；資訊被刻意分散配置——醫師掌握風險數據、倫理成員記得過去的失敗、家屬等待權威表態、病人承受恐懼——因此玩家必須在資訊不完整的情況下彼此說服。完整腳本與角色卡已釋出給其他隊伍。在 OPPORTUNITY 面向，該隊在四川巴中的一所國中與浙江台州后安村的一個小型鄉村班級開設零先修要求的合成生物學課程，選這兩個地點正是因為當地學生少有機會接觸前沿科學；課程用肢體角色扮演演示中心法則，加上一項「打造細胞工廠」的設計任務，完全不需要專門器材，在后安村有一部分以影片授課，並以前後測問卷評估；學生自己做出海報、質體圖譜與模型。之後再安排到上海交大的導覽式濕實驗室參訪，補上學校課程與大學研究之間缺掉的中間一環；另外也長期輔導首次參賽的美國高中隊伍 VGA-Pinion，從電子郵件、線上會議一路到實地到上海參訪實驗室，在專案敘事、模型參數依據與 Human Practices 架構上提供建議，而且一貫定位為提供想法，不是替他們做決定。在 ACCESSIBILITY 面向，「Touch Life, See Hope」是在上海交大舉辦的點字慢性傷口明信片共創活動，來自多個系所的參與者先學點字字母、點字板與點字筆，接著就發現無障礙是重新設計而不是逐字轉譯——觸覺讀者無法快速瀏覽，所以訊息必須縮短、照護建議必須與裝飾性文字分開，卡片版面也要照手指移動的方式重新安排；卡片上放了 Dual-Armor 的角色，讓視覺與非視覺讀者都認得出來，並釋出一份 11 頁的英文點字明信片共創工具包，讓別人也能照著辦。「Light Deep in the Lilong」是一則 16 頁的雙語繪本故事，主角是李奶奶，一位 76 歲、退休的國文老師，有一處遲遲未癒的糖尿病足傷口；故事寫給傳統素材忽略的讀者，尤其是病人家裡的孩子，傷口微生物被寫成角色，並與 Dual-Armor 的功能模組一一對應；雙語有聲版正在製作，讓閱讀不必依賴視覺，故事也在巴中現場朗讀給學生聽。wiki 本身就是一件無障礙產出，起因是一位患有 ADHD 的高年級學生反映許多網站讀起來很吃力：網站採用 Okabe-Ito 色盲友善配色（#E69F00、#56B4E9、#F0E442、#D55E00、#0072B2）、一鍵切換的讀寫障礙友善字型、一鍵關閉動畫，以及閱讀進度條。在 PARTICIPATION 面向，該隊轉向已經身在科學領域裡的人，為懷孕的研究人員做 LabSafeMom，為新進實驗室成員做 LabMate。教育方面也產出了鹼基配對挑戰卡牌遊戲、糖尿病劇本遊戲、「Dual-Armor 狼人殺」（一款社交推理遊戲，角色就是 E. coli、S. epidermidis、免疫細胞與 S. aureus，柚皮素的作用機制則寫進了角色關係裡）、一本繪本與有聲書、黏土細胞模型製作、一場沒有預設答案的生物倫理辯論，以及一項六步驟的學生設計任務（問題、載體、功能、安全、團隊合作、簡報）。最後，該隊與其他大學 iGEM 隊伍合著了一本跨隊《教育活動手冊》，負責第 7 章空間化教育與展覽的部分，貢獻「城市定向」一章，明確就是為了讓未來的 iGEMer 不必從零開始。

**realWorld.** 開放、可重複使用的產出：23 頁中英文《居家照護手冊》，附可列印的紀錄表；《Beneath the Wound》的完整腳本、主持人指南與角色卡；點字明信片共創工具包；雙語繪本故事與即將推出的有聲版；LabSafeMom 與 LabMate 都是可直接使用的應用程式並且開源；中心法則、細胞工廠、生物倫理辯論與工程微生物設計的教學簡報；遊戲卡牌；以及合著的跨隊《教育活動手冊》。另有一份給 iGEM 新隊伍的入門指南，涵蓋時程規劃、各階段任務與常見問題，計畫在 wiki 上公開釋出。

**給 GEMS：** 值得借用 SJTU 的雙層紀律：把每一項參與活動依它所排除的障礙分類（我能被聽見嗎、我能進得來嗎、我能用適合自己的形式參與嗎、我能留下來並有所貢獻嗎），並讓每一項都走完 Hear-Examine-Act-Learn-Share，每項活動都以一份別人可以直接拿去執行的可下載產出作結——工具包、腳本、手冊——再加上一段明白寫出證據尚未能證明什麼的說明。

### SMS-Shenzhen — kisMET - selective biosorption of residual metals from battery-recycling wastewater
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/sms-shenzhen/
kisMET targets the tail-end wastewater of spent lithium-ion battery recycling, where metal concentrations fall to parts-per-million and solvent extraction stops being economic. The team engineered Komagataeibacter rhaeticus to decorate its own bacterial cellulose with a secreted fusion protein built from a signal peptide, a carbohydrate-binding module, a HiBiT reporter tag and a swappable ion-binding peptide, assembled by Golden Gate on a pSEVA331 backbone under a rhamnose-inducible promoter. Four SP/CBM scaffolds and an eight-member ion-binding-peptide panel were designed so the binding specificity can be changed without redesigning the platform. Evidence so far covers cultivation, construct and reporter comparisons, single-metal binding experiments and cellulose-degradation assays; the team states clearly that selectivity in mixed wastewater, closed-loop cellulose reuse and complete metal recovery are design objectives, not results.

**frameworks.** A prospective carbon-footprint and techno-economic model, built in two levels: Level A is a preliminary estimate of the material-production module using the team's own measured fermentation parameters, and Level B is the full wastewater-treatment system, deferred until adsorption and recycling performance exist. The functional unit is treatment of one tonne of end-of-pipe battery-recycling wastewater, with the system boundary held identical for the kisMET route and the chemical-precipitation baseline (reagent manufacturing and sludge disposal only; pump and agitation energy excluded). Emission factors are taken from peer-reviewed literature using ecoinvent v3.9.1 global-average datasets, cradle-to-gate. There is no mechanistic or kinetic model - no Langmuir or Freundlich isotherm fitting, no adsorption kinetics, no structural modelling of the ion-binding peptides - which is the clearest gap in an adsorption project.

**datascience.** Scenario and sensitivity reasoning rather than inferential statistics: medium raw-material emissions computed for a 40 mL YPD batch, then scaled under three dry bacterial-cellulose yield scenarios because the team's own dry-weight yield was never measured, then expressed per tonne of wastewater; emission offsets calculated per metal for substitution of virgin salts and separately for cellulose recycling substituting only the glucose carbon source. The honesty is the notable part: outputs are labelled as trend analysis only, bead productivity is taken from published shake-flask ranges for the same strain, local Chinese grid factors are excluded, and the whole thing is described as a qualitative trend comparison and not an ISO-compliant LCA. The team also states which named parameters are the priority model inputs (fermentation yield, adsorption performance, cycle number) following expert advice.

**dataviz.** Engineering and Results figures for HiBiT reporter signals, construct and scaffold comparisons, single-metal (Li/Co/Ni/Mn) experiments and cellulose degradation; a plasmid design schematic showing interchangeable IBP modules alongside the circular map of the optimised pSEVA331 construct; an LCA system-boundary diagram separating the Level A and Level B modules; an SDG interaction map. Education reports platform analytics as a table with the caveat that reach is not a measure of learning.

**software.** No software deliverable beyond the wiki itself. There is an explicit generative-AI disclosure stating that AI was used only for readability editing and website implementation, and that no scientific claim, data figure, gel image, microscopy image, measurement plot or reference was model-generated.

**ihp.** A five-stage programme on a Motivation -> Message -> Move reflection loop, built almost entirely from industry interviews, and it genuinely relocated the project's target user. Lu Binda (SUSTech doctoral student working on Juhefeng's battery-recycling R&D) mapped the value chain and established that front-end and back-end companies have entirely different wastewater. The team then visited Meizhou Zhongrun, a front-end physical recycler, and learned it sells electrode powder downstream and generates little wastewater - so it is not a customer. That finding redirected them to GEM, a downstream hydrometallurgical company, which confirmed that lithium, nickel, cobalt and manganese do remain in the tail stream after solvent extraction and require precipitation or adsorption. Further interviews covered Dynanonic, professional wastewater treatment firms, officials from the Ministry of Ecology and Environment on biosafety and compliance, and Li Zongjin of Lingzhu Tech twice - the second time producing industrial cost ranges for every process step and the modelling rule that cost per use, not cost per batch, decides whether a reusable bead can compete.

**publicEngagement.** The most intellectually honest education page in this cohort, and worth reading as a model regardless of its scale. Four channels, chosen because the audience already uses them rather than building a team website: a WeChat official account, a Xiaohongshu account, a printed two-page bilingual handbook, and two offline events (a school-wide iGEM club class for 59 students on 14 September 2026, and a community booth at Xiangmi Park on 2 October 2026 reaching over 70 visitors, run jointly with iGEM team Yucai-SZ). Three stated principles, each derived from something that failed: teach the phenomenon before the technology (their third and best post never mentions kisMET at all, only where the metal in water comes from); keep the channel open in both directions; and republish the same material in two formats. The analytics are reported against the team's own interest: the team introduction outperformed the project introduction roughly two to one, the purely scientific piece reached the fewest readers, and across three posts and 1,206 reads they received zero comments - from which they conclude that an open door is not an invitation, and propose polls and photo requests instead. The handbook uses one visual language and three analogies (a sponge for the cellulose bead, a magnet for the ion-binding peptide, one grain of rice in a swimming pool for ppm) and is released under CC BY 4.0 for other teams to print, translate or re-analogise.

**realWorld.** The platform is deliberately modular: swapping the ion-binding peptide retargets it at rare earths from e-waste or other heavy metals without touching the core system. Acting on advice from BIT-China and their industry interviews, the team chose to pursue technology licensing with established battery companies rather than founding a company - a realistic read of their own position. Named limitations are published rather than buried: Komagataeibacter fermentation is oxygen-transfer and shear-sensitive in stirred bioreactors, candidate peptides have only been tested in single-metal solutions, and cellulose breakdown does not by itself demonstrate that engineered cells have been inactivated, so a validated containment and disposal procedure is still required. Their closing self-assessment - that as a high-school team they offer not scale but time, willingness to re-explain, and the honesty to say when an explanation failed - is the right framing.

**給 GEMS：** The dry lab is real but narrow: a spreadsheet-level carbon-footprint and techno-economic model with a defined functional unit, literature emission factors and a three-scenario sensitivity sweep is squarely within one high-school season and is exactly the kind of modelling most teams skip, yet for an adsorption project the absence of any isotherm or kinetics fitting is a conspicuous hole that a single afternoon with their own single-metal data would have filled. The limiting factor is mentorship rather than tooling, compute or time - nobody told them that Langmuir and Freundlich fits are a spreadsheet exercise, while someone clearly did teach them how to scope an LCA.

### SUIS-SFLS — TyroFix
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/suis-sfls/
SUIS-SFLS expressed three microbial tyrosinases, immobilised them on magnetic beads so the enzyme can be magnetically recovered and reused, and used the recycled catalyst to hydroxylate Mfp3-linker-Mfp6 fusion mussel foot proteins into DOPA-bearing wet adhesives for skin and wound repair. The commercial thesis is unusually self-aware: after expert interviews they abandoned the idea of selling a finished dressing and repositioned as an upstream B2B raw-material supplier, splitting the same protein stock into TyroFix Mini (cosmetic grade) and TyroFix ProMax (Class II medical grade) and running both regulatory tracks in parallel from day one so that test data never has to be repeated. They are the only high-school team here with a genuine financial model, including capex, cost per litre, pricing, gross margin and breakeven year for each line, published as downloadable PDFs. They were nominated for Best Entrepreneurship in the High School section.

**frameworks.** Golden-circle style Why/How/What mission, PESTLE run separately for each product line, SWOT per line, 4P marketing model, Business Model Canvas, a stakeholder power-interest map, TAM-SAM-SOM per line with stated assumptions, a five-phase 36-month milestone plan, and a two-line financial model with breakeven analysis.

**datascience.** A 290-response consumer survey quantified to a usable level: over 90 percent reporting skin issues, acne and marks at 62.76 percent, dryness at 48.62 percent, sensitivity at 45.17 percent, satisfaction with existing repair products at 3.34 out of 5, weak efficacy as the main complaint at 72.61 percent, safety at 82.07 percent and repair efficacy at 75.86 percent as the top purchase factors, willingness to try at 3.57 out of 5, and over 60 percent accepting CNY 100-150 with CNY 110-120 as the sweet spot. Cost modelling is benchmarked against recombinant human insulin industrial fermentation.

**dataviz.** Thirteen entrepreneurship figures including two separate PESTLE diagrams, competitive positioning, purity and performance indicator panels, a technology roadmap, a business model canvas, a milestone chart and two financial-planning charts. Two downloadable PDFs (financial-planning-mini.pdf, financial-planning-promax.pdf) carry the underlying budgets. Survey results are reported with response percentages and mean Likert scores.

**ihp.** Five named expert interviews, each with the background stated, the question asked, the feedback, the team's reflection and the concrete project adjustment. Dr. Dongfeng Wang (Deputy Chief Physician, Wuhan Petrochemical Hospital) converted vague 'good adhesion' into care-process requirements and gave quantitative design targets: film formation in about 5 seconds, breathability with water resistance, partial degradation in 3-5 days, and validation moving from superficial to deeper wounds. Mr. Yanxuan Song (medical device engineer and founder of a Guangzhou tech-beauty chain) widened their notion of cost to include purification, storage, transport and handling losses, and suggested lyophilised powder with a reconstitution solution to cut cold-chain burden. Mr. Jiujiang Zhang of CIRS Group, a Class II and III device regulatory specialist, established the rule that shared raw-material origin does not permit shared submission pathways. Mr. Xiaofei Ji, an ISO 13485 internal auditor and NPDP holder who has taken more than ten Class III products to approval, delivered the decisive advice: a student team should start at raw-material supply, treat reproducibility and batch records as early concerns, and settle IP before approaching any manufacturer. That advice visibly rewrote the deliverable, from a finished dressing to a characterised protein plus quality documentation.

**publicEngagement.** A 290-response online questionnaire that went beyond sentiment into purchase behaviour, capturing preferred formats, trusted information sources (dermatologists, real user reviews, official brand channels), trial triggers (free samples at 30.69 percent, professional recommendation at 30 percent) and an explicit price band. They also read the result honestly, noting that trust comes from experimental and clinical data (76.21 percent) and transparent mechanism (63.79 percent), and then used those channels to plan promotion rather than inventing a campaign.

**realWorld.** The most financially literate high-school entrepreneurship case in this set, and the honesty is what makes it credible. Each line has a built-up cost model rather than a percentage: Mini needs about CNY 6.8 million of equipment (seed shakers, a 200 L fermenter, high-pressure homogeniser, chromatography system, industrial centrifuge, TFF ultrafiltration) depreciated straight-line over six years, about CNY 2.3 million of R&D, and about CNY 71 per litre to produce against a $12-18 per litre price, giving roughly 34 percent gross margin and cumulative profitability in year 3 to 4. ProMax adds an aseptic filling line, sterile filtration and a lyophiliser for about CNY 11.65 million, carries about CNY 8.15 million of R&D split CNY 5.1 million expensed and CNY 3.05 million capitalised, costs about CNY 163.5 per litre against a $22-32 price, and yields only about 15.9 percent gross margin with breakeven in year 5 to 6. Volume ramps are stated (Mini 1,000 then 5,000 then 15,000 then 30,000 litres; ProMax 200 then 1,000 then 3,000 then 8,000), and the whole budget is downloadable as two PDFs. The regulatory path is the most detailed of any team in this group and is clearly researched rather than guessed: ordinary non-special-use cosmetic filing with NMPA plus a CMA-certified safety assessment for a new cosmetic ingredient and a three-year post-market monitoring period, versus provincial Class II contact-wound-dressing registration requiring ISO 13485, 100,000-class cleanrooms, GB/T 16886 biocompatibility and a clinical evaluation route, with the deliberate choice of the equivalent-product comparison pathway to avoid human trials. They identify the specific trap that cosmetic test reports cannot be reused for device registration and design around it by running both safety programmes in parallel, and cite Giant Biogene and Fu Erjia as real companies that use the shared-campus, separated-workshop model they intend to copy. Market sizing is more careful than usual, with Frost and Sullivan figures for both markets, stated percentage assumptions for SAM, and a SOM expressed as a penetration range tied to winning 10-15 recurring B2B accounts or 2-3 licensed device partners. Now the blunt part. There is no registered entity, no funding, no incubator place, no signed letter of intent and no patent filed, only a stated plan to file three categories of patents before any external collaboration. More seriously, the competitive-efficacy section blurs sources: head-to-head performance claims against Komfymed's recombinant collagen dressing, and a 65-patient trial where MAP hydrogel healed wounds in 5.7 days versus 7.3 for rhEGF, read as literature values for mussel adhesive protein generally rather than data the team generated, yet are written as 'our advantage'. A reader should treat those numbers as borrowed benchmarks. Their own SWOT is candid about this, listing an absent intended use, no confirmed device classification, no design controls, no risk-management file, no biocompatibility package and no clinical evidence strategy. Continuation is a licensing-and-supply intent built on a correct strategic insight (cash from the fast cosmetic line funds the slow medical line), but the entity that would execute it does not yet exist.

**給 GEMS：** Adopt their repositioning discipline: ask industry experts where a student-scale team actually belongs in the value chain, and be willing to drop the finished product for an upstream raw material plus characterisation and quality documentation, which is a deliverable a small lab can genuinely own. Then publish the budget as a downloadable model with capex, cost per unit, price, gross margin and breakeven year, so the plan can be criticised on its arithmetic rather than its adjectives.

### TAU-Israel — CERNAL
Overgrad · Israel · https://2026.igem.wiki/tau-israel/
CERNAL treats the transcriptome as a fingerprint of cellular state and compiles that fingerprint into an RNA logic circuit: it picks the transcripts that distinguish a target cell from its neighbour, scans each transcript for an accessible, unique, constructible trigger window, designs a toehold-style switch whose hairpin hides the ribosome binding site until that trigger unzips it, combines switches into AND and NOT gates, ranks every candidate on shared thermodynamic metrics, and assembles the winner into an annotated plasmid. Because the sensing element is the cell's own RNA rather than a characterised transcription factor, the approach is intended to be host-agnostic, and the team demonstrated it in three proofs of concept: endometriosis logic in HEK293T, a PFOA/PFAS biosensor in E. coli, and CRISPRa gates in yeast. The software is a Django Ninja + React 19 application with a strictly isolated scientific engine, a versioned HTTP API with Python, R and MATLAB clients, SBOL 3 export, and an IBBIS Common Mechanism biosecurity gate that withholds sequence files when screening cannot be completed. The team filed a provisional patent through Tel Aviv University's TTO and built a full market case around cell and gene therapy developers.

**frameworks.** A React 19 static single-page application (TanStack Router, React Query for server state, polling and mutations) built into Django's static assets, over Django Ninja typed HTTP routes with a shared error envelope, Django ORM models for persistent state, and a thin django-q2 task that dispatches work through the engine interface. The v1 runtime deliberately uses SQLite with write-ahead logging, foreign keys and a busy timeout, plus a single ORM-backed queue worker, so the queue is a database table and no separate broker (Redis, RabbitMQ) is needed; rate-limit state also lives in a database cache rather than per-process counters. Worker timeout is one hour with max attempts set to one, explicitly to avoid silently repeating an expensive calculation. The scientific engine is a separate package: it does not import Django, routers, application modules, the database or Django settings, configuration arrives as frozen request records, and an abstract-syntax-tree test catches ordinary, conditional and function-local imports that would break that boundary. Platform code may import only engine.contract and engine.client, never the scientific internals, which means the engine runs and is tested with no web server, database or network, and could be moved to a remote process behind the same request/result interface. Requirements: Python 3.13, uv, Node 22+ for the frontend build, ViennaRNA and Biopython; run './do install && ./do migrate && ./do superuser && ./do build-frontend' then the dev server and a worker in a second terminal, because without the worker submissions just sit queued.

**datascience.** Validation is answered against the Best Software ballot questions one by one, each linked to an implementation or measurement record, and separated into four kinds of evidence that the wiki says do not substitute for one another: software checks, recorded execution, structure comparisons and host experiments. Two external comparisons anchor the predictions: the RNA-accessibility score was compared against published in-cell SHAPE measurements across 450 E. coli RNA records, and the switch-ranking metrics were tested against Green et al.'s measured toehold ON/OFF ratios. Gene selection used published expression data for the PFOA analysis and, separately, an endometriosis analysis with healthy-tissue context, stratifying AREG and SELE across superficial peritoneal and deep ovarian lesions. The AND-gate study enumerated hundreds of thousands of candidate designs, and examining the best and worst of each architecture surfaced failure modes before anything was built, notably switches that score well only because they stay closed and targets that look good only on paper. At the bench, dozens of toehold candidates were designed and a subset tested in bacteria, with bacterial NOT-gate results, yeast guide-RNA experiments and human-cell input-expression studies providing different pieces of evidence; the wiki says testing is ongoing and names the remaining gate-validation work. Capabilities are labelled Implemented, Conditional (execution or release depends on infrastructure, data or screening) or Incomplete, with the stated rule that missing evidence is never scored as a numerical zero and a high score cannot fill it. The removed off-target scanner is explicitly not replaced by a zero-valued measurement. The recorded demonstration run is reported with its failure included: a 711-nt mCherry input produced 21 ranked designs, but FASTA, GenBank and SBOL release was held because the screening service was unavailable.

**dataviz.** The project landing page is an extended scroll-driven explainer that animates the actual mechanism: zooming into a cytoplasm of coloured transcripts, lining them up by abundance to show the state fingerprint, highlighting the transcripts strong in cell A only versus cell B only, picking one, finding the trigger window, then showing the hairpin lock with its buried RBS being unzipped by the key, and finally the same locks becoming AND and NOT gates. The software page is organised as a 'field guide' with chapters, every claim linked to its implementation record, and a five-step auto-playing screen recording of a real run (recorded from the local app on 11 October 2026) with per-step 'you should see' statements and a static-image fallback for users without JavaScript. The results explorer shows ranked candidates with full metric decomposition, construct views, warnings, and the rejected candidates kept visible; user decision tags (none, pinned, shortlisted, rejected, synthesize) are annotations that explicitly do not change any computational or release result. Run states are drawn as a six-state machine with eight permitted transitions.

**software.** CERNAL is the most engineering-mature iGEM software this year, and its distinguishing feature is that almost every claim is qualified by what it does not establish. The pipeline runs: differential-expression table or direct transcript in; gene ranking; sliding-window trigger enumeration scored by ViennaRNA-predicted accessibility (RNAplfold partition functions, base-pair probabilities, minimum free energy) with positions and sequence context retained; gate design across six families (single-input toehold, prokaryotic and eukaryotic AND, prokaryotic and eukaryotic NOT, CRISPR-based); cross-family ranking on shared metric definitions with normalisation and weights so candidates from compatible gate families sit in one list; circuit composition from a Boolean expression; and annotated plasmid assembly with RFC10 and RFC1000 restriction-site checks against the selected assembly standard. Three interfaces sit over one engine: a guided four-step web wizard (inputs, logic, payload, vector), a versioned HTTP API with OpenAPI docs at /api/docs and five core endpoints (GET /api/version for capabilities, POST /api/design returning a job handle, GET /api/design/{id} for cheap polling, GET /api/design/{id}/results with ?format=csv, GET /api/artifacts/{id}/download with ownership checks), and an optional LLM chatbot for picking a reference gene. Client packages ship for Python, R and MATLAB plus curl examples, and the team publishes which clients are actually verified: Python has recorded live-server CI conformance, R has later checks, MATLAB has archived wrapper defects and no fresh conformance claimed. API keys carry a cern_live_ prefix with only a SHA-256 digest stored, two scopes (read, design), expiry, revocation, 60 requests per minute and two concurrent runs by default, and an object owned by another account returns 404 rather than confirming its existence. Strict submission rejects misspelled constraint keys with a structured 422 and suggestions rather than silently applying a default, and the stated compatibility promise within an API schema version is additive-only. Formats: RNA sequences and differential-expression tables in, custom GenBank backbones in, FASTA, annotated GenBank, SBOL 3 (preserving sequence features, part roles and provenance) and CSV out, with Biopython handling GenBank and ViennaRNA the thermodynamics. Two things are unusual. First, biosecurity is wired into the pipeline, not bolted on: an IBBIS Common Mechanism integration (HMM sequence-profile models plus similarity search) screens the final switch and the assembled construct and holds sequence export when screening evidence is unavailable or unresolved, and the wiki states that a hold is not a completed screen. Second, the team separates scientific computation from AI-assisted development and says so in a dedicated section: the reviewed runtime contains no generative AI, LLM, neural network, trained classifier or remote inference service, the Python and JavaScript manifests include no AI inference SDK, and design runs send no biological data to an AI provider, while AI assistance used in interface design, coding and documentation is recorded in attribution. Reproducibility is handled by publishing a fixed 7.1 MiB source snapshot (revision 9a5ca657) with a checksum manifest, noting candidly that this revision was not on the public repository when checked and that the public repo may contain a different revision, so the snapshot is not substituted for it. Documentation is layered: a public documentation index, architecture diagrams, a scientific-engine module map, an API reference generated into a committed file with a freshness test that detects drift, decision records (including one on choosing SBOL 3), typed contracts and docstrings on cross-component data, and a repository map for new contributors. Four named reuse points are offered for teams who want only a piece: the engine contract, gate-family hooks, the scoring layer and the window utility. Repo: https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/tau-israel/cernal. A hosted deployment exists at https://cernal.app (also cernal.duckdns.org, same host) but it is gated, the wiki says to sign in with a lab account or request access, and the host did not respond when checked, so the dependable route is the published source snapshot and a local install. Upstream credit is kept explicit: a separate eukaryotic AND research notebook reads ranked CSVs exported from the third-party NucSyn Platform, and the wiki states that NucSyn is neither invoked nor bundled by the production engine and that the two sets of scores remain distinct.

**ihp.** Human practices operated under a stated 'Responsibility-by-Design' philosophy whose point was to turn the phrase into constraints. Patient accounts set the design goal: Shir Parchef waited 18 years for an endometriosis diagnosis and underwent an 11-hour procedure with six surgeons; Netta Ben Moshe was told incapacitating pain was ordinary cramps; Helen Altschuler described patients' willingness to support research because so little else exists. From these the team set the target as eliminating pathology rather than masking symptoms, and without systemic hormonal ablation. Dr. Berkowitz told them a therapy that shrinks lesions without relieving pain or preserving fertility has no clinical utility, which made them stratify AREG and SELE across both superficial peritoneal and deep ovarian lesions so the logic covers the 'invisible' lesions driving the worst pain rather than only what imaging shows. Several loops closed by narrowing the claim rather than widening it: after input from Dr. Berman the PFAS biosensor is positioned as a low-cost triage tool that prioritises which of Israel's hundreds of wells need urgent lab testing, explicitly not a replacement for LC-MS, and the team states it has not solved RNA delivery. Conversations with Neta Agmon about practical inputs and outputs and with AIS-China about user workflow shaped which interfaces were documented for reuse.

**publicEngagement.** The team ran a Mini-Jamboree where CERNAL was demonstrated live to other iGEM teams and then surveyed the participants (7 responses): all agreed synthetic biology lacks a generalizable approach for designing intracellular circuits responding to user-defined stimuli, 71.4% said they would use such a tool during iGEM and 85.7% afterwards, with interest spread across biosensing (57.1%), cell engineering (57.1%), and diagnostics, therapeutics and environmental sensing (28.6% each). The team states plainly that this is a directional signal from a small, self-selected group of peers and not market evidence, and that its value is that the demand they claim was checked with outside users rather than asserted. AIS-China was given the interface to use and returned three concrete usability fixes that the team adopted: clearer placement of downloads, a more prominent New Circuit entry point, and meaningful run names. A video walkthrough, in-app FAQ and public FAQ source support new users.

**realWorld.** A provisional patent application was filed through Tel Aviv University's technology transfer office. The market case is built from Alliance for Regenerative Medicine sector data: 1,089 commercial cell and gene therapy developers in a US$1.7B total addressable market, of which 553-731 use genetic modification, and applying a stated 30% in-house design assumption gives a beachhead of 166-219 accounts worth US$0.25-0.33B, with four organisations shortlisted for first contact and HEK293/HEK293T chosen as the entry cell line because it is widely used in industry. The competitive positioning is specific rather than dismissive: Cello 2.0 maps circuit specifications to characterised parts and Asimov Kernel provides construct design, simulation and workflow tools, but both depend on predefined specifications, characterised parts or host-specific workflows, whereas CERNAL starts from transcriptomic state; the wiki notes these citations support design context and are not an absolute claim that no competing route exists. The MVP is a 5-10 week design-partner cycle from discovery to structured feedback, and the team reports CERNAL has already produced 730 E. coli and 110 yeast circuit candidates as a routine pipeline rather than a demo.

**給 GEMS：** Build the scientific engine as a package that cannot import the web framework, the database or the settings, and enforce it with an automated import test, so the science can be run, tested and reused headlessly and the UI is only one of three front ends. Then adopt their reporting discipline: label every capability Implemented, Conditional or Incomplete, never score a missing measurement as zero, publish a recorded run that includes the step where it failed, and keep AI-assisted development in the attribution record and out of the scientific runtime.

### UNILausanne — ASTACi：偵測、解除、防禦
Overgrad · Switzerland · https://2026.igem.wiki/unilausanne/
UNILausanne 以三項互補策略處理由卵菌 Aphanomyces astaci 引起的螯蝦瘟：以迴圈介導等溫擴增（LAMP）偵測水中的病原、以 RNAi 解除攜帶病原的入侵種訊號螯蝦的威脅，並以具保護作用的蛋白質補充劑防禦原生螯蝦。量測工作所問的問題是：這套 LAMP 檢測是否專一到足以把 A. astaci 與近緣的 A. frigidophilus 區分開來、是否靈敏到足以實用，以及是否穩健到能承受真實的湖水與河水。硬體是 C.L.A.W.，一台手掌大小、以 USB 供電的恆溫加熱裝置，與 MobileLAMP 設計的原作者共同打造，完全開源且單台成本低於 10 CHF。一個隨機性的雙物種族群模型先以一個有文獻紀錄的野外案例驗證，再用來決定該如何在「解除」與「防禦」兩項策略之間分配資源。

**frameworks.** 量測以現地檢測的三項明定需求為架構（把病原與近緣物種區分開來、提供低檢測極限、在不同環境條件下維持可靠），這三項分別對應專一性、靈敏度與穩健性三個章節。模型的編排依序為敏感度分析、對照真實文獻紀錄結果的驗證，最後才是應用；假設與限制以可展開區塊逐條列出，每個參數都標註其定義、所採用的數值以及該數值的依據，在確實查無資料時也明白寫出「文獻中並無此數值」。

**datascience.** 專一性是設計出來的，而不是假定而來：團隊設計並比較了多組 LAMP 引子，表現最佳的一組把 F3 引子設計在 A. frigidophilus 具有的一段 10 bp 缺失上；團隊並發現移除選用性的 loop 引子即可消除假陽性，並把這項結果寫成給其他團隊的建議。靈敏度以序列稀釋建立，每一稀釋度做三個重複，得到初步檢測極限為每次反應 5.5 x 10^-5 ng 模板，約相當於最終反應中的 5 x 10^-6 ng/uL，低於此量時擴增就變得不一致；某一道缺失的條帶被歸因於可能的移液操作失誤，而不是被悄悄剔除。這個數字接著以黃金標準方法對標：團隊為 A. astaci 建立 qPCR 標準曲線，以三重複做 Ct 對 log10 濃度作圖，最低可偵測濃度約為 1 x 10^-7 ng/uL，因此團隊得以說自家檢測與參考方法相差在一個數量級之內，而不是宣稱兩者相當。穩健性測試產生了最有用的負面結果：團隊量測了湖水與河水的 pH（蒸餾水 5.8、日內瓦湖 7.04 至 7.11、河水 7.26 至 8.16），在樣本中加入合成 DNA，凝膠結果顯示擴增在整個範圍內都穩健，但對 pH 敏感的呈色判讀在起始 pH 偏高時無法變色，因此檢測本身穩健，其判讀方式則不然。團隊把這一點轉化為三項明確建議：每組新引子都要跑無模板對照（NTC）、若 NTC 出現假陽性就捨棄 loop 引子，以及在判定樣本乾淨之前先檢查環境 pH，或以凝膠確認呈色法的陰性結果。硬體是經過校正而不是直接信任：直接插入試管孔的溫度計讀值比顯示值高約 10 C，因此恆溫器設定在 52.5 C 才能讓管內達到 62.5 C，這道校正步驟也寫進了公開的操作手冊；由 27 C 升溫至 62.5 C 約需五分鐘，並在第八分鐘超調至約 70 C，原因是感測器位於加熱塊下方，因此流程規定須預熱 10 分鐘，之後在三次獨立運行中，試管孔於 30 分鐘內維持在 62.7 +/- 1.2 C。生態模型為隨機模型，每一條件下執行多次重複，結果以中位數搭配百分位區間呈現；模型先經敏感度分析找出真正重要的參數，再以掃描競爭與傳播參數的方式，對照一起有文獻紀錄的實際取代事件進行驗證（Bubb、Thom 與 Lucas 於 2003 年在一處河段追蹤 15 隻入侵種與 20 隻原生螯蝦，2005 年複查時原生個體數為零）；團隊選了中等競爭、beta = 0.9、吻合度 95% 的組合，而不是吻合度最高的 97%，因為後者會與他們設定的中性棲地基準相矛盾，而他們也說明剩餘的落差是被保留下來，而不是靠調整棲地參數來消除。

**dataviz.** 加註說明的瓊脂糖凝膠電泳圖，與呈色反應管的照片並列；qPCR 標準曲線以 Ct 對 log10 模板濃度作圖，並在檢測的線性範圍內做線性迴歸；溫度穩定性圖以灰線呈現 C.L.A.W. 的三次個別運行、以橙色呈現平均值 +/- SD，並以陰影帶標出 60 至 65 C 的 LAMP 作用區間，全部以 R 4.5.1 搭配 ggplot2 分析與繪製；生態模型的月週期示意圖以動畫呈現；互動式族群軌跡圖附有中位數線、標示可能結果範圍的陰影區、可滑過查看的數值、可切換顯示的資料表與可點選的圖例項目；熱圖網格呈現原生族群衰退百分比隨競爭與傳播參數的變化，並以外框標示所選取的格位。

**software.** C.L.A.W. 完全開源，並公開了組裝手冊，內含標示價格與供應商的零件清單、逐步組裝說明、接線圖，以及設定與校正的指引；底座、外殼、上蓋、試管座與按鈕的 STL 檔案皆有提供，並在 wiki 上搭配互動式 3D 檢視器。這套設計以已發表的 MobileLAMP 裝置為基礎，團隊並與其通訊作者合作，修正了一處缺漏的電路連接。分析與繪圖以 R 4.5.1 搭配 ggplot2 完成。

**ihp.** 與瑞士水域生態系研究暨保育基金會 La Maison de la Riviere 的一場對話，推翻了模型原本已經做出的決定。模擬結果單調地顯示，把資源從蛋白質補充移往 RNAi 永遠對原生族群有利，這意味著應該放棄「防禦」策略。該基金會描述了一個案例：原生螯蝦被重新引入一座並沒有入侵種螯蝦的湖泊，卻仍然死亡，因為 A. astaci 早已存在於水中。模型無法呈現這種情形，因為它只透過入侵種族群追蹤病原。團隊因此為這個使用情境繼續發展「防禦」策略，並明確記錄下來：限制來自模型的適用範圍，而不是這項策略本身。

**publicEngagement.** 專案另設有教育頁面與遊戲區，以及一個包容性頁面；wiki 本身也提供對閱讀障礙者友善的顯示選項。

**realWorld.** 目標使用者被明確指名，設計也由此推導而來：必須在沒有實驗室的水邊執行檢測的漁民與保育工作者，這正是 C.L.A.W. 以標準 USB 行動電源供電、成本低於 10 CHF，並公開了重製所需一切資料的原因。展望一節列出三項具體改良並說明理由（加熱上蓋以避免冷凝水減少反應體積、加大鋁製加熱塊讓對照組能與樣本同時進行、以及凍乾試劑以做成自給自足的現地套組）；檢測本身的下一步則明定為先以分離自病原的 DNA 取代合成 DNA，再進一步改用環境樣本，並可能加入預先富集（pre-enrichment）步驟。

**給 GEMS：** 要在判讀方式真正會遇到的樣本基質中測試它，而不只是測試化學反應：這支團隊的 LAMP 擴增在河水中可行，但以 pH 為基礎的變色判讀卻失效；這種失效在蒸餾水驗證中完全看不出來，而且正是會在現場悄悄產生假陰性的那一類問題。

### UOregon — AquaFlock
Overgrad · United States · https://2026.igem.wiki/uoregon/
UOregon 改造 E. coli，把環境中過量的硝酸鹽轉入氮儲存聚合物 cyanophycin，並在 cyanophycin 累積達到閾值後表現絮凝蛋白，使細胞沉降、可被收取作為肥料替代品，藉此閉合氮循環。目標使用者是奧勒岡州水質少有檢測的鄉村水井持有者與農民。最突出的是教育實踐：針對先備知識遞增的三種受眾，自行開發三套原創課程，以明確的 Design-Build-Test-Learn 迴圈迭代，並以通用學習設計（UDL）與 STEAM 為基礎。團隊另外做了一套離線桌面搜尋引擎，索引 2022-2025 年 1,354 個 iGEM 隊伍 wiki、共 20,761 個頁面的全文。

**frameworks.** 教育本身就以 DBTL 工程迴圈的方式執行，並留下反思式改變理論（Reflective Theory of Change）圖與一套標準化的成效評分量表（參與度、科學理解、創造力），兩者都改編自奧勒岡州立大學 STEM Research Center 在 Polar STEAM Summit 2026 的報告。學習目標則依 Bloom's Taxonomy 的可測量動詞撰寫（記憶、理解、應用、分析、評鑑、創造）。

**datascience.** 工作坊後的回饋問卷採分段排序設計；第三場工作坊中，15 位回覆者有 8 人在參加前就聽過合成生物學，生物倫理與科學傳播被評為最喜歡的段落，插畫手冊、真實世界案例與小組討論則被指為最有效的學習工具。

**dataviz.** 全程使用手繪科學圖解：所有教材都由團隊成員親手數位繪製，包括一本中心法則漫畫、插畫式學習手冊，以及用於配對活動的插畫版合成生物學工具卡（可動手操作）。

**software.** iGEM Wiki Search：一款桌面應用程式，從單一搜尋框即可檢索 2022-2025 年各屆 1,354 個隊伍 wiki、20,761 個頁面的全文，離線執行、無需伺服器。它自動化了 wiki 的收集與處理、建立全文索引、以整個專案而非單一頁面為排序單位、以負責任的方式爬取、能處理僅靠 JavaScript 渲染的 wiki，並做過跨平台測試。團隊明確地把它與 iGEM 的 Phoenix Project（僅有詮釋資料）以及 iGEM Munich 2024 的 Data Explorer（僅 2019 年 wiki、無原始連結）做比較，並讓每一筆結果都連回原始頁面。

**ihp.** 人類實踐以鄉村公平為框架：住在大城市以外的人得到較少財務支持、水井與水體較少被檢測、也較少獲得主動的醫療照護，因此本專案被設計成一條循環的鏈，為被市政系統邊緣化的社區提供農業、健康與經濟上的支持。團隊繪出四步落地路徑（先在住家、再到農業污染源、接著收取、最後減量／再利用／回收），並提出一個很鮮明的設計目標：「我們的產品被設計成最終會被淘汰」——一旦硝酸鹽濃度降回安全範圍即不再需要。團隊走訪服務 Eugene 與 Springfield 的 Metropolitan Wastewater Management Commission 區域污水處理廠，訪談廠務操作人員，他們確認硝酸鹽控制（與 PFAS、矽並列）仍是未解的難題，印證了這套較小規模系統可以補上的缺口。團隊選定四項聯合國 SDG 作為焦點：3（健康與福祉）、4（優質教育）、6（潔淨水與衛生）與 12（責任消費與生產）。

**publicEngagement.** UOregon 的核心設計原則值得引用也可被其他隊伍沿用：「無障礙應該降低進入複雜科學的門檻，而不是降低科學本身的複雜度。」團隊沒有只做一場通用的外推演講，而是為先備知識遞增的三種受眾撰寫三套原創課程，並在 2026 年 6 月、7 月與 10 月以三次 DBTL 迭代實際執行，把每一次的經驗帶進下一次。第一場工作坊（Intro to Synthetic Biology）是一小時課程加一份插畫回家作業單，對象是奧勒岡人道協會夏令營的 30 位高中生；學生複習中心法則與質體組成，然後自行設計一株工程菌來解決自選的問題。活動後與學生及營隊人員的檢討產出四項具體修正（先建立先備知識、增加真實世界關聯、縮短段落轉換以降低認知負荷、增加同儕互動點），並直接帶入第二場工作坊。第二場工作坊（Engineering SynBio Solutions）是兩小時課程，對象是 SAIL（Student Academy to Inspire Learning，奧勒岡大學既有的 STEM 夏令營，招收來自多元學習背景的學生）的 20 位高中生；教材包含一本全插畫學習手冊、一本把中心法則說成故事的手繪漫畫、投影片與動手活動，五個段落各有自己的引導問題，並刻意從基礎生物學鋪陳到 CRISPR 與質體、再到基因迴路與實驗設計。第三場工作坊（SynBio Solutions to Real-World Problems）是兩小時課程，對象是奧勒岡大學 20 位大一、大二理學院學生，由奧勒岡大學 Knight Campus 研究生協會的外推小額補助支持；由於這群受眾已有基礎生物學，團隊把漫畫換成配對遊戲式複習，在 CRISPR 與質體之外加入定向演化與 de novo 蛋白質設計，再延伸出前兩場無法觸及的兩個段落：針對三個真實合成生物學應用的小組生物倫理分析，以及一個科學傳播活動，讓學生彩繪提袋，向自選的受眾說明自己學到什麼。成效證據扣在標準化量表上，而不只是人數：參與度、理解與創造力透過工作坊後的直接回饋表與間接觀察在各次迭代間追蹤，第二場的學生主動問出超出授課範圍的問題（有人問 CRISPR 與質體能否同時使用），第三場的問卷則把生物倫理與科學傳播排在最前面。工作坊之外，團隊出版了一本描繪 AquaFlock 專案歷程的漫畫，並釋出 iGEM Wiki Search 桌面工具，目的正是讓未來的隊伍更容易找到並接續前人的工作——這是一項針對 iGEM 社群本身的教育貢獻。

**realWorld.** 預期使用者是奧勒岡州的鄉村水井持有者與農民；收取下來的絮凝物成為當地的肥料替代品，使肥料取得在地化，同時從源頭減少硝酸鹽。專案說明頁建立了脈絡：施用的氮肥大約只有一半被植物吸收，其餘淋溶成硝酸鹽，造成優養化、有害藻華與缺氧，也對飲用受污染水源的人體健康構成直接風險。

**給 GEMS：** 把外推當成 DBTL 迴圈來跑，並搭配一套固定的成效量表：為先備知識不同的受眾做出同一套課程的三種差異化版本，每次執行後都與主辦單位人員檢討，並以同樣的三項標準（參與度、理解、創造力）為每次迭代評分，讓進步是可被證明的，而不是自己宣稱的。

### WUXI-DSAS — ReNovo
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/wuxi-dsas/
ReNovo is a whole-cell E. coli biosensor for urinary gentisic acid (2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid), built as a non-invasive early-screening route for renal cell carcinoma (RCC), which is 80-85% of primary kidney malignancies and asymptomatic exactly when it is curable. The team adapted the maleylpyruvate-responsive GtdR/PgtdA system of Cupriavidus necator, deliberately omitting the gtdT transporter from the published circuit to obtain a monotonic, quantifiable dose-response, and used mCherry to dodge urine's green autofluorescence. Because urinary analyte concentration tracks hydration, a parallel colorimetric creatinine assay is run on the same chip and the result is reported as a gentisic acid-to-creatinine ratio in a three-tier risk band. The second-generation sensor PG2 gave a linear response over 0-12 uM (y = 1.094x + 16.8, R2 = 0.9764) with no significant artificial-urine matrix effect and no cross-reactivity to 2-, 3-, 4-HBA or salicyluric acid.

**frameworks.** Business and policy analysis frameworks applied explicitly: PEST analysis of China and global markets, Porter's five forces, SWOT, a marketing-mix positioning exercise, a five-phase evidence-gated development roadmap to 2035 with documented decision gates, and a dated risk register. A concentric three-layer SDG impact model (Inner Core / Proximal Field / Outer Ripple) organises the sustainability analysis by causal distance rather than importance.

**datascience.** Survey instrument run in two waves (n = 131 general awareness; n = 70 product-preference, including a ranked-preference question scored out of 5) with results reported per option and used to justify named design choices. Wet-lab statistics are reported properly: linear regressions with R2 (PG2 0.9764; creatinine Jaffe calibration R2 = 0.98; enzymatic cascade calibration R2 = 0.9614; undiluted induction R2 = 0.9294), two-way ANOVA for matrix effect (concentration p < 0.0001, matrix p = 0.6), one-way ANOVA for reciprocal interference (p = 0.9837), exponential and log-linear fits of positive-cell fraction (R2 = 0.9954 and 0.9723).

**dataviz.** Unusually strong, data-first wiki: an interactive GLOBOCAN 2024 choropleth of age-standardised kidney-cancer incidence across 186 countries and territories with the underlying CSV published for download, keyboard-navigable; per-question survey charts that print exact n, option counts and percentages as accessible text; a concentric SDG framework figure and a cross-goal synergy/trade-off figure; an experiment-report calendar.

**software.** No standalone software deliverable. The /software page states plainly that it covers only wiki tools (interactive kidney-cancer map, scientific illustrations, experiment-report calendar) with the implementation in the wiki repository. The /model page is equally candid: it is marked RECORDS PENDING and states that a team model with documented assumptions, parameters, code and validation has not been published, pointing readers to Results instead. A phone mini-program that computes the gentisic-acid-to-creatinine ratio, asks a pre-test aspirin question and prints a tiered report is described as a proposal, not a built artefact.

**ihp.** Nineteen named stakeholders across clinical medicine, diagnostics, regulation, bioethics and education, each mapped to the specific project section their input changed - and the changes are real, not cosmetic. The single strongest chain is the circuit redesign: the first-generation gtdR-gtdA-gtdT-mCherry sensor gave a non-monotonic response that peaked around 2 uM and then fell, making quantification impossible. Professor Hangxiang Wang suggested testing lower concentration gradients to check for promoter saturation; the team did, and the non-linearity persisted. Dr. Jing Shi then diagnosed the mechanism from the sequence architecture - the large expressed proteins and heavy transporter expression imposed metabolic strain - and Dr. Tengfei Hu proposed replacing active symport with passive diffusion by excising gtdT to stop intracellular 3-maleylpyruvate over-accumulation. Dr. Christina Feng reinforced it from a different angle: heavy metabolic load creates selection pressure for spontaneous loss-of-function mutations and plasmid clearance, which would make a deployed biosensor unreliable. The team deleted gtdT, and the second-generation PG2 construct restored linearity to R2 = 0.9764. Second chain, normalisation: Dr. Zhou (diagnostics researcher) warned that a single urinary metabolite moves with hydration, diet, medication and age so an elevated reading cannot be distinguished from a concentrated sample, and Dr. Gu (urology director) specifically recommended creatinine correction and first-morning-urine collection, while Dr. Xuan supplied the physiology - before a tumour invades the collecting system, biomarker secretion is very low. The team added a parallel creatinine assay as an internal reference and changed its reported output from raw fluorescence to a gentisic acid-to-creatinine ratio; it then changed chemistry between contexts for a stated reason, keeping the Jaffe picric-acid method for 96-well lab characterisation but switching the device to a four-enzyme cascade because Jaffe responds to non-creatinine urinary compounds and needs strongly alkaline conditions unsuited to dried reagents. Third chain, specificity: Dr. Wu (clinical laboratory physician, Wuxi No. 2 People's Hospital) said routine urine tests cannot separate nephritis or UTI from RCC, and Dr. Zhong warned that herbal medicines and diet confound urinary organic acids; the team ran an artificial-urine matrix panel (Na2HPO4, NaCl, KCl, creatinine, albumin, urea) and a look-alike panel (2-, 3-, 4-hydroxybenzoic acid, salicyluric acid, salicylic acid as the main aspirin metabolite), finding no matrix effect and no cross-reactivity, and added a pre-test aspirin question to the proposed app. Fourth chain, hardware and logistics: Dr. Wu demanded elimination of manual pipetting in favour of a single-use enclosed cassette plus automated reader; Dr. Vargas pointed them to Cologuard's non-contact sample handling as a benchmark; Dr. Christina Feng said in Chinese that she would 'recommend that you consider freeze-drying', naming -40 to -60 C cold chain as a commercial killer, and Dr. Zhong noted community clinics lack refrigeration - so lyophilised cells dried into the chip became the design target. Fifth chain, ethics and framing: Mr. Matthew Peatman argued a false positive is ethically acceptable because it only triggers non-invasive imaging whereas a false negative is disastrous, which set sensitivity as the priority over specificity; he also warned of 'psychosomatic health dysmorphia' from unregulated self-testing, and Dr. Martin Goffriller argued results must stay in the user's own hands, which produced local-only processing, opt-in anonymised data sharing and a three-tier Low/Borderline/Elevated report with an explicit disclaimer instead of a raw number. Dr. Wang Keming's insistence that the device be positioned strictly as a preliminary screening aid rather than a diagnosis is carried through the whole wiki. The notable discipline here is how consistently the team labels unvalidated claims: the 80 C / 20-minute thermal inactivation hold, hydrophobic vent containment, post-lyophilisation viability, and the three-tier cutoffs are each written as 'requires validation' or 'has not yet been demonstrated'.

**publicEngagement.** Two public surveys underpin the engagement work rather than decorating it: n = 131 on awareness (71.76% had only heard the name of kidney cancer, 35.11% had never considered that early RCC is asymptomatic, 57.25% each named hospital queues and fear of invasive procedures as screening barriers) and n = 70 on product expectations (safe handling ranked top at 4.39/5; 61.43% wanted digital confirmation of a colour readout rather than reading it themselves; 61.43% felt only 'somewhat reassured' about engineered bacteria and wanted more safety information; 44.29% wanted a built-in inactivation step before disposal; 58.57% would share anonymised data only with identity confidentiality; 68.57% preferred short science videos and 67.14% detailed articles with charts). Outreach was then built to that evidence: dual-track materials (comics, posters, brochures in English and Chinese, videos for younger audiences; rigorous seminars for senior students and faculty), age-tiered workshops from kindergarten to Grade 11 (LEGO cell models for Grades 1-3, strawberry DNA extraction for Grades 6-8, gel electrophoresis loading and interpretation for IB Grade 11), a presentation for parents and faculty, and WeChat / RedNote / Instagram channels. On Ms. Fiona You's challenge to 'go beyond iGEM', the team committed to a permanent campus Synthetic Biology Club and structured knowledge transfer so the next cohort builds on rather than restarts the work.

**realWorld.** The real-world framing is quantified and sourced: 442,570 new kidney-cancer cases and 144,871 deaths worldwide in 2024 (GLOBOCAN), China carrying roughly 18% of cases (80,211) and the highest national mortality (25,029) while sitting below the world age-standardised rate, so the burden is population scale rather than per-capita risk; 93.6% five-year relative survival for localised disease against 20.3% once metastatic; around 60% of cases found incidentally. The SDG case is built on named sub-targets with the team's own evidence rather than a logo wall: SDG 3 (3.4, 3.8, 3.d), 4 (4.4, 4.7, 4.a), 9 (9.1, 9.5, 9.b), 12 (12.4, 12.5, 12.8), 8 (8.2, 8.3, 8.5), 10 (10.2, 10.3, 10.4) and 17 (17.6, 17.16, 17.17), arranged in a concentric model and accompanied by a cross-goal synergy and trade-off analysis. The team also does something most teams skip: it checks its claim against an external commitment, noting that the UICC World Cancer Declaration 2025-2035 target of diagnosing 60% of cancers early is framed around cancers with existing evidence-based screening (breast, cervical, colorectal) and that RCC's absence from that list is precisely the gap. Regulation is specific: the National Medical Products Administration catalogues instruments and in-vitro diagnostic reagents separately and assesses them independently, so the reader and the biologically active chip follow two tracks of different length and the chip governs the launch date; the EU IVDR is cited as a separate conformity regime; China's Cancer Prevention and Control Action Plan 2023-2030 is noted as favouring early detection but not listing kidney cancer. On cost the team refuses a headline number, stating instead that cost per result is dominated by how often the reusable reader is amortised and that it avoids setting a selling price at this stage, while positioning unit cost low enough to be absorbed into a subsidised programme or public insurance, and identifying that payer, decider and beneficiary are three different parties. After the Jamboree: a five-phase evidence-gated roadmap to 2035 with a documented decision gate between phases and a dated risk register (clinical validity 2028, specificity confounded by salicylate or diet 2028, unresolved creatinine-versus-specific-gravity normalisation 2028, production QC variability 2031, regulatory classification or evidence gap 2033), plus the campus Synthetic Biology Club and the Jiangnan University School of Life Sciences link as the institutional carriers.

**給 GEMS：** Copy WUXI-DSAS's stakeholder map that indexes each of nineteen interviewees to the numbered project section their advice changed, so a reader can audit the causal claim; and copy their discipline of writing 'requires validation' next to every unproven design feature (thermal inactivation hold, lyophilisation viability, risk cutoffs) instead of letting a proposal read as a result.

### Worldshaper-Shanghai — SweetCycle
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/worldshaper-shanghai/
Worldshaper-Shanghai engineered the two glycosyltransferases that perform the final steps to Rebaudioside M (SrUGT76G1 and SrUGT91D2), screened eight designed variants in a contained Stevia hairy-root chassis with qPCR and HPLC read-out, and found that T284I raised Reb M to 21.96 micrograms per gram fresh weight against 15.44 for wild type while the SrUGT91D2 variants did nothing. The commercial insight is genuinely original: Reb M is expensive not because the pathway is hard but because it sits at about 2 percent of a pool of near-identical glycosides, so the only lever that matters is raising that fraction (eta), and the party who benefits is whoever owns the separation column. They therefore sell a licensed process asset to Reb A refiners rather than a product, backed by a published, recomputable techno-economic model that ranks three production routes and finds their own current enzyme performance gives a negative NPV in every scenario. They were nominated for Best Entrepreneurship in the High School section.

**frameworks.** A purpose-built Reb M Commercialisation Decision Model (25-year NPV at a 12 percent discount rate across mild, neutral and fast price-convergence scenarios) plus PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces scored force by force, SWOT with deliberately unbalanced counts because the null results are listed as weaknesses, 4P, Business Model Canvas rewritten for licensing, bottom-up TAM/SAM/SOM, a four-phase milestone table with quantitative gates and pre-committed fallback decisions, and a risk register where every row has a triggering measurement and the decision that follows.

**datascience.** The standout dry-lab contribution. They normalise every price to RMB per kilogram of sucrose sweetness equivalent (RMB/SSE) because a 300x and a 250x sweetener cannot be compared per kilogram, which immediately shows that their real competitor is sucralose at 0.33 RMB/SSE, not sucrose at 5.40. The separation-cost model is calibrated as C_sep = 40/eta on top of a shared RMB 198.9/kg, giving a twenty-fold fall from about RMB 2,000/kg at eta = 2 percent to about RMB 100/kg at 40 percent. Decision thresholds are stated as checkable numbers: alpha greater than or equal to 0.9 or TON greater than or equal to 108 for the enzyme route to beat the fermentation proxy, eta greater than or equal to 9, 16.8 and 26.5 percent for three different comparisons. The model is published as runnable code with a parameter spreadsheet.

**dataviz.** Eighteen figures carrying analysis rather than decoration: an evidence chain where node area is influence on the plan and colour is source type, a log-scale cost-per-sweetness positioning map, an S3 cost build-up split into bought-in versus engineerable lines, a Sherwood-type separation-cost curve, a compliance-status matrix with ok / work-in-progress / not-assessed, a 25-year NPV chart, an economic-window heatmap, a product-architecture diagram and a stakeholder map that deliberately includes the parties their success would harm.

**software.** model_core.py producing model_results.json and then the figures, published so a counterparty can re-run the analysis, with a supplementary Excel of parameters and scenarios.

**ihp.** Thirteen stakeholder interviews plus the survey, tabulated with who said what and, in a separate column, exactly what it changed. Three decisions are traceable to specific conversations rather than to any market report. AGV (Ai-Chi-Wei) brand R&D gave the priority order cost before supply stability before natural origin, which moved the success metric to cost per unit sweetness and narrowed the first market to premium beverage; AGV marketing added where not to compete, naming mass-market fruit tea as unwinnable and partial replacement as the realistic ask. Tiancao Technology, a functional food ingredient supplier, killed the plant-is-cheaper claim outright and pushed them from building capacity toward licensing. A fermentation engineer reordered the roadmap by stating that fermentation or in vitro catalysis is the pragmatic route for 5-10 years, that a new plant variety takes 7-12 years to commercialise, and that LCAs typically favour fermentation over leaf extraction by roughly 92 percent less cropland and 90 percent less water, which caused them to delete every claim that sunlight makes plants greener. Mr Lu, a grower and extension author, supplied the three clauses growers actually respond to (yield not reduced, purchase premium, guaranteed contract) and the line that without a demonstration field there is no trust, which became a hard Phase 3 gate. The China Food and Beverage Association established that different production processes are legally different raw materials even for an identical molecule, turning process disclosure into a named workstream. Most tellingly, three separate interviews told them whole-plant residue valorisation is a brand story rather than a purchase criterion, and they removed it from the base business case rather than argue with the data.

**publicEngagement.** A 503-respondent consumer survey (Questionnaire Star, 2026) reported with the uncomfortable parts intact: natural/healthy/safe drives 61.95 percent of motivation but taste only 12.06 percent and price 4.16 percent, while 57.38 percent would preferentially buy if taste approached sucrose at a reasonable price, and 35.34 percent had never heard of stevia or monk-fruit sweeteners at all. They pair this with a brand-marketing observation that 80-90 percent of consumers cannot distinguish sweetener types, and draw the warning rather than the flattering conclusion: a natural label does not sell itself. Consumer content on Xiaohongshu and Douyin is scoped explicitly to label literacy and evidence-based sugar reduction, with a stated compliance boundary of no health claims and no in-house taste panels.

**realWorld.** The most intellectually honest commercialisation analysis in this cohort, high school or otherwise, and the honesty is structural rather than decorative. The business model is a licence, not a product: a characterised SrUGT76G1 variant plus immobilisation and UDP-glucose-recycling parameters delivered as a technology transfer file, priced at a running royalty of 15 percent of the licensee's incremental gross margin (range 10-25 percent) with signing and milestone fees sized only to recover transfer cost, plus a per-hectare trait royalty of 10-15 percent later and a hairy-root pre-screening service throughout. Every price is anchored to a number the counterparty can verify in their own plant, which they state as the point: nobody is asked to believe a claim, only to run a calculation. Unit economics are fully built: target process cost RMB 438/kg at alpha 0.90 and TON 30, licensee incremental margin RMB 362/kg at a Reb M price of RMB 800/kg, royalty about RMB 54/kg, a five-year indicative P&L with every input as a substitutable row, cumulative break-even in commercial year 2 to 3, and a next-twelve-months funding ask of RMB 150,000-200,000 (USD 21,000-29,000) itemised down to calibration standards and two counterparty visits, with the explicit comment that they would rather present a small itemised ask than a round number. Market evidence is primary: 13 interviews and a 503-person survey, with secondary market data (Mordor, Grand View) used only where it is the right layer and with the two series explicitly declared non-comparable. The TAM is left unquantified and flagged as data gap G1 rather than fabricated. The regulatory path is specific and already open for the lead route: China's National Health Commission announcements 2024 No. 2 and 2025 No. 1 approved steviol glycosides by enzymatic conversion and by fermentation as food additives, which is precisely why the enzyme route leads and the engineered trait follows, with the non-GM conventional-crossing route (published at 56.8-61.6 percent Reb M) kept as a pre-planned fallback that avoids the GM layer. Now the blunt assessment. There is no company, no signed licence, no letter of intent, and one engaged counterparty rather than a customer; they say so in their own weaknesses. Their SrUGT91D2 variants produced a null result across five samples and they publish it, arguing correctly that doing so is what makes the SrUGT76G1 result credible. Their own Reb M quantification is labelled directional only: single batch, no biological replicate, all peak areas below the lowest calibration standard, so absolute values are extrapolated, and the fix (0.5, 1 and 2 microgram standards) is listed as outstanding work. Every performance number in the business case is still a literature value, which they say outright. And the model's most important finding is one that undermines their own pitch: at today's enzyme performance the NPV is negative in every scenario, and the economic window for the in vitro route is 0.7-4.6 years, shorter than the payback period, so the advantage is a window rather than a moat. The continuation plan is correspondingly disciplined: a four-artefact customer-validation gate for the next twelve months (a named refinery completing non-food performance testing, a brand defining partial-replacement acceptance criteria, a toll manufacturer quoting the kilogram-scale process, a regulatory and freedom-to-operate screen), with the statement that until those exist the NPV and P&L remain scenario analyses rather than sales forecasts. They even list the parties their success would disadvantage, including Reb A-only refiners holding the wrong asset and smallholders likely to be reached last, and the public-health trade-off that cheaper sucrose-like sweetness is only a gain if it displaces sugar rather than water.

**給 GEMS：** Build one recomputable decision model per project, published as code plus parameters, whose job is to tell you which route your asset belongs in and what performance threshold makes it worth pursuing, then write every milestone as a quantitative gate with a pre-committed continue, modify or stop decision. The practice that makes it work is publishing the result that hurts: their model says today's enzyme gives a negative NPV, and saying so is what makes every other number believable.

### XJTLU-Software — AMPilot
Undergrad · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/xjtlu-software/
AMPilot is a live, hosted AI-assisted research workbench for antimicrobial peptide design, built around the argument that a conversation is an entry point but the research has to live in inspectable materials. Sources stay linked to their records, candidate sequences stay in files, and documents remain editable after the conversation moves on, across twelve implemented research stages grouped into five phases from framing a question to a bench handoff. The team wrote their own agent harness rather than using LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, DSPy or LiteLLM, specifically so the application rather than a framework owns the saved research state and the policy that turns it into model context, and so that a model proposal becomes an executable action only through a validated tool boundary. The sequence generator, TC-SRF, adapts the ProtFlow latent flow-matching pipeline with scientific-text conditioning via cross-attention and adaptive normalisation plus a constraint-aware decoder that refuses a residue unless some allowed suffix can still satisfy the stated length, charge and composition contract. Validation includes a 16-participant randomised AB/BA crossover user study, which is the most rigorous usability evidence any iGEM software team produced this year.

**frameworks.** A Vue frontend rendering documents, files, questions and progress from server state, over a Python backend (Python 3.11, Node.js 22.12+) whose two named components are StudioRunner, which reads the workspace, runs the engine and reconciles delivery, and CompatibleEngine, which owns the inner model and tool loop and sends ordinary JSON over HTTP via httpx. Persistent state is SQLite with WAL, foreign-key checks and a busy timeout, holding tasks, sources, attachments, research items, questions, decisions and versioned documents, with transactions and version checks so a stale edit cannot silently overwrite a newer document. There are three deliberately separated entry points: five public scientific API routes that need no account, the authenticated hosted workbench (which locks the engine to the self-developed compatible path), and a local MCP bridge started with 'npm run mcp' that accepts a loopback backend and exposes a filtered read-only tool subset, with generation, evaluation, document writing and construct creation excluded by a mutating-tool filter. The team is explicit about what 'self-developed' does and does not mean: the dependency manifest has no agent framework, but ordinary libraries, external language models and scientific packages remain dependencies, and using an SDK would not inherently surrender control of message history; an optional Codex app-server adapter exists but delegates its inner runtime and is kept as a separate, non-conflated path. Licence Apache-2.0, with the TC-SRF-AMP generator MIT-licensed and carrying its own upstream attribution. Live at https://ampilotlab.com (Guest mode with checkpoints in the browser; API docs at /docs, OpenAPI at /openapi.json); source at https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/xjtlu-software/ampilot, pinned at commit 31c2491 for the wiki.

**datascience.** Three layers of evidence, all dated and tied to commits. CI: on 2026-10-20 the team retrieved GitLab's job records and JUnit report for pipeline 776168 at commit 1ca9596, with all six jobs (lint, bundle, frontend, backend-rest, backend-science, backend-agent) passing: 2,622 backend tests passed with 43 skipped and 0 failures, plus 153 frontend tests. They then publish exactly what CI skipped and why (7 for a missing curated document index, 24 for an uninstalled clinical library, 2 for a missing research corpus, 2 for the unvendored HemoPI2 program, and so on), stating that the pipeline's fallback permits such skips so a green pipeline is not evidence every scientific model ran, and that a module skipped at collection can stand for more than one uncollected test. A separate fresh local full-suite run on a Mac mini at the same commit gave 2,677 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed, and the team discloses that one installed regressor's digest differs from the public asset manifest, records both digests, and says the run tests the installed environment rather than certifying byte-identical assets. A local storage microbenchmark measured 400 reads and 400 writes across 8 workers on synthetic data (read 294.1 ops/s at P95 32.47 ms, write 2,895.6 ops/s at P95 4.86 ms, Python 3.11.16, SQLite 3.53.4, Darwin arm64, WAL with synchronous=FULL) and says plainly that this measures storage operations, not simultaneous users or model throughput. The TC-SRF checkpoint was inspected on 19 October 2026 under a restricted CPU load with a matching SHA-256: training step 10,000, best validation total loss 0.1246988252 at step 10,000, zero stale validation evaluations, with the team stating these are stored training state rather than a newly measured score and that they do not prove convergence, recover the loss trajectory or establish validation-set independence. The user study is the standout: 16 participants (8 bioinformatics postgraduates, 8 experimental researchers), each using both a conventional toolchain (PubMed plus web tools plus local scripts) and AMPilot, in a randomised AB/BA crossover with 8 per order, parallel tasks crossed with tools, and at least 48 hours between sessions. Tasks were salt-tolerant short cationic peptides for P. aeruginosa and protease-resistant short amphipathic peptides for MRSA. Results: completion 11/16 conventional vs 15/16 AMPilot; task time 142.5 +/- 28.6 vs 41.2 +/- 37.3 minutes with non-completions assigned the 180-minute cap, a paired reduction of 101.3 minutes (95% CI 81.4-121.2, SEM 9.35); operation and format errors 3.8 +/- 1.2 vs 0.4 +/- 0.5; System Usability Scale 58.2 +/- 9.4 vs 84.5 +/- 6.2. A completers-only sensitivity analysis is reported separately and labelled descriptive rather than paired because the subsets differ. The team states the study supports integration for these tasks and does not establish improved candidate activity, general effectiveness, or a population-wide usability ranking.

**dataviz.** The workbench presents a sequence workspace where a circular plasmid map and the base-level sequence stay connected to the original GenBank annotations, a public knowledge base with separate entry points into catalogues of sequences, MIC values, literature, drugs, clinical trials and patents, and a progress rail that makes unfinished stages visible. The rail's twelve stages are checked against saved outputs rather than against a conversational claim that a stage is complete, which is the key design idea. The measurement planner uses a typed claim rather than free text: a reading carries its quantity and endpoint, unit and subject, target organism, basis (predicted, observed or inferred), the model and the data it was fitted on, and the conditions and scope within which its interpretation applies, with compatible quantities and units checked at that boundary. Every screenshot on the wiki is captioned with its capture date (17 October 2026), the record shown, and an explicit statement that it illustrates the interface and not a biological outcome or a measured user benefit.

**software.** The engineering argument is about who owns context, and it is the most interesting one in iGEM 2026. A long research task accumulates source passages, candidate evaluations, document versions and revised decisions; sending every repeated body is wasteful, but replacing them with a fluent model-written summary erases their identity and scope. AMPilot therefore constructs each request from explicit records with a preserved path back to omitted detail, under three stated rules (retention of identifiers, current verdicts and tool order; non-mutation, meaning a request is projected and the saved record is never overwritten; retrieval, meaning the place omitted evidence can be read again is always named).
