Concretely: the two most recent eligible search responses stay intact while older ones become source indexes only when the replacement is shorter, with a route back via read_source(source_id); the two most recent heavy analysis reads stay whole while older ones are truncated at 400 serialized characters per field without generating a new model-written summary, with a route back via read_research_item(item_id); and when the outer snapshot is rebuilt, revoked decisions move from confirmed_decisions into withdrawn_decisions so a retracted choice stops acting as a requirement while remaining in the audit record. Two loops with two responsibilities: an outer pass reads the workspace and builds the snapshot, while the inner provider loop projects a request-local copy of the message list, streams the response, validates and executes tool calls, matches results to tool-call IDs and appends receipts, with a 32-logical-response budget across a turn (and the honest note that transport retries and evidence-review calls fall outside that count). The tool registry supplies JSON Schema to the model and validates incoming arguments again on the server, refusing unknown tools, invalid arguments and mutations without an active task, and the wiki adds that a valid schema establishes a well-formed request, not a correct scientific conclusion. Delivery reconciliation is the mechanism that most directly addresses LLM failure: after the engine returns, StudioRunner checks promised work against saved outputs and outstanding questions, because 'a fluent closing message is not a delivery receipt', and if a summary fails evidence review after a report was already saved, a deterministic receipt links to the existing work instead of publishing the unchecked summary. Failure handling is designed rather than incidental: a stop records a cancelled task state, supersedes pending proposals, terminates the TC-SRF subprocess and kills it after a grace period, and rejects late publication by checking task status before any workspace write; a version conflict returns a conflict rather than overwriting, so an agent cannot silently restore figures the researcher removed; and an unresolved claim keeps the evidence and stores objections with the draft rather than treating them as approval. Five public API routes expose single functions without a chat thread: POST /api/v1/peptides/evaluate, POST /api/v1/peptides/assay, POST /api/v1/constructs/design (GenBank and SBOL out), GET /api/v1/corpus/search and POST /api/v1/measurements/plan, each row on the wiki carrying its own stated limit (the public corpus route is lexical and explicitly not the local BGE-M3 hybrid retrieval pipeline; the measurement route returns 503 when its bundle is unavailable). Reproducibility is staged honestly: a fresh checkout is described as a starting point rather than every runtime dependency, with predictor and explorer assets fetched through a manifest and SHA-256-checked, local artifacts rebuilt and content-checked, and optional neural services configured separately, with the note that fetched-file checksums and rebuilt-artifact content checks are different guarantees and that not all SQLite or serialized model files are byte-identical across platforms. Data lifecycle is recover-first: Trash stops active work and retains the research, permanent removal requires an exact-record confirmation plus a check that background work has stopped, file cleanup failures stay queued for retry, and the 30-day maintenance command is described as administrator-operated rather than an automatic timer, with the explicit statement that row deletion is not physical-media erasure and that the guide does not promise regulatory compliance. Deployment limits are named too: replicated recovery and a PostgreSQL migration remain work to validate before anyone describes this as distributed high availability. A smaller reusable amp-select package is published separately.

**ihp.** The guiding image is a ship built inside a glass bottle: it may have beautiful sails and never know whether it can withstand real wind. The team's framework insists software teams should not move from idea to implementation, but should ground the idea in social reality, narrow it to a real bottleneck, translate that into a scope, and only then develop along two parallel tracks of fitting real practice and learning to act responsibly. Stakeholders deliberately spanned clinical medicine, infection and antimicrobial resistance research, environmental science and One Health, and experimental AMP work, grouped by principal contribution and engaged at every stage rather than in one round of interviews. A respiratory physician with over ten years of clinical experience at Nanjing Brain Hospital, including severe respiratory infection and respiratory failure, and a documented case at a hospital in Wuhu, Anhui where a patient acquired a resistant infection, anchored the clinical reality. Environmental and One Health input then widened the frame from hospital treatment to the pathways by which antibiotics, resistant bacteria and resistance genes circulate, and the team records the resulting complication honestly: pollution sources, microbial communities and detection capacity vary, and no single indicator can fully describe the risk. The 16-participant crossover study is itself an integrated human practices output, run by the HP team and reported on the software page with its design, its confidence intervals and its stated limits.

**publicEngagement.** Education is organised as three pathways (observe and explain; design and test; critique and deliberate) joined by adaptation and a shared foundation in synthetic biology and engineering thinking, reaching 6 learner groups, over 300 participants, 8 or more organisations and institutions, and 15 or more activities. The plan was built from expert advice before delivery rather than after: the team took the question of how to help people with very different backgrounds find their own way in to Dr Justin Fendos, trained at the Yale Teaching Center and founding director of the Dongseo Scientific Teaching Center in South Korea, across two visits, and shaped the plan around how he adapts materials to a syllabus and to a learner's stage. The stated aim was to teach the ideas behind synthetic biology even where they extend beyond AMPilot itself.

**realWorld.** The problem is anchored in The Lancet's 2024 global burden estimate: 4.71 million deaths associated with bacterial antimicrobial resistance in 2021, 1.14 million attributable to it, and a reference-scenario projection of roughly 1.91 million attributable deaths annually by 2050, with knock-on effects on surgery and cancer care that depend on effective infection control. The named audiences are AMP researchers at universities and research institutions, synthetic biology and iGEM teams, and early-stage R&D professionals in biopharmaceutical companies. The team frames the longer-term goal as making the workflow reusable for other functional peptides by swapping domain knowledge, generation and evaluation models and experimental requirements. Contributions are offered at three independently usable levels: the software and its interfaces, an organised AMP knowledge base, and human practices questions and editable records for connecting stakeholder engagement to design.

**給 GEMS：** Make the application, not the model, own the research record: AMPilot checks a stage complete against saved outputs rather than a conversational claim, reconciles promised work against what was actually written because a fluent closing message is not a delivery receipt, and shortens repeated context by replacing bodies with indexes that name exactly how to read the detail again instead of substituting an AI summary. Then prove the tool's value the way they did, with a randomised AB/BA crossover study reporting completion, time with confidence intervals, error counts and SUS, and with a published list of exactly which CI tests were skipped and why.

### Yucai-SZ — SpotAway: a dry-activatable emergency stain patch
High School · China · https://2026.igem.wiki/yucai-sz/
Yucai-SZ designed SpotAway, a concept for a portable dry patch that treats fresh oil stains where they happen. The functional layer pairs a cellulose-binding-module fusion carrying a de novo designed capsanthin binder, for capturing the hydrophobic pigment in chili oil, with a triolein-binding-domain lipase fusion that anchors near oil droplets and hydrolyses triglycerides, all held in a trehalose-mannitol-protected xerogel that is rehydrated with one or two drops of water. The dry lab extended the standard Foundry de novo design pipeline by layering a docking-based binding-ability pre-test onto structural screening, after wet-lab results showed that structural metrics alone could not rank candidates. What distinguishes the measurement work is that every assay is published with a section defining what it cannot show.

**frameworks.** Four measurement modules (M1 to M4), each written as introduction, experimental setup and validation, results and discussion, methodological boundaries, and applications. The boundaries section is not an afterthought: it states the wavelength, concentration range, temperature and pH over which each conclusion holds and names the techniques that would be required to go further. Four wet-lab Design-Build-Test-Learn cycles are layered onto a two-round computational screening loop in which wet-lab disagreement with the dry-lab ranking is the trigger for changing the pipeline.

**datascience.** The measurement wavelength is derived rather than assumed. Seven control groups covering buffer, pure solvent, the biphasic solvent background, pigment absorption and intrinsic protein absorption were scanned from 240 to 320 nm in 5 nm increments, which showed the binder's 280 nm peak shifting about 5 nm shorter in the petroleum-ether biphasic system, fixing 275 nm as the quantification wavelength, with the explicit rule that 275 nm must not be adopted without rescanning if the pigment, solvent ratio or biphasic conditions change. Protein specificity of the response is then tested with a negative protein control, egg white, which also absorbs near 280 nm but does not reproduce a comparable delta-OD on adding capsanthin, and independent-samples t-tests distinguish genuine responses (Binder-1 and Binder-3 increased, p < 0.01; Binder-2 decreased, p < 0.001) from non-responses (Binder-4 and egg white, not significant). Two standard curves are built for the lead candidate rather than one, a binder concentration curve at 275 nm over 0 to 1.5 mg/mL (y = 0.388x + 0.03, R2 = 0.990) to account for protein background and a delta-OD against concentration curve (y = 0.108x - 0.006, R2 = 0.993) measured against a blank at matched binder concentration after a 30-minute light-protected reaction, with the stated limit that the fits are valid only over 0 to 1.5 mg/mL and must not be extrapolated, and that the method cannot yield a dissociation constant, which would require ligand titration across orders of magnitude and separation of free from bound states by SPR, ITC, MST or fluorescence quenching. The most instructive module is M3, where transferring the UV strategy to lycopene produced unstable results and the team stopped to measure the measurement system itself: a lycopene standard curve in petroleum ether (y = 0.1109x - 0.00223, R2 = 0.994) plus light-exposed and light-protected time series read at 0, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240 and 270 minutes showed the OD474.5 signal drifting with an apparent half-life of about 2.5 hours under illumination, which meant an observed OD change could not be attributed to binder activity. The team terminated the lycopene route on that basis and states the conclusion precisely, that the current lycopene assay system lacks sufficient stability for binder assessment, not that lycopene cannot be used at all, and notes that they did not identify the degradation products or separate photodegradation from thermal degradation. Lipase activity is quantified by copper-soap colorimetry at 710 nm against an oleic acid standard curve (y = 0.0123x + 0.0452, R2 = 0.999), with free lipase at 4.19 U/mL and the Lipase-Binder fusion at 3.68 U/mL at matched 1 mg/mL protein (87.8% retention), and the team is careful that the 143% apparent retention per catalytic centre is a theoretical molar correction based on an unverified 1.63x molecular-weight ratio calculated from amino acid composition, not an independent measurement of enhancement. The unit is defined (1 U equals 1 umol fatty acid released per minute at 37 C and pH 7.0) and the assay conditions are justified against the intended use, olive oil as a stand-in for the long-chain triglycerides in cooking-oil stains, 37 C as warm-water washing and pH 7.0 as neutral washing, while stating that performance at 20 C or pH 9 to 10 is not established.

**dataviz.** UV background scans from 240 to 320 nm in 5 nm steps for seven separate control groups, with the absorbance maximum arrowed on each; delta-OD bar charts with mean +/- SD, individual significance annotations and n stated; two paired standard curves for the lead binder, one for protein quantification and one for the binding response; time-course photographs of pigment adsorption alongside the quantitative data; lycopene stability curves comparing light-exposed and light-protected groups over 270 minutes with the sample photographs beside them; an oleic acid calibration curve.

**software.** The computational pipeline is built on RFdiffusion3 for backbone generation, LigandMPNN for sequence design, RoseTTAFold3 for pTM and ipTM structure evaluation with RMSD as a designability filter, and AutoDock Vina docking added in round two as a binding-ability pre-screen after the wet lab showed that four candidates with near-identical structural metrics behaved very differently in adsorption. Redesigning 200 sequences on the Binder-1 backbone and docking-screening them produced Binder-5 with the strongest predicted binding energy (-10.9 kcal/mol), which improved about 40% over its parent in the wet lab without overtaking the round-one best candidate, a result the team reports as showing docking can rescue weak candidates rather than as a validation of docking.

**ihp.** The project began from a questionnaire with 719 valid responses plus interviews with hotpot enthusiasts, used to test whether the team's own experience of oil stains reflected a broader need before committing to the problem.

**publicEngagement.** The team runs an education programme and publishes a cookbook alongside the project, with collaborations and a sustainable-development-goals page documenting wider activity.

**realWorld.** An entrepreneurship page accompanies the project. The team is careful to describe the patch as a concept whose integration remains to be experimentally validated, and frames the measurement conditions, 37 C and pH 7.0 with olive oil as substrate, as deliberately matching the product's intended use so that the reported activity reflects performance in context rather than serving only as a proof of principle.

**給 GEMS：** Before attributing a signal change to your molecule, measure whether the analyte itself is stable under the measurement conditions: light-exposed versus light-protected time series and an apparent half-life define the window in which a reading means anything, and are cheap enough to run before every new target.
